You can use the WhatsApp search bar to search personal chats or send questions to Meta AI business assistant. Messages from Meta AI business assistant are generated by AI (artificial intelligence), using a technology from Meta, in response to the prompts and messages you send to the AI.

Note:

  • Meta AI business assistant and some experiences are currently only available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet, even if others in your country have access.
  • At this time, only English, Arabic, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Tagalog, Thai, and Vietnamese are supported.

When you type into the search bar, we’ll show you results from your chats and present questions you can ask Meta AI business assistant. Content from your personal chats remains on your device. Meta doesn’t connect what you type back to you personally unless you send a prompt to Meta AI business assistant. By default, topics suggested by Meta AI business assistant are generated automatically and not based on your personal information.

You can continue to use the search functionality on WhatsApp as you normally would, to search chats for messages, photos, videos, links, GIFs, audio, polls, and documents from the search bar. Choosing to interact with Meta AI doesn’t affect your personal messaging experience on WhatsApp.

Search with Meta AI business assistant

  1. Tap the search field at the top of your Chats list.
  2. Tap a suggested prompt or type your own and tap Ask.
  3. As you type a prompt, you’ll see search recommendations under Ask Meta AI business assistant.
  • If prompted, read and accept the terms.
  1. Tap a search recommendation.

When you tap a search suggestion, Ask, or enter on your keyboard, you’ll be shown Meta Business Agents and Platform Terms of Service only if you’ve never interacted with Meta AI business assistant. You’ll then be taken to a chat with Meta AI business assistant to continue the interaction. Learn how to chat with Meta AI business assistant in this article.

Note:

  • As always, your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption, meaning no one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them. To learn more about AI chats and privacy on WhatsApp, read more here.

About Business Features

Copy link

We want to be clear that the January 2021 terms and privacy policy updates do not affect personal messages. The changes are related to optional business features on WhatsApp, and provides further transparency about how we collect and use data.

What’s not changing?

The privacy and security of your personal messages and calls do not change. Your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption, meaning no one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them. We will never weaken this security and we label each chat so you know our commitment.

Optional Business Features

We’re working to better support over 175 million people who message a business account every day. The updates related to optional business features are a part of our broader efforts to make communicating with a business secure, better, and easier for everyone. These efforts include:

  • Enabling customer service: People find it useful to chat with businesses to ask questions, to make a purchase, or get helpful information like purchase receipts. We’re now making it easier to chat with businesses who may use Meta business products. To respond to customers, some businesses need secure hosting services that Meta plans to offer. When a business uses this service, we will clearly label the chat so it’s up to you whether or not you message them.
  • Discovering a business: People can already discover businesses on Facebook or Instagram from ads that show a button you can click to message them using WhatsApp. Just like other ads on Facebook, if you choose to click on these ads, it may be used to personalize the ads you see on Facebook. Again, WhatsApp and Meta cannot see the content of any end to end encrypted messages.
  • Shopping experiences: More people are shopping online, increasing as we are apart. Where available, businesses with a Shop on Facebook or Instagram can already have Shops on their WhatsApp business profile. This allows you to see a business’s products on Facebook and Instagram and shop from it directly in WhatsApp. If you choose to interact with Shops, we will let you know in WhatsApp how your data is being shared with Meta.

You can learn more details about these optional features and how we work with Meta here.

Business Features

Copy link

WhatsApp is committed to exploring multiple ways to help your business connect with customers. In order to provide customized solutions to your business needs, we offer two business solutions i.e. WhatsApp Business app and WhatsApp Business platform.

WhatsApp Business app is built with the business owner in mind. The app makes it easy to personally connect with your customers, highlight your products and services, and answer their questions. Create a catalog to showcase your products and services and use special tools to automate, sort, and quickly respond to messages.

To get started, download the WhatsApp Business app at no additional charge from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.

WhatsApp Business Platform helps medium and large businesses provide customer support and deliver important notifications to customers.

Explore our library of help content for the WhatsApp Business Platform here.

Can’t save or recover quick replies

Copy link

Can’t save a quick reply

If you can’t save your quick reply, check to make sure it follows all of the following formatting rules.

  • The maximum number of stored quick replies allowed is 50.
  • The maximum length of a quick reply shortcut is 25 characters.
  • Shortcuts can’t include spaces.
  • All shortcuts must begin with a forward slash /.
  • The maximum number of keywords allowed per quick reply is three.
  • Keywords may not contain spaces or any non-alphabetic, non-numeric characters.
  • The maximum length of a single keyword is 15 characters.

Can’t recover quick replies

If your quick replies have disappeared, they can’t be recovered. You’ll need to recreate them.

To avoid losing quick replies in the future, save a copy of your quick reply messages outside of the app.

Can’t link or unlink WhatsApp Business account to Facebook or Instagram

Copy link

If you’re having trouble linking or unlinking your WhatsApp Business account to a Facebook Page or Instagram profile, make sure that:

  • You use the phone number associated with your WhatsApp Business account on the WhatsApp Business app.
  • You’re an admin on your Facebook Business Manager account.
  • Your Facebook Page or Instagram Profile and your Catalog are linked to the same Business Manager account.
  • You have Manage Page permissions for the Facebook Page or Instagram Profile and Manage Catalog permissions for the catalog on Business Manager.
  • You entered the correct registration code when registering the phone number associated with your WhatsApp Business account.

About channels on the WhatsApp Business app

Copy link

Create a channel for your business to share updates and information with customers and connect with new ones. Channels on the WhatsApp Business app allow you to broadcast an update to an audience of any size. To get started, download the WhatsApp Business app.

While channels might feel familiar to chats, channel updates are a one-way broadcast rather than a conversation. Customers who follow you can’t reply directly to updates or send messages to channel admins. Instead they can show their interest in a channel’s content by adding emoji reactions to channel updates or voting on polls.

Updates are sent from your channel, which is in the Updates tab of the app. Followers won’t see your WhatsApp Business profile name, picture, or your phone number.

Channel admins are visible to each other. Learn more about safety and privacy as a channel admin.

Share updates and information with your followers

Use your channel to share things like:

  • Text
  • Images
  • Videos
  • Stickers
  • Links
  • Audio
  • Polls

As the channel owner, you and all channel admins are responsible for keeping the content on your channel safe, relevant, and age-appropriate for your followers. Learn more in the Channels Guidelines.

Attract new followers

Customers can find your channel in several ways:

  • External link: Share a link to your channel on other websites or apps. Your channel and updates will be viewable in WhatsApp.
  • In-app sharing: Customers can share channels they like with their WhatsApp contacts.
  • Browsing in the app: Customers can search for channels or find them by browsing the directory. For easier browsing, some channels are sorted into categories within the directory.

Measure engagement

With channel insights, you can see metrics about your channel like:

  • Insights about your channel’s growth and reach for the last 30 days, including accounts reached, top regions, and number of follows/unfollows.
  • Additional info about followers who are also contacts.
  • Emoji reaction and poll results.

Learn how to channel metrics and insights.

Channels is still evolving so keep in mind, we’ll continue to add new features for channel admins as we grow.

Following channels on the WhatsApp Business app

About chatting with businesses that use AI from Meta for business messaging

Copy link

Note:

  • This feature is currently only available in limited countries to select businesses. It might not be available to you yet. If you are unable to turn on Meta Business Agent using the steps in this article, you can add yourself to the waitlist here.
  • At this time, not all languages are supported. The language that AI from Meta uses is determined by your business’s phone number.
  • Messages generated by AI from Meta may not be accurate or appropriate.

Businesses on WhatsApp may use AI from Meta to provide you with faster customer assistance and customized experiences using AI-generated messages.

How to identify chats with AI

Some businesses use AI from Meta so they can respond to customers more quickly. When you chat with a business that uses AI from Meta:

  • This message will appear in your chat with the business: AI from Meta receives chats to improve AI quality and generate messages for this business.

  • Messages in your chat that are created by AI from Meta will feature the marking: AI

    [Image: AI Sparkle Dust (sparkle dust)]

    .

Your privacy is our priority

  • Chats with businesses that have enabled AI from Meta feature this icon

    [Image: Double Chevron (two right chevrons within a circle)]

    in the chat thread or on the business profile.

  • When you see this icon

    [Image: Double Chevron (two right chevrons within a circle)]

    in the chat thread or on the business profile, it means Meta may receive message content to improve AI quality.

You are in control of the conversation. If a business chooses to use AI services provided by Meta, you’ll have an opportunity to review how your messages will be used and decide if you want to message that business. You can stop chatting with the business or block them at any time. To learn about controls you have when messaging businesses, view this article.

At any time while interacting with a business using AI from Meta, you can ask to stop receiving AI-generated messages from AI from Meta. If you ask to stop receiving AI-generated messages from Meta or if AI from Meta cannot assist you at any point, it will attempt to connect you with the business for additional support. Learn about controls you have when messaging businesses.

Since these AI chats are a Meta service, you’ll need to approach Meta to request data access or deletion.

You can download or ask Meta to delete its copy of your messages and information about you and the AI chat by using chat-based commands. If you delete either the chat or your WhatsApp account, or if Meta has deleted the information because the business no longer uses AI from Meta, you will not be able to download this information.

  • To download your messages and information about you and the AI chat, type and send the following command in a chat with the respective AI: /download-ai-info.
  • To delete your messages and information about you and the AI chat, type and send the following command in a chat with the respective AI: /reset-ai.

Learn more about these options in this article.

Users who want to access or delete information that businesses have collected about them should contact the business for more information.

When you message a business that uses AI from Meta, AI from Meta generates responses based on information that Meta has already received from the business and your messages. If a response is not accurate or appropriate, you can provide feedback about the message to help Meta improve the quality of its AI. To learn how to provide feedback about a message created by AI from Meta, view this article.

Note: As always, your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption. No one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them. Learn more in this article.

Copy link

You can connect Google Calendar to Meta Business Agent within your WhatsApp Business account to allow your AI agent to schedule appointments between you and your customers.

How to connect Google Drive with Meta Business Agent

Copy link

You can connect your Google Drive account to Meta Business Agent within your WhatsApp Business and manage which files it can use. Meta Business Agent will use information from the files you select to enhance responses when you interact with customers.

Note: Meta Business Agent cannot be connected to Google Drive using WhatsApp Web. You can connect Meta Business Agent to Google Drive using the WhatsApp Business mobile app.

Connect your Google Drive account

  1. Open the Tools tab in the WhatsApp Business app.
  2. Tap Your AI agent.
  3. Tap Connections. Or, tap Knowledge, scroll down to Google Drive and tap Add.
  4. In the Available partner apps section, tap Google Drive.
  5. Tap Connect Google Drive in the pop up window.
  6. Choose the Google account you’d like to connect to Meta Business Agent.
  7. Tap Continue to sign in to WhatsApp.
  8. Tap See and download all your Google Drive files and tap Continue.
  9. Select files you want to connect and tap Sync files.

It might take up to 12 hours to complete the Google Drive connection. You can disconnect your Google Drive account at any time. After you disconnect, Meta Business Agent will no longer be able to access its data.

Disconnect your Google Drive account

  1. Open the Tools tab in the WhatsApp Business app.
  2. Tap Your AI agent.
  3. Tap Connections.
  4. In the Connected partner apps section, tap Google Drive.
  5. Tap Disconnect.
  6. Tap Disconnect again when you are asked to confirm this action.

About connecting with businesses

Copy link

It’s easy to distinguish between a personal account and a business account on WhatsApp. In an individual chat, tap or click the contact’s name to view their profile. If they’re a business, their profile will be labeled as a WhatsApp Business account.

A Business account is the default status for a business that creates an account on one of the WhatsApp Business products.

Some businesses have a verified badge indicated by a blue checkmark that appears next to the business name in the chat window. The badge means the business was verified by Meta based on their activity on WhatsApp and documents they provide.

Why am I seeing a new system message in my WhatsApp chats?

Some businesses choose WhatsApp’s parent company, Meta, or another company to securely store messages and respond to customers.

You’ll see the following messages, when a business chooses to:

  • Use a partner: You’ll see “This business works with other companies to manage this chat.”
  • Use the WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API (Hosted by Meta): You’ll see “This business uses a secure service from Meta to manage this chat.”

If a business is using the WhatsApp Business app or managing and storing customer messages themselves, you’ll see: “Messages and calls are end-to-encrypted. Only people in this chat can read, listen to, or share them.”

Meta will not automatically use the messages you send a business to inform the ads that you see. However, businesses will be able to use chats they receive for their own marketing purposes, including advertising on Meta.

If you don’t want to receive messages from a business, you can block them directly from the chat.

Always private and secure

Every WhatsApp message is protected by the same Signal encryption protocol that secures messages before they leave your device. When you message a WhatsApp business account, your message is delivered securely to the destination chosen by the business.

Note:

  • There are optional services that a business or you can choose to use where Meta receives limited information. For example, you can choose to start a chat with a business after interacting with their ad on Facebook and Instagram. You can also interact with offers and announcements a business may send you on WhatsApp. We include the

    [Image: single chevron]

    icon for these services, which you’ll be able to tap to learn more about how this works. To learn more about interactions with business chats that include offers and announcements, read this article.

  • In addition, certain companies choose to use AI from Meta to assist them in responding to messages sent from customers. Meta receives these chats to improve its AI quality; when this happens we will let you know by highlighting “uses AI from Meta” under the business name.

About contacts and your WhatsApp Business app

Copy link

GDPR and the contacts in your device address book

When you use the WhatsApp Business app, you are the Controller of all contacts in your device’s address book. As Controller, you must have a legal basis to process your contacts, whether contractual necessity, legitimate interest, consent, or any other appropriate legal basis described in Article 6 of the GDPR.

When you give WhatsApp access to these contacts, WhatsApp is your data Processor. We quickly determine whether you can message these contacts on WhatsApp and deliver your messages to the intended recipients. For more information, refer to the WhatsApp Business Data Processing Terms referenced and incorporated within our WhatsApp Business Terms of Service.

Manage and control access to your device address book

There are several ways to control which contacts you provide to WhatsApp. For example, you can add only those contacts for which you have the appropriate legal basis to your device address book. One benefit of this approach is that it encourages you and your employees to practice good data privacy hygiene. Keeping business contacts and devices separate from personal ones helps prevent the misuse of customers’ data or company devices for personal use (and vice versa).

If you wish to keep all your business and personal contacts on the same device, you can segment your address book by using tools that allow you to keep separate address books.

Controls when communicating with businesses

Copy link

You’re in control of your communication with businesses on WhatsApp and you can easily update chat preferences.

WhatsApp gives you tools to share feedback or stop receiving communication on WhatsApp from a particular business that include offers and announcements. These include coupons, information about new products, back-in-stock alerts, or reminders about upcoming sales and events. Or, you can block and report that business at any time.

As a reminder, our policies prohibit businesses from contacting you without your permission.

Message with your username

If you’re chatting with a business and you have a username set up, your phone number will be kept private. Businesses you haven’t messaged before won’t see your phone number. A business may ask you to share your phone number in the chat for orders or payments. Sharing your phone number is optional and always your choice.

Stop offers and announcements

You can choose to stop receiving offers and announcement messages altogether:

  1. Open your chat with the business.
  2. Tap Stop, then tap Stop again to confirm that you’ll no longer receive offers and announcements.

To continue receiving offers and announcements, open your chat with the business and tap Resume.

If you decide to stop offers and announcements, you’ll still get other messages that you have chosen to receive such as boarding passes, delivery updates, one-time passwords, etc.

Share message feedback

Submit feedback to let WhatsApp know if you’re interested in the type of messages the business sends you.

To continue to get offers and announcements from the business:

  1. Open your chat with the business.

  2. Tap

    [Image: thumb up (thumbs up)]

    .

  • To cancel your feedback, tap Undo.

To get fewer offers and announcements from the business:

  1. Open your chat with the business.

  2. Tap

    [Image: thumb down (thumbs down)]

    .

  • To cancel your feedback, tap

    [Image: undo (left arrow with U-shaped tail)]

    .

  • To stop getting offers and announcements from the business, tap

    [Image: hand raised (hand raised)]

    .

  • To block the business, tap

    [Image: cancel (red x in red circle)]

    .

Block or report a business

When you receive a message from a business, we will also provide you with the option to block or report the business, or view their profile.

When you block a business, you can tell us why. For example, you no longer need to message that business or you didn’t sign up to receive messages from them. We might use this block and report information to take action on an account or limit the messages they can send. We may also use this information to ensure the safe and secure use of WhatsApp by detecting spam and limiting other bad experiences.

The information you provide is anonymous to the business, which means the business can’t see who provided it. WhatsApp doesn’t see the content of your messages to the business.

How to create a link to your WhatsApp from your Google Business Profile

Copy link

You can add your WhatsApp Business phone number to your Google Business Profile to let customers start a chat with you in one click.

Businesses that add their phone number automatically receive a WhatsApp click to chat button that shows to customers when your business appears in Google Search and Google Maps results. When customers click the button, they’re sent to WhatsApp where they can start a chat with your business.

For businesses that already have a Google Business Profile, tap or click here and follow these steps to add your WhatsApp Business phone number:

  1. Tap or click Edit profile > Contact.
  2. Tap or click the Down arrow in the Chat section.
  3. Select WhatsApp.
  4. Add your WhatsApp click to chat URL.
  5. Tap or click Save.

Note:

  • Make sure the phone number you add is a valid WhatsApp Business phone number in international format.
  • You can add multiple WhatsApp Business phone numbers to your Google Business Profile.
  • If you don’t have a Google Business Profile, tap or click here to create one.

How to create a verified channel on the WhatsApp Business app

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

More

Android

iOS

Once you’ve subscribed to Meta Verified or Meta One for Business on WhatsApp and your account has been verified, you can create a verified channel or verify one of your existing channels. Add a verified badge to your WhatsApp channel to help potential customers feel more confident when engaging with your brand.

Create a new verified channel

If you don’t already have a channel on the WhatsApp Business app, you’ll need to create one before you can add the verified badge.

  1. Tap Tools > Subscriptions.
  2. Tap Meta Verified or Meta One, depending on your subscription.
  3. Tap Verified channel.
  4. Tap Get started > Continue.
  5. Enter your Channel description.
  6. Tap Create verified channel. This will create a new channel with your verified business name and profile picture.

Note: The business name which has been verified will always be the prefix of any verified channel name. Additionally, profile pictures for verified channels will be set to match the profile picture for the verified business account. It’s currently not possible to change this, even in the case of multiple channels.

Add a verification badge to a channel

If you have an existing WhatsApp channel, you can add a verified badge. Currently, you can verify up to 10 channels per subscription, depending on the subscription plan.

  1. Open your channel. Then, tap your channel name.
  2. Tap Add a verified badge.
  3. Select the verified business account you’d like to connect to your channel. The Channel name and picture will change to match your verified details.
  4. Tap Confirm changes.

Your channel should now show the verified badge. If it doesn’t appear immediately, you may need to restart the WhatsApp Business app to see the update.

Remove the verified badge from your channel

You can remove the verified badge from your channel at any time. This is helpful when transferring ownership of a verified channel to another WhatsApp user.

To remove the badge:

  1. Open your channel. Then, tap your channel name.
  2. Tap Remove verified badge > Remove verified badge.

Removing the verified badge from your channel will not impact the status of your Meta Verified or Meta One subscription.

Once the badge is removed from your channel, you can transfer ownership of the channel to another user. Learn how to transfer channel ownership here. Once they have ownership, they can subscribe to Meta Verified or Meta One on their account and add the badge to the channel once verified.

Note: The verified badge may be removed for integrity reasons, such as channel suspension.

Verified channel isn’t searchable or visible

Although some channels are not visible in search results, you can still help promote your channel by sharing your link with others. To do this, go to your channel and tap the Channel Link button. This will give you options to share your channel with friends or copy the URL from the list.

Please note that having a verification badge does not guarantee your channel will appear in search results. Keep an eye on our Help Center, blog and social feeds for the latest information.

How to create ads in Status on the WhatsApp Business app

Copy link

Ads in status on the WhatsApp business app are managed in Meta’s Ads Manager and supported by the Meta Business Help Center. If you have issues with creating ads or using Ads Manager, contact Meta Business support. If you have issues with payments or questions about refunds, contact Meta payment support.

Businesses use status to engage with their audience through photos, videos, and text. Ads in status can help your business get discovered by new customers and make it easier to connect with you.

You can create ads in Meta Ads Manager that use the WhatsApp Status placement. Ads will appear in Status and Channels, separate from personal chats and calls. Customers who interact with your ad are sent directly to a chat with your business.

With Ads Manager reporting, you can review metrics for your ads, such as impressions, clicks, and messaging conversations started.

Learn how to create ads in WhatsApp Status.

How to create ads on WhatsApp Business

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

Web

More

Android

From the WhatsApp Business app on iPhone, you can create Facebook and Instagram ads that lead to a WhatsApp chat with your business.

You can tailor these ads by selecting photos, videos, catalog items, or statuses. You set your own budget, duration, and target audience.

There are two ways to create ads on iPhone. Choose the method that matches your setup:

  1. Without a Facebook account: Use your email address for verification and payment. No Facebook login required.
  2. With a linked Facebook account: Log in to Facebook to use your existing Facebook payment method.

Note:

  • Ads and ad accounts must follow the Meta advertising policies and WhatsApp Business policies. You can’t create new ads while your ad account is in review.
  • All ads need to be approved before they go live. Ad reviews typically take 24 hours.

Create an ad without a Facebook account on iPhone

If you don’t have a Facebook account or prefer not to link one, you can create ads from the WhatsApp Business app on iPhone using your email address.

Ad creation steps without Facebook on iPhone

  1. Tap Settings > Advertise > Get started.
  2. Choose a photo from your gallery or phone, catalog item, or status to advertise.
  3. Note: You must grant the Facebook app permission to access your photo gallery. Catalog items must be approved. You can advertise multiple products.
  4. Tap Continue.
  5. If asked to continue with Facebook, tap Skip if you don’t want to use a Facebook account.
  6. Review and accept Facebook’s non-discrimination policy.
  7. Enter a description for your ad.
  8. Set a daily budget, a duration, and an audience.

Payment and verification for first-time ad setup on iPhone

If this is your first ad without a Facebook account on iPhone, you’ll need to verify your email and add a payment method.

  1. Tap Add payment method.
  2. Enter your email address > tap Send code. You’ll receive a six-digit code via email.
  3. Enter the six-digit code.
  4. Select your country or region, currency, and time zone > tap Next.
  5. Enter your business information > tap Next.
  6. Add your payment information > tap Continue.
  7. Tap Create ad.

If approved, your ad will appear under Settings > Manage ads. It can take some time before the ad appears.

Create an ad with a linked Facebook account on iPhone

If you have a Facebook account, you can link it to the WhatsApp Business app on iPhone to streamline ad creation and use your existing Facebook payment method.

  1. Tap Settings > Advertise > Get started.
  2. Select a photo from your gallery or phone, catalog item, or status to advertise.
  3. Note: You must grant the Facebook app permission to access your photo gallery. Catalog items must be approved. You can advertise multiple products.
  4. Tap Continue.
  5. If asked to continue with Facebook, tap Continue, Login, or Not you, and log in to your Facebook account. If not asked, scroll down to Payments and tap Login to Facebook. If you don’t see these options, make sure the Facebook app is installed.
  6. Enter a description for your ad.
  7. Set a daily budget, a duration, and an audience.
  8. Use your Facebook account to select a payment method.
  9. Review your ad settings and Tap Create ad.

If approved, your ad will appear under Manage ads.

Draft ads on iPhone

If you started creating an ad on the WhatsApp Business app on iPhone but didn’t finish, you can find your draft ad under Tools > Advertise.

To continue working on a draft ad, tap Continue creating ad under the For you section. You can also resume your draft from the Advertise screen.

Note: You can only have one draft ad saved at a time. Creating a new draft will delete your previous draft. Draft ads are automatically deleted after 7 days.

Ad approval time and scheduling on iPhone

To view and manage your active and completed ads on iPhone, tap Tools > Manage ads. You can track performance and see all your ads in one place.

Ads submitted from the WhatsApp Business app can take up to 24 hours to be approved. Ad results can improve over time, often after the first two days.

You can’t schedule ads in advance or set them to repeat automatically. To restart an ad that has ended:

  1. Tap Tools > Manage ads.
  2. Tap More (three dots) next to a completed ad.
  3. Tap Recreate ad.

Note: This article contains information about how to create a catalog on the WhatsApp Business app. To learn how to connect an existing Meta catalog to the WhatsApp Business app, view this article.

To provide your customers easy access to your business’s latest offerings, keep your catalog updated.

Add a product or service to your catalog

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Catalog.

  2. Tap Add new item. Then, tap Add photos and videos.

  3. Tap Photo & video library > select media > Next >

    [Image: Send (paper airplane)]

    to upload images and videos from your device or Camera >

    [Image: Send (paper airplane)]

    to take new images or videos.

  • Note: You can upload up to 10 images or videos. The size limit for a video is 50 MB. Video thumbnail images are automatically generated when a video is uploaded and cannot be edited at this time.
  1. Enter a product or service name.
  2. Tap Country of origin.
  3. Select the country where the item was created and tap Save.
  • Note: You must select the country of origin when adding a new item or editing an existing catalog item.
  1. Add optional details:
    • Price
    • Sale price
    • Description
    • Website link
    • Product or service code
  2. Tap Save.

Note: Every image and video uploaded to the catalog is subject to a review, which confirms that the image, video, product, or service meets the WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy.

Catalog items will only be visible to your customers after they have been approved by WhatsApp. If an item is pending review or has been rejected, it will not be visible to customers. Once a product or service is approved, it’s automatically added to the catalog. However, if it’s rejected, a red exclamation icon will be displayed next to the image.

If you think your item was wrongly rejected, you can appeal the decision:

  1. Tap the rejected item.
  2. Tap Request another review.
  3. Enter your reason for the request.
  4. Tap Continue.

If you reviewed the WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy and your appeal was rejected, send us a reply explaining your request for a third review.

Control which products or services customers can see

Hide catalog items

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Catalog.

  2. Tap a product or service >

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots within circle)]

    Edit.

  3. Turn on Hide this item.

  4. Tap Save.

  • Alternatively, swipe left on an item in your Catalog manager. Then, tap Hide > Hide.

Note: Hidden items still appear in your catalog manager with

[Image: Hide Catalog Item (eye with slash)]

over the item image. On the product detail page, a note also indicates when an item is hidden.

Unhide catalog items

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Catalog.

  2. Tap a hidden product or service

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots within circle)]

    Edit.

  3. Turn off Hide this item.

  4. Tap Save.

  • Alternatively, swipe left on an item in your catalog manager. Then, tap Unhide > Unhide.

Create and manage collections in your catalog

You can create collections within your catalog to make it easier for customers to find the products and services they’re looking for. Learn more about how to create and manage collections.

Share a product or service from your catalog

You can share a link to products or services from your catalog in a chat or on your status in WhatsApp, or with a third-party messaging app. Learn more about how to share a product or service from your catalog.

Delete a product or service from your catalog

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Catalog.
  2. Swipe left on a product. Then, tap Delete > Delete.

    • Alternatively, select the image of the product or service you want to delete. Then, tap

      [Image: More (three horizontal dots within circle)]

      Edit > Delete > Delete.

How to create and manage your business username

On iPhone

Copy link

Web

Android

iOS

More

Web

Android

iOS

Usernames on WhatsApp Business is rolling out gradually over the next few months and might not be available to you yet. In the meantime, you can reserve your business username. We recommend keeping WhatsApp Business updated on your device so you can get the latest feature updates.

Businesses on WhatsApp Business can create a unique username (for example, @yourbusiness) to help customers find your business. Usernames are optional and can help you strengthen your brand while making it easy for customers to find you.

A business username is a unique identifier (like @YourBusinessName) that lets customers contact you without needing your phone number. With a username, your business phone number will still be visible on your business profile.

Customers who don’t have your business phone number saved will see your username instead. This includes when you message a customer directly, participate in group chats, or make WhatsApp calls. Your username always appears with an @ symbol.

Note: Customers who already have your number saved will continue to see it. When you message someone new, we may share the country where your number is registered to help them decide whether to respond. Each phone number can only have one username. If your business uses more than one phone number, you’ll need a different username for each number.

Customers can enter your exact username directly in WhatsApp to start a conversation. There’s no searchable directory — they need to know your exact username, which is why sharing it on your marketing materials, signage, and social media is important. You can also share via QR code or a direct link

When you create a username for your business:

  • Your business profile stays the same. Your display name, profile photo, description, and other business information stay the same.
  • Your business phone number stays on your business profile, and customers who already have your number can continue communicating with you as they do today.
  • Your existing customer chats stay the same. You can still message customers by using their phone numbers.
  • Your customers may be notified.
  • Creating a username will not hide your business phone number.

Create a business username

  1. Go to the Tools tab and tap Edit Profile.
  2. Tap Create username > Create username.
  3. Enter the new username you want.
  4. Tap Save > Done.

Usernames can be up to 25 characters long. You can only use lowercase letters (a to z) and numbers (0 to 9).

If you see “This username is not available”, the username might be taken.

Note: You can claim the same username you use on Instagram or Facebook by linking your WhatsApp Business account with your Facebook Page or Instagram Business profile. Learn how to link your accounts.

For businesses using the WhatsApp Business App, usernames can only be transferred to a different phone number by changing your phone number on the same phone. Username transferring is not available to an existing business account on a different phone. To learn more about transferring your phone number on the same phone, read this article.

For businesses using the WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API, usernames can be transferred to another phone number within the same business portfolio. This enables use cases such as migrating from a test phone number to a production number, switching carriers, or consolidating phone numbers. The username itself remains the same during transfer.

Change your business username

  1. Go to the Tools tab and tap Profile.
  2. Tap Username > Change username.
  3. Enter the new username you’d like.
  4. Tap Save.
  5. In the popup notifying you that you changed your username, tap Continue.

Note: There’s a limit to how many times you can change your business username. After you change your username, your previous username may become available for others to claim.

Business broadcasts are especially good for keeping your existing customers engaged with offers, deals and promotions, but you can create and send business broadcasts for other communications: sharing new items, announcements, thanking customers and asking for their feedback.

Click here to get started with business broadcasts.

Creating a business broadcast or starting from an existing one

You can send business broadcasts in an existing thread or tap

[Image: Channels Add (plus sign)]

New business broadcast.

If you’re creating a new business broadcast, you’ll start by selecting your audience. If you’re using an existing broadcast, you’ll already have an audience selected.

Then, edit the draft of the business broadcast. This involves adding media, text, and an optional action button. Preview the message and review payment information (if applicable) before sending or scheduling the business broadcast.

Select audience

On the Recipient screen, you’ll see pre-populated lists with your full contact list from your address book.

  • You can add everyone in from any of these lists with a single tap, or choose individual contacts from any or all of them for your message.
  • When you’re done selecting your recipients, tap Create to draft your message.

Add photos

You can enhance your business broadcast by adding a photo. When creating a business broadcast, tap

[Image: camera (camera)]

to access your camera or choose from your media library >

[Image: Stickers Check Mark (single checkmark)]

.

Add an action button

Your message can contain a button to let customers take certain actions:

  • Catalog: Tapping this takes customers to a selected catalog item or your entire catalog.
  • Custom reply: This allows customers to respond to your message with a single tap that will send you a message you pre-filled.
  • Phone call: This lets customers tap to call you at your business’s phone number.
  • Website: Tapping this takes customers to a website of your choice, such as your business website.

Business broadcast preview

When you’re done creating your draft, tap Next to see how the business broadcast will look to those who will receive it.

Note: Your messages are subject to review by Meta.

To help keep WhatsApp users safe, your business broadcasts are subject to review by Meta before you send them in WhatsApp chats. Meta can’t access your messages once they’re sent in chats on WhatsApp.

Review and send or schedule your business broadcast

Review your business broadcast, its pricing, and the recipients you selected.

If you’re ready, you can send or schedule the business broadcast.

To send your message, tap Send now.

To schedule your message to automatically send at a later time, tap Schedule. On the Schedule screen, select a date and time > tap Schedule.

Note:

  • Push notifications must be turned on to send broadcasts.

  • Your device must be connected to the internet at the time your business broadcast is scheduled to send.

  • If it isn’t connected, the app will attempt to send your business broadcast after one minute, and then every 10 minutes. The app will try to send your message up to 10 times.

Paying for business broadcasts

You can get free messages and other benefits with Meta Verified.

Processing

When you send or schedule your business broadcast, there may be a slight processing delay. This is typically no more than a few seconds, but could be as long as 3 hours.

About sending spam

WhatsApp will be monitoring reports of messages marked as spam. Businesses must provide all necessary data disclosures and notices (such as maintaining a privacy policy or labeling business broadcasts) and secure all necessary rights, consents, and permissions (for example, opt-in) to communicate with their customers via WhatsApp as stated in the WhatsApp Business Terms of Service. Businesses must also honor and comply with all customer requests to stop or opt-out of receiving certain or all types of WhatsApp messages from the business.

Failure to comply with the Meta Terms for Business Broadcasts on the WhatsApp Business App, which incorporate the WhatsApp Business Terms of Service, may result in temporary or permanent suspension of your account’s access to the business broadcast feature. Follow our best practices to create a quality experience and avoid any inconvenience.

Note: Business broadcasts is currently available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet.

  2. Add a payment method > click Save.
  3. Enter the required information, such as your email or business address.

If a business broadcast can’t be delivered, funds will be credited back to your account for future use. Learn more about how payments for business broadcasts work in this article.

The WhatsApp Business app enables you to share a link so customers can connect with you directly.

If your customer has WhatsApp installed on their device, a chat between the two of you automatically opens. From a web browser, your customer will be sent to a web page with your business information and messaging. From there, they can click Continue to chat to open a chat with you.

Note: If you share your profile picture with everyone in your privacy settings, it also appears on the web page. Learn how to change your privacy settings.

Creating a short link

A short link for your business is automatically generated when you create an account on the WhatsApp Business app. To access this short link, tap Short link on the Tools tab. The short link will be displayed under your business name.

Once you’ve accessed your short link, you can:

  • Tap Copy Link if you wish to copy the short link and paste it somewhere else on your website or other Facebook pages.
  • Tap Share Link if you wish to directly send this link over to your customers. Anyone who has access to the link will be able to message you.
  • Create a custom default message that customers can edit and send you when they open the short link.

Note: Pre-populated default messages makes it easier for customers to reach your business with common questions or inquiries.

About creating a business name

Copy link

A business name must be representative of the business or organization.

A business name is different than a business username. Learn more about business usernames in this article.

Rules for creating a business name

To be eligible for an “Official business account”, business names can’t include:

  • All capital letters, except for acronyms. Only the first letter of each word can be capitalized. Conjunctions may not be capitalized. For example:
    • Correct: Sweet Treats or Tammy’s Burritos and Tacos
    • Incorrect: SWEET TREATS* or Tammy’s Burritos And Tacos
  • Any extra spaces between words. Business names must use single spacing.
  • Unnecessary punctuation
  • Emoji
  • Symbols (example: ®)
  • Consecutive non-alphanumeric characters (characters which are neither numbers nor letters)
  • Any of these special characters: ~!@#$%^&*()_+:;“’{}[]|<>,/?

Note: These formatting guidelines do not apply to businesses who already brand this way externally. In that case, the business name used on the WhatsApp Business app may incorporate punctuation, capitalization, etc. that matches the external branding.

Also, business names can’t consist of only:

  • A person’s full name
  • A generic term (example: Fashion)
  • A generic geographic location (example: New York)
  • Three or fewer characters

Finally, business names can’t include any variation of the word “WhatsApp”. Learn more by visiting our Brand Guidelines.

Note: If your business account is listed as an “Official business account”, changing your business name might result in your account losing its “Official business account” status.

How your business name appears in chat

Your WhatsApp Business account type determines the way your customers see your business name in their chat list.

If you have an Official business account, customers will see your business name in their WhatsApp chat list and chat thread, even if they haven’t saved your contact information.

If you have a regular business account, customers will see the name they saved for your contact information. If your phone number isn’t saved in their address book, they’ll only see the phone number you used to register your Business account.

About businesses with the same business name

WhatsApp Business allows multiple business accounts to have the same name, since multiple businesses may have the right to use the same or similar names. However, intellectual property ownership is important to WhatsApp. If you would like to report a claim of third-party copyright, trademark, or other intellectual property infringement, please follow the process outlined in our Intellectual Property Policy.

About creating ads on the WhatsApp Business app

Copy link

From within the WhatsApp Business app, you can create Facebook and Instagram ads that lead to a WhatsApp chat with you.

As a business owner, you can create ads directly from the WhatsApp Business app to promote your business, without having to switch to other apps. While creating the ad, you can select ad media, spend, duration, and target audience. You can also pay for the ad, by choosing to use the same payment method as your Facebook ad account.

If you haven’t linked your Facebook page with your WhatsApp Business account, your ads will only deliver to Facebook. You can deliver ads to Facebook and Instagram once you have linked your Facebook page to your business.

Ads in WhatsApp Status and Channels

The WhatsApp Status and Channels placements are only available in Meta Ads Manager. You can create ads in Meta Ads Manager that use the WhatsApp Status or Channels placements. Ads will only appear in Status and Channels, keeping them separate from personal chats and calls. Customers who interact with your ad are sent directly to a chat with your business.

With Ads Manager reporting, you can review metrics for your ads, such as impressions, clicks, and messaging conversations started.

How to customize how your business appears in chats with customers

Copy link

When someone clicks on an ad you’ve created on Facebook or Instagram, they’ll see a chat on WhatsApp with your business that includes information about your business, such as:

  • Your business name.
  • Your business image.
  • The year you joined WhatsApp Business.
  • Your Facebook and Instagram follower counts, if they’re linked to your WhatsApp Business profile.

To edit some of this information, you can update your business profile.

People will also see any greeting message you’ve set, which may include a link to your catalog.

Find out how to create and edit greeting messages.

What happens when you delete your business username?

  • Customers who previously saw your @username will now see your phone number when you message them.
  • Your username becomes available to others. Once deleted, another business or person may claim it.
  • People will not be able to message you using your username. They will need your phone number to contact you.
  • Your existing chats stay the same. Deleting your username doesn’t affect chat history or contacts.

Delete username

  1. Go to your business profile and tap Username.
  2. Tap Edit.
  3. Tap Delete username > Delete.

Note: Deleting your username is permanent. If you change your mind later, your previous username might not be available.

How to delete your phone number from the WhatsApp Business Platform

Copy link

Note: If you registered for the WhatsApp Business Platform through a Business Solution Provider, reach out to them directly for help.

Numbers registered with the WhatsApp Business Platform cannot also be registered with WhatsApp Messenger or the WhatsApp Business app. Trying to register with WhatsApp Messenger or WhatsApp Business using a number that is already in the WhatsApp Business Platform will lead to the error message “WhatsApp is currently not available. Please try again in 1 hour”.

If you no longer want to use the WhatsApp Business Platform, you can manage your WhatsApp accounts and follow these steps to delete your number:

  1. Find the WhatsApp account tied to the phone number that you want to delete, and select it.
  2. After selecting the account, you should see the People, Settings, and Pages tabs on the right.
  3. Click Settings > WhatsApp Manager.
  4. In WhatsApp Manager, click Phone Numbers.
  5. Find the phone number that you want to delete. Click the Delete icon and follow the steps presented to you in order to delete the phone number.

When you click the Delete icon, you might be asked to provide the password for the Facebook account associated with the account if a phone number was connected at any point.

Note:

  • Only admins of the WhatsApp Business App can delete a number.
  • A number can only be deleted if no paid messages have been sent from the account within the last 30 days.
  • Once you delete your number, all your WhatsApp Business Platform data will be deleted.
  • Phone numbers deleted from a WhatsApp Business Platform account can’t be used again for another WhatsApp Business Platform account.
  • If you have registered for the WhatsApp Business Platform through a Business Solution Provider, reach out to them directly for help.

If you can’t see an option to delete your number or you’re experiencing issues, please contact our support team in Meta Business Suite:

  1. Log into Meta Business Suite.
  2. Click Help > Help.
  3. When the sidebar has loaded, click Contact Support Team.
  4. Provide information for the following fields:
    • Where is the issue occurring?: Select the business account registered to the phone number that you want to delete.
    • What issue are you experiencing?: Select Other Business Manager issue.
    • Get help: Select Chat.
    • Email and Phone Number: Enter your contact information.
    • Message: Enter a description of your request. You can use this sample message:
    • Hi, I would like to delete my phone number from the WhatsApp Business Platform.- Click Start Chat to connect to the Meta support team.

If you encounter the error message “WhatsApp is currently not available. Please try again in 1 hour” when trying to register a new SIM or phone number to WhatsApp Messenger or WhatsApp Business, this means that the number was previously registered in the WhatsApp Business Platform.

To proceed with your registration, you can request to have the number deleted from the WhatsApp Business Platform by providing the necessary documentation and consent for account deletion:

  • Proof of documentation with the date of your purchase of your SIM or number, and/or a copy of your phone bill/contract.
  • Consent to have us delete the phone number from the WhatsApp Business Platform.
  • Acknowledgement that deleting the phone number from the WhatsApp Business Platform will also delete all account data, insights, and message history.

Note: The information in this article is intended for businesses using the WhatsApp Business app. Businesses seeking an enhanced business experience should consider using the WhatsApp Business Platform. To learn more about the different business solutions that WhatsApp offers, view this article.

The WhatsApp Business app is a free-to-download app for small businesses.

Before downloading the app, please be aware of the following:

  • If you have an existing WhatsApp Messenger account, you can easily migrate your account, including chat history and media, to a new WhatsApp Business account.
  • If you decide to stop using the WhatsApp Business app, you can transfer your account and chat history back to WhatsApp Messenger.
  • You can use WhatsApp Business and WhatsApp Messenger simultaneously, but the accounts must be linked to different phone numbers. It’s not possible to have one phone number linked to both apps at the same time.

Get started

  1. Download the WhatsApp Business app from the Apple App Store.
  2. Open the WhatsApp Business app.
  3. Review the WhatsApp Business Terms of Service and, in some regions, the WhatsApp Business App Privacy Policy. To accept, tap Agree and continue.
  4. Verify your phone number.

WhatsApp will search for any backups associated with your phone number. If it finds one, you may be able to restore your chat history.

If you’re new to the WhatsApp Business app or if you’re unable to restore a backup, the WhatsApp Business app will guide you through the process of creating a business profile.

Create a business profile

  1. Enter a business name. Tap Continue.
  2. Select up to three business categories. You can choose from among the suggested categories, or tap + See more categories to explore other options. Tap Continue.
  • Note: It is not possible to create a custom business category.
  1. Add your business hours. Tap Continue.
  2. Add a profile photo. Tap Continue.
  3. Enter a business address and a link to your business’s website to help customers find you. Tap Continue, or tap Skip to do this later.
  4. Enter a business description to tell potential customers about your business. Tap Continue, or tap Skip to do this later.
  5. When you’re finished, tap Continue.

Create a description with the help of Meta AI business assistant

To use Meta AI business assistant to help you refine your description:

  1. Enter a draft of your business description.

  2. Tap

    [Image: AI Sparkle Dust (sparkle dust)]

    Refine with Meta AI.

Meta AI business assistant will generate a list of potential descriptions.

Select your favorite and tap Next, or tap

[Image: Refresh (arrow in the shape of a circle)]

Generate new descriptions to explore other options. You can always edit a description generated by Meta AI business assistant.

Next steps

  • Create a catalog
  • Create an ad
  • Create a marketing message
  • Get verified

We’re currently building and testing out updates to business profiles that may not be available to you yet. In the meantime, we recommend keeping WhatsApp updated on your device so you can get new features as soon as they’re available.

Your WhatsApp Business profile lets you add publicly viewable information about your company. These details include your business name and address, username, category, description, email address, and website.

A complete and accurate business profile not only keeps your customers informed. It can also reduce the amount of communication you receive about things like your business’s hours.

Businesses with active Meta Verified subscriptions can update their business asset’s profile name and picture. Updating your asset’s profile info will require review and approval.

Note: These features may not be available to all regions or businesses. Learn about updating your business name and profile picture for Meta Verified businesses.

View your profile

To view your profile, go to the Tools tab and then tap Profile.

Edit your profile photo

  1. Tap Edit under your profile picture.
  2. If you don’t have a profile photo set, tap Add Photo instead.
  3. Choose an option:
    • Choose photo: Select a photo, crop if needed, then tap Choose.
    • Take photo: Take a new photo, crop if needed, then tap Use Photo.
    • Use avatar: Follow the steps prompted by Create from selfie or Create Manually, then tap Done.
  4. You can also tap Delete Photo > Delete Photo to remove your current profile photo.

Note: Your profile photo is public by default. Learn how to change your privacy settings in this article.

Edit your cover photo

  1. Tap Camera

    [Image: Camera Cover Photo (camera within a circle)]

    to the right of your cover photo.

  2. Tap Choose Photo to choose an existing photo or Take Photo to take a new photo.

    • You can also tap Delete photo > Delete photo to remove your current cover photo.

  3. Once you’ve selected a photo or taken a new one, crop the photo as needed.

  4. Tap Choose if you chose an existing photo or Use Photo if you took a new photo.

Note: Your cover photo is public by default.

Edit your business name and description

  1. Tap on the field you’d like to update.
  2. Make your changes.
  3. Tap Save.

You can also create a business username to help customers find your business. Usernames are optional. Learn more about creating and editing your business username in this article.

Edit your phone number

Read this article to learn how to edit your phone number.

Edit your business hours

  1. Tap the Business hours field.
  2. Select one of the following schedule templates:
    • Open for selected hours: Tap a day to customize your business hours for that day.
    • Always open: Use the toggle to select which days of the week your business is open.
    • By appointment only: Use the toggle to select which days of the week your business is open for appointments.
  3. Tap Save.

You can also tap Clear to reset your business hours.

Edit your business address

  1. Tap the Address field.
  2. Choose from these options:
    • Search for your address: Start typing your business address. Select your address from the suggestions that appear. Your address and map location will be set automatically. Tap Save.
    • Enter your address manually: Type your full business address. Tap Save.
  3. Tap More options:
    • Location Notes: Add location notes to help customers find you, then tap Save.
    • Service area: Select a Service area to let customers know how far you can travel. Add an optional note, then tap Save.
    • Set location on map. Toggle on to drag the map and move the pin to your business’s exact location. Tap Done > Save.
      • Note: This only changes the location of your business on the map. The address you’ve entered in the address field will stay the same.

To remove your address, tap Delete address.

Edit your email and website

  1. Tap the field you’d like to edit.
  2. Update your information.
  3. Tap Save.

Edit your catalog

  1. Tap Manage to update your catalog or create a new one.
  2. Add or edit items in your catalog as needed. Learn more about how to create and maintain a catalog in this article.

Edit your linked social media accounts

If you have no linked accounts:

  1. Tap Facebook or Instagram > Connect WhatsApp > Continue > Done .
  2. Log into your Facebook or Instagram account to add it to your business profile.

If you already have linked accounts:

  1. Tap Facebook or Instagram to manage your linked account.
  2. You can hide a linked account from your profile by turning off Show on profile.
    • Alternatively, you can unlink it from your business profile by tapping Remove WhatsApp.

Edit your business category

  1. Tap the Categories field.
  2. Select up to three relevant categories for your business.
  3. Tap Save.

Note: Unfortunately, it’s not possible to create a custom category. If the category you want to use is not available, try using a more generic category, or use the Other Business category.

Edit your About information

  1. Tap the About field.
  2. You can tap the field under Currently set to to create a custom About message. Then, tap Save.
    • Alternatively, you can select one of the presets in the Select your About section.

How to engage with customers using the WhatsApp Business directory

Copy link

The WhatsApp Business directory gives users the ability to search for businesses without leaving WhatsApp. It’s a valuable tool for expanding your business and connecting with new customers.

The WhatsApp Business directory is currently only available in Brazil and may not be available in your area yet.

Best practices to help grow your business on the Whatsapp Business directory

We recommend these best practices to help manage an increase of customer questions:

  • Your business profile is central to your business’s presence on WhatsApp. It should contain all the information customers want to know about your business. Keep your business profile updated and add a profile picture to attract potential customers, as well as show them that your business is trustworthy.
  • Use quick replies or filter by list to manage or organize incoming messages.
  • Create a catalog to showcase your products and services.
  • If you have a physical storefront, print out a QR code, and place it in your window. This gives people an easy way to find your business on WhatsApp both online and offline.
  • Follow these account security tips to make sure your account is secure.

How to get started on the WhatsApp Business Platform

Copy link

Before you can start engaging with customers on the WhatsApp Business Platform, you must first create a WhatsApp Business account.

To get started on the WhatsApp Business Platform (API):

  • If you’re a developer for your company, create an account through WhatsApp Developer Documentation.
  • If you’re a Business Solution Provider (BSP), create an account in the Meta Business Manager.
  • If you’re working with a BSP to integrate with WhatsApp, create an account via the embedded signup flow.

Explore our help content library to find answers and troubleshoot issues.

About group chats with multiple representatives of a business

Copy link

In order to provide you with a better customer experience, some businesses on WhatsApp may invite you to a group chat that includes one or more of their representatives.

Businesses can add you to a group by sending you an invite link. To join a business’s group, select Join group > Join group. To leave the group, select Exit group. Select Safety tools to review your privacy and safety details while messaging with businesses. Joining a business’s group is entirely optional, and you can leave at any time.

Group chats with businesses resemble normal group chats in most respects, but if a business is using an authorized third-party provider to help them manage WhatsApp, you may notice some differences:

  • Certain features, including calling, video calling, live location sharing, message editing, and view-once messages, may not be available to you or the business in group chats.
  • You may not be able to invite a business to other existing groups.
  • Group members may not be able to become admins.

Businesses will not be able to add you to a group chat if your personal, group privacy settings prevent them from doing so. To learn how to change your group privacy settings, view this article.

You can upload spreadsheets on the WhatsApp Business app web to quickly add multiple contacts at once. The uploaded contacts will appear in your Broadcast audience, allowing you to send business broadcast messages to many customers directly from your business account. This feature is only available on the WhatsApp Business app web.

Formatting your spreadsheet

Your spreadsheet should include the following prior to uploading:

  • CSV or XLSX format
  • Structure file with the following 2 columns: contact’s full name and phone number

Uploading your spreadsheet

  1. On your computer, open the WhatsApp Business app web and log in.
  2. Click> Tools.
  3. Click Broadcast audience.
  4. Select save the CSV template to use the template and manually input your contacts or click Upload file and select a CSV or XLSX file with your list of contacts. Make sure your uploaded file follows the structure defined by the CSV template.
  5. Review your import list. Once the entries are successfully imported without errors, name your audience.
  6. Click Save audience to save the contacts to your phone. You can now send business broadcasts to this audience from your phone.

Troubleshooting errors

If your upload contains more than 20 errors, you’ll receive a prompt to review your file before proceeding. Duplicate entries are also flagged as errors. You can remove errors in bulk by clicking Delete all errors. To resolve errors individually, either clickto delete the entry or clickto edit the phone number. Click Update to save your changes.

If any errors are found in the uploaded contacts during processing, they’ll be displayed at the top of the audience list. You’ll need to correct or remove these errors before you can save the audience and sync it with your phone.

About interactions with business chats that include offers and announcements

Copy link

Messages that include offers and announcements can provide you with valuable information from businesses you choose to talk to on WhatsApp such as coupons, information about new products, back-in-stock alerts, or reminders about upcoming sales or events.

WhatsApp requires businesses to secure your permission to send offers and announcements and WhatsApp takes action to prevent you from receiving too many of these messages.

Note: Businesses may choose to share your activity information with Meta to send you relevant messages and improve Meta ads. See Meta’s Privacy Policy for how Meta uses this data.

How WhatsApp limits bad experiences and business message overload

  1. In order to limit bad experiences (like spam) and manage the number of offers and announcements you might receive, WhatsApp collects limited information about your chats. This includes:
  • The number of chats you have per day and week.
  • When you last received an offer or announcement from a business, and how often you receive them in comparison to your other chats.
  • Interactions with businesses or business threads (like feedback you submit).
  1. As always, your personal messages are end-to-end encrypted. No one outside the chat, not even WhatsApp, can read, listen to, or share them.

Your privacy is our priority

  • This icon

    [Image: Single Chevron (right chevron within circle)]

    means WhatsApp’s parent company, Meta, may receive limited info to reduce spam, help businesses send you relevant messages and improve Meta ads. You can tap on this icon

    [Image: Single Chevron (right chevron within circle)]

    to learn more or decide to stop chatting before any information is shared.

  • The content of your messages and calls isn’t shared by WhatsApp. Neither is your name or phone number. Learn more about the privacy and security of messages with businesses here.

  • Meta may receive limited information like:

    • Feedback you submit about a business.
    • Browser interactions from links shared by businesses in WhatsApp, like how long the browser was open.

  • If you choose to add your WhatsApp to a Meta Account, Meta may also receive information such as:

  • The number of chats you have per day and week.

  • When you last received an offer or announcement from a business, and how often you receive them in comparison to your other chats.

  • You are in control of the conversation. You can stop chatting with the business or block them at any time. Learn about controls you have when messaging businesses.

Issues using catalog

Copy link

If you’re having trouble with your catalog, here are some common issues and how to fix them:

Catalog items not displaying or disappeared

If you see “Items can’t be displayed” or “Check your device internet connection and try again later”, this is a known temporary issue. You can try:

  1. Check your internet connection and try again.
  2. Update to the latest version of WhatsApp Business.
  3. Close and reopen the app.

Note: Your catalog items aren’t deleted. They’re still saved and will reappear once the issue is resolved.

Can’t add, save, or delete catalog items

If you see errors like “Your catalog couldn’t be created”, “Item couldn’t be saved”, “Product couldn’t be deleted”, or “Collection not deleted”, try these steps:

  1. Wait a few minutes and try again.
  2. Make changes one item at a time instead of bulk edits.
  3. Check your internet connection.
  4. Close and reopen the app.

Note: If deleting a collection, try removing all items from it first, then delete the empty collection.

Changes not saving

If you see “Changes not saved”, “Something went wrong”, or the page keeps loading when you try to save:

  1. Save after each individual change instead of making many edits at once.
  2. Reduce image file sizes if uploading photos.
  3. Clear the app cache in your phone settings.

Can’t reorder items

If you see “Something went wrong” when trying to reorder your catalog or collection, this is a known temporary issue. Your catalog order isn’t lost. It remains as it was before you tried to reorder and will work normally once the issue is resolved.

Catalog item rejected

If you are unable to add, upload, or save an item to your catalog, it may be because the item you attempted to add has been rejected.

If an item you are trying to add has been rejected, a red exclamation icon will appear.

Catalog items are rejected for a variety of reasons. Tap Learn more to review our Commerce Policy to see if your item does not comply.

If you think your item was wrongly rejected, you can appeal the decision:

  1. Tap the rejected item.
  2. Tap Request another review.
  3. Enter your reason for the request.
  4. Tap Continue.

Can’t add advertisements to catalog

The catalog on WhatsApp Business is designed for listing your products and services, not for placing or displaying advertisements.

What you can add to a WhatsApp Business catalog:

  • Product name
  • Product images
  • Description
  • Price
  • Product code/link

If you want to advertise your catalog or products, you can:

  • Share products or services from your catalog directly in WhatsApp chats with customers
  • Create ads on WhatsApp Business to run “Click to WhatsApp” ads on Facebook and Instagram that open a chat with your business
  • Share your catalog link externally so customers can browse your products outside of WhatsApp

Link a device using phone number

  3. If prompted, confirm your identity using biometric authentication or the PIN you use to unlock your phone.

Alternatively, you can:

  • Android: Tap

Copy link

There is a known issue for some linked devices not displaying up to one year of chat history. We’re working to fix this as soon as possible. In the meantime, you can still see your chat history on your primary device. We encourage you to keep WhatsApp updated on your linked device. Updates are released regularly and may contain fixes for bugs and other issues.

Use WhatsApp Business on Web, Desktop, and other devices by linking them to your phone. You can use up to four linked devices and one phone at a time.

Linking multiple devices to your business account enables more employees to respond to customer messages from anywhere especially during ad campaigns or promotions.

Keep your account safer

  • Check your linked devices regularly.- For iPhone: Tap WhatsApp Settings or your profile picture. Tap Linked devices to review all devices linked to your account. To log out of a linked device, tap the device > Log out > Log out.

      [Image: More (three vertical dots)]

We’ve provided a couple different options for managing the accounts across Meta’s family of apps that you want to connect to your Meta Verified or Meta One account.

Manage requests from WhatsApp Business app accounts associated with your business account

Businesses with admin accounts on Facebook or Instagram can revoke your request at any time. Businesses with accounts only on WhatsApp can revoke the request within 12 days of submission.

If your request is revoked, you’ll receive a notification and your subscription will be canceled.

About Protected business accounts

If your business has multiple accounts on WhatsApp, we recommend subscribing to a Meta Verified or Meta One subscription plan that includes the protected business accounts benefit.

The Protected business accounts premium benefit allows business subscribers to identify associated WhatsApp accounts. This feature is exclusive to certain subscription tiers, enabling businesses to manage their online presence more effectively.

The number of Protected business accounts you can have depends upon your subscription plans:

Meta Verified

  • Business Premium: Up to 10 Protected business accounts
  • Business Max: Up to 50 Protected business accounts

Meta One

  • Expert: Up to 10 Protected business accounts
  • Max: Up to 50 Protected business accounts

To subscribe to Meta Verified for businesses on WhatsApp with multiple accounts, start by purchasing a subscription. Then, add the associated accounts to the Protected business accounts list in your primary account on the WhatsApp Business app.

Note:

  • Not all subscription plans include this benefit.
  • Protected accounts can still be banned for violating WhatsApp Business Terms of Service.

Add Protected business accounts

  1. Using your primary WhatsApp Business app account, go to:

    • Meta Verified: WhatsApp Business Tools > Meta Verified.
    • Meta One: WhatsApp Settings > Subscriptions > Meta One.

  2. Tap Protected business accounts.

  3. Tap Select business account. This will generate a list of your business contacts that aren’t already on your Protected business accounts list.

  4. From the list, select the accounts you’d like to add as Protected business accounts. Tap

    [Image: Search (magnifying glass)]

    to search for a specific account.

    • Note: If you try to add an account that you’ve blocked as a protected business account, you will have to unblock the account first. If prompted, tap Unblock.

  5. Once you’ve selected the accounts you’d like to add as Protected business accounts, tap Done. This will return you to the Protected business accounts list, which should now include the accounts you selected. Note: You can add or remove Protected business accounts at any time.

Note: Not all subscription plans include this benefit.

Additionally, while a Protected business account is associated with a verified business account, that account will not receive its own verified badge. To receive a verified badge, the account must also be subscribed to Meta Verified or have completed the verification process with Meta One.

Learn more about subscription plans for “Meta Verified and Meta One for businesses on WhatsApp.

Remove Protected business accounts

  1. Using your primary WhatsApp Business app account, go to:

    • Meta Verified: WhatsApp Business Tools > Meta Verified.
    • Meta One: WhatsApp Settings > Subscriptions > Meta One.

  2. Tap Protected business accounts.

  3. Swipe left on the account you’d like to remove. Tap Remove. If you’d like to remove multiple accounts at once, tap Edit and tap the

    [Image: Delete Message (trash can)]

    for the accounts you’d like to remove. Then, tap Done.
