Edit your ad

You can edit ads while they’re running. For example, to extend your budget and duration.

To edit an ad that’s running:

  1. Tap Tools > Manage ads.

  2. Tap your ad.

  3. Tap

    [Image: Draw (pencil)]

    next to Budget and duration to edit budget and duration.

  4. Tap

    [Image: Draw (pencil)]

    next to Audience to edit your audience.

  5. Make your edits and tap Save.

Note: Some ad elements, like media, may not be editable after the ad is published. If you need to make significant changes, consider recreating the ad and updating the desired fields.

Manage your ad account

To change the email address associated with your ad account:

  1. Tap Tools > Manage ads.

  2. Tap

    [Image: More Options (three vertical dots)]

    Ad account settings >

    [Image: Draw (pencil)]

    .

  3. Enter your new email address > tap Save.

  4. You’ll receive a six-digit code at this email address. Enter this code.

Repeated ads

You can’t schedule an ad to run, or promote the same ad automatically at the moment.

But, after an ad has stopped running, you can run the same ad again. To do this:

  1. Tap Tools > Manage ads.
  2. Tap an ad you’ve run before that has ended.
  3. Tap Recreate ad.

Delete your ad

To delete an ad that’s in review, not delivering, or rejected:

  1. Tap Tools > Manage ads.

  2. Tap the ad you want to delete >

    [Image: More Options (three vertical dots)]

    Delete ad.

Note:

  • Ads that are running can’t be deleted.
  • Deleting an ad doesn’t remove the costs you’ve already incurred. You’ll still be charged for any costs incurred before deletion.

Pause and resume your ad

If you want to stop running an approved ad, you can pause it. To pause an ad that’s running:

  1. Tap Tools > Manage ads.

  2. Tap the ad you want to pause >

    [Image: More Options (three vertical dots)]

    Pause ad.

To resume an ad:

  1. Tap Tools > Manage ads.

  2. Tap the ad you want to resume >

    [Image: More Options (three vertical dots)]

    Resume ad.

See your ad’s performance

To see how your ads are performing, tap Tools > Manage ads.

If you tap See details next to Performance overview, you can see:

  • Your ads’ reach
  • How much you spent on those ads
  • How many conversations your ads started
  • Cost per conversion

Rejected ad or ad account

Learn more about rejected ads and ad accounts.

Ad not delivering

If your ad isn’t delivering, the most common causes are:

Account spending limit reached

An account spending limit is a cap on the total amount your ad account can spend across all ads. It’s different from your available balance, which is the prepaid funds you’ve added to your account. Even if you have funds available, your ads will stop delivering once your total ad spend reaches the account spending limit.

To check if your account spending limit has been reached:

  1. Tap Tools > Manage ads.

  2. Tap

    [Image: More Options (three vertical dots)]

    Ad account settings.

  3. Tap Ad payments.

  4. Tap Account spending limit > Set limit. You’ll see how much you’ve spent so far and what your limit is set to.

If you’ve reached your account spending limit, your ads won’t run again until you increase your limit.

Payment issues

Failed payments or unsettled balances will stop ad delivery immediately. Check your payment method in Ad account settings > Ad payments to make sure your payment information is up to date and that your payment method has sufficient funds available.

Ad not showing on Instagram

If you selected Instagram as a placement but your ad is only showing on Facebook, here’s why this might happen:

  • Automatic optimization: When you select multiple placements, the ad delivery system automatically shows your ad on the platform where it’s likely to perform best based on your audience and budget.
  • Regional availability: Instagram ad placement may not be available in all regions yet.
  • Content compatibility: Some ad formats or content types may not be supported on Instagram placements.

This is expected behavior and means your ad is being shown where it can reach the most people in your target audience.

About mandatory disclosures to be made by Businesses in India

Copy link

Businesses on WhatsApp are responsible for making all the disclosures required under applicable law, including disclosures required for goods or services on WhatsApp. Businesses must ensure that all the information and images provided in relation to your listings are accurate and correspond with the appearance and other features of the goods or services contained in the listing. Businesses must also update their business profile and listings as changes occur to such information.

About message packs for business broadcasts

Copy link

Note: This feature is rolling out gradually and may not be available to you yet.

Message packs let you pre-pay for a set number of messages you can use when sending business broadcasts. When you send a broadcast, one credit is used for each recipient who receives your message.

Message pack credits don’t expire, so you can use them at your own pace.

Learn more about business broadcasts.

Purchase message packs

You can find and buy message packs from several places in WhatsApp.

From broadcast home

  1. Tap Tools.
  2. Tap Business broadcasts > Message credits.
  3. Tap Message packs and select the pack you’d like to purchase.
  4. Tap Buy and follow the payment process to complete your purchase.

From the broadcast review screen

  1. When reviewing your broadcast before sending, tap Add to view available message packs.
  2. Tap Message packs and select the pack you’d like to purchase
  3. Tap Buy and follow the payment process to complete your purchase.

View your message credit balance

To check how many credits you have remaining:

  1. Tap Tools
  2. Tap Business broadcasts.
  3. Your current balance will show in the Message credits section.

Use your message pack credits

When you send a business broadcast, your message pack credits are automatically applied. One credit is consumed for each recipient who receives your message.

For example, if you send a broadcast to 50 recipients and all 50 receive the message, 50 credits are used from your balance. If you don’t have enough credits to cover all recipients, you can buy an additional message pack before sending.

Find pricing for message packs

For the most up-to-date pricing, go to Tools > Business broadcasts > Message credits. The pricing for each pack is included in the pack description.

Notes:

  • Message packs are currently only available on iOS devices.
  • Business broadcasts and message packs can’t be refunded, subject to applicable law.
  • You can’t resell message packs.
  • WhatsApp reserves the right to not offer message packs to certain users.

About messaging businesses that use multiple WhatsApp Business products

Copy link

Businesses on WhatsApp may use multiple business messaging tools to chat with their customers. They may chat with customers using the WhatsApp Business app, or they may choose to use WhatsApp’s parent company, Meta, to securely store messages and respond to customers on its behalf.

Some businesses may choose to use these tools at the same time.

When you chat with a business that chooses to use these tools at the same time, chats between only you and the business are managed by a secure service from Meta. This will also include a limited portion of your chat history that the business provides. Other communications sent via the WhatsApp Business app, including group chats and status updates, remain end-to-end encrypted.

When you edit or delete a message in a chat with a business that uses multiple WhatsApp Business products, the business may still be able to see the original message on one of their platforms.

If a business chooses to use both of these tools at the same time, we’ll make it clear to you when they are using WhatsApp’s parent company, Meta, to securely store messages and respond to you.

You’re in control

WhatsApp wants to make sure you know what’s happening with your messages. If you don’t want to receive messages from a person or business, you can always:

  • Block them directly from the chat
  • Delete them from your contact list

We want to make sure you understand how your messages are being handled. We also want to ensure you have the options you need to make the right decisions for you.

About Meta AI business assistant

Copy link

Note:

  • This feature is currently only available in select languages and in limited countries. It might not be available to you yet.
  • This article contains information about using Meta AI business assistant on the WhatsApp Business app. For information about using Meta AI business assistant in Meta Ads Manager or Business Support Home, view this article.

Meta AI business assistant is an optional service from Meta that businesses using the WhatsApp Business app can use to accomplish business-related tasks.

Using Meta AI business assistant, businesses can:

  • Get help writing better product descriptions
  • Learn new skills to grow your business
  • Generate images and content for your catalog
  • Learn how to set up a marketing campaign
  • Suggest improvements to your business profile

How to use Meta AI business assistant

  1. Open the WhatsApp Business app.

  2. From the Chats tab, tap

    [Image: Meta AI (multicolored oval ring)]

    .

  3. Tap one of the suggested prompts, or send one of your own.

You can also ask Meta AI business assistant a question using the WhatsApp Business app search bar.

Once you start a chat with Meta AI business assistant, that chat will be included under the name Business assistant along with your other chats on the Chats tab. You can view past messages with Meta AI business assistant or send a new one by opening this chat.

When you choose to use Meta AI business assistant, Meta receives your prompts, AI messages, feedback, and information about your business, such as your business profile, to deliver relevant responses directly to you and to improve the quality of AI at Meta.

Note:

  • Messages from Meta AI business assistant are generated by artificial intelligence (AI), using a service from Meta, in response to the prompts you send to it. To learn how Meta uses information for generative AI models, view this article. To learn more about AI chats and privacy on WhatsApp, view this article.
  • You have the option to delete individual chats with AIs or request the deletion of information you previously shared with Meta AI. Learn more in this article.
  • Meta uses AI chats consistent with Meta’s Privacy Policy. By using this feature, you agree to the Meta Business Agents and Platform Terms of Service.
  • Some messages generated by Meta AI business assistant may not be accurate or appropriate.

About Meta Business Agent behaviors in chats

On iPhone

Note:

How Meta Business Agent behaves in a chat in which it is present can vary. Depending on the settings you selected during onboarding, Meta Business Agent may default to either responding to customer questions or learning from your responses to customer questions in a given chat.

How to tell if Meta Business Agent is present in a chat

If Meta Business Agent is present in a chat, regardless of whether it is actively responding to customer questions or simply learning from your responses to customer questions, that chat will feature the

[Image: AI Sparkle (sparkle dust)]

icon, both within the chat itself and on the Chats tab.

If a chat does not feature the

[Image: AI Sparkle (sparkle dust)]

icon, this means that Meta Business Agent is not present in that chat. It can neither respond to customer questions nor learn from your responses to customer questions.

How to respond manually when Meta Business Agent is actively responding

If Meta Business Agent is actively responding to customer questions in a chat and you would prefer to respond manually:

  1. Open the chat in which you would prefer to respond manually.

  2. Tap

    [Image: Respond Manually (hand)]

    Respond manually.

How to unmute Meta Business Agent when Meta Business Agent is in learning mode

If Meta Business Agent is in learning mode in a chat and you would like it to begin responding to customer questions on your behalf:

  1. Open the chat in which you would like to unmute Meta Business Agent.

  2. Tap

    [Image: AI Replies (sparkle dust within circle)]

    .

How to unmute Meta Business Agent when Meta Business Agent detects a question that it can answer

If Meta Business Agent is in learning mode and detects that a customer has asked a question that it is able to answer, the

[Image: AI Replies (sparkle dust within circle)]

icon will expand to read See AI reply. Tap See AI reply to view the response that Meta Business Agent has generated. If you are satisfied with Meta Business Agent’s response, tap Turn on AI replies to unmute Meta Business Agent and have it send the message.

On iPhone

If you want to switch from the WhatsApp Business app to WhatsApp Messenger (regular WhatsApp), you can move your account information by following these steps. Before migrating from WhatsApp Business to WhatsApp Messenger, you need to back up your account information to iCloud.

You can learn how to create a backup in this article.

Note: This migration process doesn’t transfer data created by features unique to WhatsApp Business, such as your catalog and collections.

To move your account information from WhatsApp Business to WhatsApp Messenger:

  1. Update WhatsApp Business and download WhatsApp Messenger from the App Store.
  2. Open WhatsApp Messenger.
  3. Read and agree to the WhatsApp Messenger Terms of Service.
  4. WhatsApp Messenger automatically identifies the number you used in WhatsApp Business.
  • To continue, tap the option with your existing phone number, then tap Continue.
  • If you don’t want to use the existing number, tap Use a different number, then follow the >verification process.
  • Note: If you wish to use both apps, WhatsApp Business and WhatsApp Messenger must be linked to their own unique phone numbers.
  1. WhatsApp will send you an SMS with a 6-digit code. Enter the 6-digit code to verify your number.
  • Note: Skip this step if your iCloud Keychain is enabled and you’ve previously verified the number on the same phone.
  1. Create your WhatsApp Messenger profile, then tap Done.

Before you move from WhatsApp Messenger to the WhatsApp Business app, we recommend creating a backup of your account. Learn how to create a backup in this article.

Businesses can make a bigger impact on their sales and growth by switching to the WhatsApp Business app. The WhatsApp Business app offers a variety of free features for connecting with customers and selling products and services.

  1. Update WhatsApp Messenger and download the WhatsApp Business app from the Apple App Store.
  2. Open the WhatsApp Business app.
  3. Read the WhatsApp Business app Terms of Service and, in some regions, the WhatsApp Business App Privacy Policy. Tap Agree & continue to accept the terms.
  4. The WhatsApp Business app automatically identifies the number you’re using in WhatsApp Messenger. To continue, tap the option with your business number.
    • If the number that appears is not the number you’d like to use, tap Use a different number, then follow the normal verification process.
  5. WhatsApp will send you an SMS with a six-digit code. Enter the six-digit code to verify your number. You won’t have to complete this step if your iCloud Keychain is enabled and you’ve verified this number on the same phone before.
  6. Tap Continue > Continue, or Continue > Don’t Allow, to allow or deny WhatsApp Business access to your device’s address book.
    • Note: WhatsApp contacts are not yet supported on WhatsApp Business app, so any WhatsApp contacts created will be lost by moving to the WhatsApp Business app. In WhatsApp Messenger, you can turn off WhatsApp contacts inside your settings and choose the option to save all contacts to your phone’s address book so you don’t lose them when you move to the WhatsApp Business app.
  7. Create your business profile, then tap Next.
    • You can continue editing your business profile once your WhatsApp Business account is active.

About moving between WhatsApp Messenger and the WhatsApp Business app

Copy link

WhatsApp Messenger and the WhatsApp Business app are two different apps. You can’t use the same phone number with each app simultaneously, but it is possible to move between them.

Moving your account information from WhatsApp Messenger to the WhatsApp Business app is simple and easy. Learn how to move from WhatsApp Messenger to the WhatsApp Business app in this article.

It’s also possible to move from the WhatsApp Business app to WhatsApp Messenger. Learn how to move from the WhatsApp Business app to WhatsApp Messenger here.

Note: While it’s possible to move some of your account information from the WhatsApp Business app to WhatsApp Messenger, WhatsApp Business app features will not move to WhatsApp Messenger. This means that account information associated with features unique to the WhatsApp Business app, like catalog items and collections, cannot be transferred.

About opting in to receive messages from a business on WhatsApp

Copy link

When you sign up through a business ad or website to receive messages on WhatsApp, you’re giving that business permission to contact you.

What happens when you sign up

When you tap Sign up or similar buttons to connect with a business on WhatsApp:

  • You agree to share your phone number with that business.
  • The business can send you messages, including marketing and promotional content.
  • Your WhatsApp number becomes visible to that business.

What you can expect

After signing up, the business can send you marketing messages on WhatsApp, which may include:

  • Welcome messages
  • Promotional offers and updates
  • Product updates and announcements
  • Personalized recommendations

How to stop receiving messages

You can stop messages from a business at any time:

  1. Open the chat with the business.
  2. Tap the business name at the top.
  3. Tap Block.

Alternatively, you can report and block by tapping and holding a message, then selecting Report.

Your privacy

  • Businesses cannot see your profile photo, status, or last seen unless you’ve adjusted your privacy settings.
  • Blocking a business removes your number from their contact list.

Learn more about privacy settings on WhatsApp.

If you no longer want to use Meta Business Agent, you can pause or delete it.

Pause Meta Business Agent

  1. Tap Tools > Your AI agent > AI replies.
  2. Under Chats, select Pause for new chats but learning.

This will stop Meta Business Agent from responding to customers in subsequent new chats.

Responding manually to a customer in a chat will pause Meta Business Agent for that chat until you unmute it.

Delete Meta Business Agent

  1. Tap Tools > Your AI agent.
  2. Tap AI replies > Disconnect AI > Disconnect and delete my AI.
  3. Fill out a brief survey about your experience with Meta Business Agent.
  4. Tap Submit.

Note: If you delete Meta Business Agent and decide to turn it on in the future, you will need to go through the set-up process again.

When you are visiting a business’s catalog, you can use the Message Business button to start a conversation, or use the Add to Cart button to begin the order process.

Add products to cart

  1. Go to your chat with a business or their business profile.

  2. Tap

    [Image: Shopping Button (storefront)]

    next to the business name to access their catalog.

  3. Browse through the products.

  4. Tap

    [Image: Add Item (plus sign)]

    next to an item to add the item to your cart. You can also tap an item to open the product detail page. Tap Add to Cart.

  • Tap

    [Image: Add Item (plus sign)]

    or

    [Image: Remove Item (blurred horizontal streak)]

    to adjust the quantity of that item in your cart.

You can also tap Message Business to ask about the product. To ask about multiple items, add all of them to your cart and send your inquiry in a single message. An order isn’t final until confirmed by the seller.

Edit your cart

  1. Tap the View Cart or

    [Image: Open Cart (shopping cart)]

    from the Catalog menu or in your message with the business to see the products added to your cart.

  2. Tap Add more to navigate back to the catalog to add more products.

  3. Tap

    [Image: Add Item (plus sign)]

    or

    [Image: Remove Item (blurred horizontal streak)]

    to adjust the quantity of specific items in your cart.

Place an order

  1. Once you’ve updated your cart, tap Place Order button to send your cart to the seller.
  • Note: If you cannot send your cart to the seller, contact the business for assistance.
  1. Once sent, you can see your order details by tapping the View Cart button in your chat window with the seller.

You can send Business broadcasts for a fee.

You only pay for each message that is delivered to a contact within five days of being sent. The balance for each delivered message is accumulated. After the balance exceeds a set amount or you reach your billing date, you’ll be charged for the outstanding balance.

You can also pay for business broadcasts through prepaid funds. You must have enough funds in your account to cover the cost of the business broadcast. Funds will be deducted daily as messages are delivered. Your payment method is charged for the total number of recipients you choose, and the funds are credited back to your account for any receivers to whom your broadcast couldn’t be delivered.

Pricing for business broadcasts is based on the country code of each message recipient. We use rate cards for the following specified currencies listed below. Business broadcasts is available in additional currencies through a USD-based exchange rate conversion:

On iPhone

Copy link

Your customers can easily discover and contact your business using your WhatsApp QR code.

It can be printed and displayed prominently at your place of business. You can also download a WhatsApp QR code sticker template to frame your code.

QR codes are great tools for connecting with new customers and driving sales for your business. Share them digitally on your website or social media pages, or print it out and post it around your community.

Print your WhatsApp QR code

  1. Tap

    [Image: Shopping Button (storefront)]

    Short Link > QR Code.

  2. Save a photo of your QR code. You can do this in two ways:

    • Take a screenshot of the QR code.
    • Tap Share Code > Save Image to save the image to your device.

  3. Open your Photos app, and open the image of your QR code.

  4. Crop the image so that only your QR code is displayed.

  5. Print your Whatsapp QR code.

Note: To use the WhatsApp QR code sticker template:

  • The dimensions of your printed QR code must be 8cm x 8cm (302x302px).

Privacy and security for business messages

Copy link

Business Messaging

Every WhatsApp message is protected by the same Signal encryption protocol that secures messages before they leave your device. When you message a WhatsApp business account, your message is delivered securely to the destination chosen by the business.

WhatsApp considers chats with businesses that use the WhatsApp Business app or manage and store customer messages themselves to be end-to-end encrypted by default. Once the message is received, it will be subject to the business’s own privacy practices. The business may designate employees or other vendors to process and respond to messages, and it may also use the chats it receives for its own marketing purposes, including advertising on Meta.

However, some businesses can choose optional services to interact with customers.

  • For example, some can choose WhatsApp’s parent company, Meta to securely store messages and respond to customers. Meta will not automatically use the messages you send a business to inform the ads you see.
  • In addition, some can choose to have AI from Meta to assist them in responding to messages sent from customers. Meta will receive these chats to improve its AI quality and generate message responses.
  • Some can also choose to use multiple business messaging tools to chat with their customers.

When businesses use these optional services, we display this clearly in the chat and do not consider messages with these businesses to be end-to-end encrypted. The encryption status of an end-to-end encrypted chat can’t change without being visible to the user. For more information about which chats are end-to-end encrypted, please read our Encryption Overview.

Note:

  • There are optional services that a business or you can choose to use where Meta receives limited information. For example, you can choose to start a chat with a business after interacting with their ad on Facebook and Instagram or interact with offers and announcements a business may send you on WhatsApp. We include the

    [Image: single chevron (right chevron within circle)]

    icon for these services, which you’ll be able to tap to learn more about how this works. To learn more about interactions with business chats that include offers and announcements, read this article.

You’re in control

WhatsApp wants to make sure you know what’s happening with your messages. If you don’t want to receive messages from a person or business, you can always:

  • Block them directly from the chat
  • Delete them from your contact list We want to make sure you understand how your messages are being handled. We also want to ensure you have the options you need to make the right decisions for you.

About providing customers with Order Details or Order Summaries

Copy link

The Order Detail/Order Summary feature helps businesses provide an order summary to customers. Businesses are responsible for providing mandatory, correct, and truthful information and/or images in the Order Detail/Order Summary which includes:

  • user details
  • business details
  • description of goods or service purchased by the user
  • date of purchase of goods or services
  • price per item
  • total price and payment details

The Order Detail/Order Summary feature is not a substitute for invoices, cash memo, bill, receipt, etc., businesses must issue under law for goods/services. Businesses are solely responsible for issuing an invoice or such other statutory document as required under applicable laws.

About QR code for WhatsApp Business

Copy link

WhatsApp Business QR codes are an easy way for customers to discover and reach out to your business. Existing and new customers can send you messages through the WhatsApp Business app by scanning your business account’s QR code. How to register for the WhatsApp Business app

Copy link

Requirements

  • You can only register a mobile phone or a landline (fixed) number that you own.
  • You must be able to receive phone calls or SMS with the phone number you’re trying to register.
  • Make sure you’re using a supported phone number. Unsupported phone numbers can’t be registered on WhatsApp and include:- VoIP
    • Toll-free numbers
    • Paid premium numbers
    • Universal access numbers (UAN)
    • Personal numbers
  • You must have all call-blocking settings, apps, and task-killers disabled.
  • If you’re registering through your mobile phone, you must have a working internet connection through mobile data or Wi-Fi. If you’re roaming or have a bad connection, registration may not work. Try opening Business (whatsapp.com) on your mobile phone’s internet browser to see if you’re connected to the internet.
  • If you’re registering through a landline, tap Call me to request a phone call to receive your registration code.

How to register

  1. Enter your phone number:

    • Choose your country from the drop-down list. This will automatically fill in your country code in the box on the left.
    • Enter your phone number in the box on the right. Don’t put a 0 before your phone number.

  2. Tap Done to receive a registration code. If prompted, you can also tap Call me to receive the code through a phone call.

  3. Enter the 6-digit registration code you receive via SMS or phone call.

    • Note: If you have iCloud Keychain enabled and have registered this number before, you may be automatically registered without receiving a new SMS code.

Using extension numbers for landline

Landline extension numbers can’t be used to complete the registration process. Please use a landline number without an extension to register your phone number. For security purposes, we can only send the six-digit registration code to the landline number that you intend to use for your business account.

If you don’t receive the six-digit code through SMS

  • Wait for the progress bar to finish and retry. The wait time may take up to 10 minutes.

  • Don’t guess the code or you’ll be locked out for a period of time.

  • If the timer runs out before you receive the registration code, an option will appear to request a phone call. Choose the Call me option to request the call. When you answer the call, an automated voice will tell you the six-digit registration code. Enter this code into the WhatsApp Business app.

    • Note: Depending on your carrier, you may receive charges for SMS and phone calls.

Remember: Never share your 6-digit registration code with anyone.

Troubleshooting steps

If you’re having issues registering, try the following:

  1. Turn your phone off, wait 30 seconds, and turn it back on.
  2. Uninstall and reinstall the latest version of WhatsApp Business.
  • To uninstall, tap and hold the WhatsApp Business icon and select Uninstall or Remove App.
  • To reinstall, download the latest version of WhatsApp Business.

  1. Check your reception by sending a test SMS message from any mobile phone to the mobile phone number you’re trying to register. Enter the mobile phone number exactly as you entered it in the WhatsApp Business app, including the country code.

    • Note: We can’t send your registration code through other methods due to security reasons.

How to reserve and manage usernames on WhatsApp Business Platform

Copy link

Usernames on WhatsApp Business is rolling out gradually over the next few months and might not be available to you yet. In the meantime, you can reserve your business username. We recommend keeping WhatsApp Business updated on your device so you can get the latest feature updates. To learn more about reserving your username, read this article.

Usernames on WhatsApp Business are an optional feature that lets you create a unique identifier for your business (for example, @YourBusinessName) to help customers easily find and recognize your business. Customers can use your username to start a chat with your business more easily without needing your phone number.

Your username is different from your display name:

  • Your display name doesn’t have to be unique.
  • Your username must be unique.

Both your username and phone number will be visible on your business profile.

Before you get started

  • Usernames are unique to a phone number If your business has multiple phone numbers, you can use the same display name across all numbers, but you need to create a different username for each phone number.
  • WhatsApp automatically reserves some usernames to help the right businesses claim them.
  • WhatsApp Business Platform businesses can manage usernames in WhatsApp Manager or Meta Business Suite. Changes you make in one place will appear in the other.

Why reserve a business username?

In places where usernames are not yet available, you can reserve a username now to use on WhatsApp at a later date. When you reserve a username, it’s held for your business account and other accounts won’t be able to claim it.

You will be notified in WhatsApp when your reserved username is ready to use. Reserving a business username can help you:

  • Build brand recognition with a memorable @username.
  • Use a consistent identity across Meta. In most cases, you may be able to claim the same username you use on Facebook or Instagram.
  • Protect your preferred name early. While we reserve some usernames to help businesses claim them, most usernames are first-come, first-served.

Reserve a business username

Reserve a username in WhatsApp Manager

  1. Open WhatsApp Manager.
  2. Click Phone number in the left menu, then click your phone number.
  3. Click Profile, then scroll to Username.
  4. Click Create, then enter the username you want.
    • You can also choose a username from Suggested.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Close.

Note: If you want to create a username that matches your existing Instagram or Facebook account and don’t see it as a suggestion, you’ll need to link those accounts to WhatsApp. You can link your phone number when claiming the username in Meta Business Suite or WhatsApp Manager, or by accessing your Facebook Page or Instagram account and adding your phone number directly⁠.

To link your phone number, you must have full control of the page or account, or basic partial access with the manage_phone permission. See About business portfolio and business asset permissions⁠ for information about control/access and permissions.

Reserve a username in Meta Business Suite

  1. Go to Meta Business Suite.

  2. Click WhatsApp Accounts in the left menu.

  3. Click the phone number you want to create a username for.

  4. Click Phone numbers, then click the

    [Image: Edit (pencil)]

    .

  5. Scroll to Username, then click Create.

  6. Enter the username you want.

    • You can also choose a username from Suggested.

  7. Click Save.

  8. Click Close.

When you reserve a business username, it becomes active when the feature launches in your region. You’ll get a notification when your username is ready to use.

Change your business username

You can change your business username at any time. After you change it, your previous username is held for 60 days. During this time, you can claim it again. No one else can claim it during the 60-day hold.

Change a username in WhatsApp Manager

  1. Open WhatsApp Manager.
  2. Click Phone number in the left menu, then click your phone number.
  3. Click Profile, then scroll to Username.
  4. Click Edit, then enter your new username.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Close.

Change a username in Meta Business Suite

  1. Go to Meta Business Suite.

  2. Click WhatsApp Accounts in the left menu.

  3. Click the phone number you want to change the username for.

  4. Click Phone numbers, then click the

    [Image: Edit (pencil)]

    .

  5. Enter your new username.

  6. Click Save.

  7. Click Close.

Delete your business username

You can delete your business username at any time. After you delete it, your username is held for 60 days in case you want to reclaim it.

Delete a username in WhatsApp Manager

  1. Open WhatsApp Manager.
  2. Click Phone number in the left menu, then click your phone number.
  3. Click Profile, then scroll to Username.
  4. Click Edit.
  5. Click Delete > Delete.

Delete a username in Meta Business Suite

  1. Go to Meta Business Suite.

  2. Click WhatsApp Accounts in the left menu.

  3. Click the phone number you want to delete the username for.

  4. Click Phone numbers, then click the

    [Image: Edit (pencil)]

    .

  5. Click Delete > Delete.

How to select a location when looking for businesses

Copy link

Note: The WhatsApp Business directory is currently only available on Android in Brazil. Over time, we’ll expand the availability of this feature to regions outside of Brazil.

When searching the WhatsApp Business Directory in WhatsApp Messenger, you can share your current location.

  • Share your current location. The location data remains stored on your phone, and will only refresh if you share your location again. WhatsApp cannot see your location, nor can businesses in the directory. Business results are ranked by distance and other signals, and you can erase your stored location from your phone at any time. Learn more about sharing your device’s location in this article.

Change your location

WhatsApp will default to the location selected when you last searched for businesses. You can always clear that location and set a new one.

  1. Open WhatsApp and tap

    [Image: New Chat (speech bubble with plus sign within square)]

    Businesses.

  3. Select While using the app or Only this time.

Stop sharing your location

You are in control of whether you’d like to share your location and you can stop sharing your location at any time.

To stop sharing your location on WhatsApp

  1. Open Settings on your mobile device.
  2. Tap Location > App location permissions > WhatsApp.
  3. Select Don’t allow.

About location privacy

Before WhatsApp uses your location data to help you find nearby businesses, your location is converted into an imprecise location so WhatsApp does not know exactly where you are. The broad search results are then sent back to your phone and ranked by distance to the exact location, as well as other signals. This way, WhatsApp servers never see your specific whereabouts.

Note:

  • WhatsApp uses Google as a third party service provider and therefore the location data will be shared with Google.
  • When you start a chat with a business you found through the Discover businesses, the business will get a notification from WhatsApp telling them that you found them using Discover businesses. Your location stays private and is not seen by the business or WhatsApp.

How to set up Meta Business Agent

On iPhone

Note:

  • This feature is currently only available in limited countries to select businesses. It might not be available to you yet. If you are unable to turn on Meta Business Agent using the steps in this article, you can add yourself to the waitlist here.
  • At this time, not all languages are supported. The language that Meta Business Agent uses is determined by your business’s phone number.

Meta Business Agent is an artificial intelligence (AI) service from Meta for businesses. Businesses on WhatsApp can use Meta Business Agent to enhance parts of their conversations with customers who choose to use AI from Meta.

To set up Meta Business Agent on the WhatsApp Business app:

  1. From the Tools tab, tap AI agent.
  2. Tap Continue.
  3. Tap Accept.
  4. You may be prompted to authenticate using your fingerprint or facial recognition. Once you have done so, tap Confirm.

Note: If your business has AI agent responses automatically enabled through Meta Ads Manager, you may be prompted to authenticate or to finish setting up your AI agent on the WhatsApp Business app.

Before Meta Business Agent can begin responding to customers on your behalf, it will need to learn about your business.

  1. Under Use past chats to show your AI how you answer questions, tap either:

  • Use past chats: Teach Meta Business Agent how to respond to customers using your chats from the past six months.

  • Ignore past chats: Do not use past chats to teach Meta Business Agent.

  • Note: When Meta Business Agent doesn’t have enough information to begin responding to customers, it will go into learning mode. In learning mode, it collects data from new chats to learn how to respond to customers. This means it may take longer before Meta Business Agent can begin responding on your behalf.

  1. Under Choose a catalog, tap:
  • WhatsApp catalog: Train Meta Business Agent using the products in your WhatsApp Business catalog.
  • Catalog from Commerce Manager: Train Meta Business Agent using the products in your Commerce Manager catalog. If you select this option, you will be required to confirm the Facebook account associated with your Meta business portfolio.
  1. Under Add documents or photos, tap Add, then tap Choose from files or Choose photo or video to upload documents (such as documents containing information about your products) or photos (such as photos displaying a list of prices for your products) from your device, or tap Scan document to scan a document using your device’s camera. You can upload multiple files at a time.
  2. Under Add a website, add a link to your business website, if you have one.
  3. Tap Done.
  • Note: Meta Business Agent may take several minutes to become active in chats.

After setting up Meta Business Agent, take some time to teach Meta Business Agent about your business.

You can control when and where you want Meta Business Agent to reply to customers. From the Tools tab, tap Your AI agent, then tap AI replies. Choose from the following options:

  • All new 1-1 chats: Meta Business Agent will respond in all new chats between your business and one other person.
  • 1-1 chats except with contacts: Meta Business Agent will respond in all chats between your business and one other person unless that person is a contact.
  • 1-1 chats from ads: Meta Business Agent will respond in all chats created when a customer engages with one of your business’s Facebook or Instagram ads.
  • Paused for new chats but learning: Meta Business Agent will be paused from automatically responding to new chats. While paused, it will continue to collect data from new chats to learn how to respond to customers.

Turn on Meta Business Agent in individual chats

To turn on Meta Business Agent in individual chats, open the desired chat, then tap

[Image: AI Replies (sparkle dust within circle)]

in the bottom right corner of the screen.

Alternatively:

  1. Open the desired chat.
  2. Tap the customer’s name.
  3. Tap AI replies.
  4. Tap Turn on.

If Meta Business Agent has been paused, you can turn it back on in an individual chat by tapping

[Image: AI Replies (sparkle dust within circle)]

.

Note:

  • AI responses may not be available in certain situations, including if your contact is a business that has also turned on Meta Business Agent.
  • If you turn on Meta Business Agent in a chat where you’re in the middle of a conversation with that customer, Meta Business Agent will not respond to that customer’s messages unless the chat has been inactive for seven days. To override this, tap Restart AI replies in this chat.

About shopping on WhatsApp

Copy link

Note: We’re currently experiencing a problem with the Share business option missing from business profiles when using a linked device. We’re working on fixing it at the moment. In the meantime, you can still share a business by tapping

[Image: Forward (right arrow with curved tail)]

in the business profile or by using your primary device.

Shopping on WhatsApp is quick and easy for businesses and their customers.

Note: Some of these features may not be available to you yet.

Discover businesses

There are a couple different ways that customers can connect with businesses on WhatsApp.

  • Business profile: A business’s WhatsApp business profile includes important business information like their address, category, description, social media accounts, email, and website. To view a business’s profile, open a chat with the business and tap their business name at the top of the chat. You can easily share business profiles with your friends and family. From the business profile, tap Share

    [Image: Forward (right arrow with curved tail)]

    and select which contacts to share it with.

  • WhatsApp QR codes for businesses: To connect with a business on WhatsApp, scan their WhatsApp QR code. The WhatsApp camera can only scan official WhatsApp QR codes. Learn more about scanning a business’ QR code on Android or iPhone.

Explore products and services

Businesses on WhatsApp can create a catalog to showcase their products and services to help customers find what they’re looking for.

  • WhatsApp catalog: Every catalog item has a unique title and optional fields like price, description, website link and product code. Learn more about viewing a business’s catalog.
  • Shopping while chatting with a business: Some businesses choose to share lists containing a selection of items when chatting with customers. These lists help customers find the products and services they’re looking for more easily. Learn more about shopping using conversational commerce.

Note: Adding prices to a catalog is only available in certain countries.

Place an order

  • Cart: As customers browse a business’ products and services, they can add items to a cart. Once they add items to their cart, they can send the cart to their chat with the business and discuss payment options. Learn more about placing an order using cart on Android or iPhone.

About Shops integration with the WhatsApp Business app

Copy link

WhatsApp is determined to provide business users with commerce tools that help them grow their businesses. Over the years, we’ve learned that businesses need focused solutions to help them showcase their goods and services.

Business users are no longer able to display their Shops storefront on the WhatsApp Business app. Moving forward, the catalog tool on the WhatsApp Business app will be our default commerce tool. This change will not impact your Shops storefront on Facebook or Instagram. You have the option to drive people interested in your Facebook shop to connect with you on WhatsApp.

Setting up a catalog

To make this transition as seamless as possible, we recommend setting up a catalog.

Users who had a catalog before integrating with Shops storefront

Setting your Shops storefront visibility to Hidden returns your WhatsApp catalog to when you began using the Shops storefront integration. Any items added to your storefront after turning on the integration won’t be migrated to the WhatsApp Business app. Learn how to change your Shops settings in this article.

Note: Setting your Shops storefront visibility to Hidden is non-reversible. Once you’ve hidden your storefront, none of your storefront items will be available in WhatsApp.

Users who didn’t have a catalog before integrating with Shops storefront

Your storefront won’t be migrated to the WhatsApp Business app if you didn’t have a catalog before Shops storefront integration. To continue showcasing your products and services on WhatsApp, we recommend creating a catalog on WhatsApp. Learn how to create and maintain a catalog in this article.

Help Meta Business Agent learn more about your business

Update business information in Meta Business Agent home

Meta Business Agent responds to customer messages based on its knowledge of your business.

To add to Meta Business Agent’s knowledge of your business:

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Your AI agent.
  • Tap Share business info to teach Meta Business Agent about your business.
  • Tap Recommend bestsellers to teach Meta Business Agent about your bestselling products.
  • Tap Share purchasing info to teach Meta Business Agent how customers can purchase your products.
  • Tap Respond to customer questions > Add another example response to demonstrate the kind of response that Meta Business Agent should give to certain customer questions.

  1. Tap

    [Image: Plus (plus sign)]

    , then:

  • Tap Add documents, Add images, or Take photo to upload documents or images from your device.

Alternatively:

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Your AI agent.
  2. Tap Knowledge.
  • By Example responses, tap Add to add an example response to demonstrate the kind of response that Meta Business Agent should give to certain customer questions. You can also include important business information in the responses, such as shipping information or business hours.
  • By Files and links, tap Add to add documents, images and photos to teach AI about your products, prices, policies, or other topics.

To update something that Meta Business Agent already knows about your business:

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Your AI agent.
  2. Tap Knowledge.
  3. If you have more than three example responses, tap See all to view a list of things that Meta Business Agent knows.
  4. Identify the knowledge response that you want to update, then:
  • Tap the response to open and edit the response.
  • Swipe left, then tap Delete to remove the information from Meta Business Agent’s knowledge.

To remove a document or image from Meta Business Agent’s knowledge repository:

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Your AI agent.
  2. Tap Knowledge.
  3. Under Files and links, tap See all to view a list of documents and images that you have used to teach Meta Business Agent.
  4. Swipe left on the document or image you want to delete, then tap Delete.

Respond manually to customer messages

When you message a customer manually in a chat in which Meta Business Agent is replying, Meta Business Agent may save messages that contain new information about your business. It will use this information to better respond to similar customer messages in the future.

When Meta Business Agent saves a message, you can view or edit what Meta Business Agent learned from the chat thread. Tap Review AI knowledge and then tap see all knowledge. To remove the saved message from Meta Business Agent’s memory, locate the saved message, swipe left, then tap Delete.

Alternatively, to review new AI knowledge:

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Your AI agent.
  2. Tap Knowledge.
  3. Tap the example response to edit it. Tap Save.

To delete, tap the example response to open it. Swipe left, then tap Delete to remove the information from the AI’s knowledge.

Interact with Meta Business Agent in chat

Meta Business Agent may occasionally send you messages asking for more information about your business. While you cannot respond to these messages as you normally would, you can help Meta Business Agent learn more about your business by performing its recommended actions.

For example, Meta Business Agent may ask you:

  • To review or add knowledge that it should know
  • To review a list of things that it has learned
  • To provide it with information about specific aspects of your business like your return policy or business website
  • To choose chats in which to turn on Meta Business Agent

Ask for customer info with Meta Business Agent

You can have Meta Business Agent ask your customers for additional information to help:

  • Get the information to qualify them as a prospective customer for your business
  • Learn more about them and their needs
  • Get the information you need to process their request

To have Meta Business Agent request customer information:

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Your AI agent.
  2. Tap Ask for customer info.
  3. Choose when your AI agent should ask for customer info and tap Next.
  4. Select which info you want to collect. Then tap Save.

You can add multiple moments to ask for customer information and specify what kind of information should be requested. When a customer replies, you will be notified that the chat needs your attention.

Teach Meta Business Agent how to respond to customer messages

Once AI replies have been turned on, you can teach Meta Business Agent using actual customer interactions.

  1. Open a chat that contains the AI-generated message you want to improve.
  2. Tap and hold the AI-generated message.
  3. Tap Teach your AI.
  4. Enter the message that Meta Business Agent should base future responses on.
  5. Tap AI feedback.

You can teach your AI using messages that are from the past six months.

Meta Business Agent will generate responses to similar customer messages in the future based on this information. It will not respond using your exact words. Existing responses will not be updated.

Note: You can view or edit a list of all the things that Meta Business Agent has learned about your business, either from its interactions with you or from studying your interactions with customers. From the Home tab, tap Tools > Your AI agent, then tap Knowledge.

About the official WhatsApp Business account

Copy link

The WhatsApp Business app has an official chat account, where you can hear directly from us. We’ll use this conversation to share news, tips, and information that will help you make the most of the WhatsApp Business app.

Note:

  • It’s not possible to make calls or send messages to WhatsApp in this chat.
  • This feature may not be available in your area yet.

How to identify the official WhatsApp account

The WhatsApp Business app has one official account.

  • The official WhatsApp Business chat is marked with the verified badge

    [Image: Meta Verified Badge (sticker with a checkmark)]

    and has the description “Official WhatsApp Business account”.

  • If you receive a chat from the WhatsApp Business official chat you’ll see this system message: “This is an official WhatsApp Business account. Tap to learn more.”

  • You don’t have the ability to message this chat and won’t be asked to share any personal information.

If you receive a message from an account without the verified badge

[Image: Meta Verified Badge (sticker with a checkmark)]

claiming to be WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business, it’s a scam. You should never reply to anyone pretending to be WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business. Please report and block the number.

Choose to not receive communcation about new features and tips

You have control over the communication you receive from the WhatsApp Business account about new features, tips, and information to help you make the most out of our services. If you’d prefer not to hear from WhatsApp this way, you can either archive or block this chat to stop receiving these types of messages at any time. You always have the option to unblock the chat to receive messages again in the future. In some rare cases, we might still send you messages about important and timely information related to your account, even if you block the chat.

Learn how to block and report contacts in this article.

If you have additional questions and would like to contact us on WhatsApp Business, please go to Settings > tap or click Help > Contact Us.

About the WhatsApp Business directory

Copy link

The WhatsApp Business directory is a fast, safe, and convenient way for people to find businesses. The directory helps you reach new and existing customers and share your business information through your business profile.

Your business profile helps you establish your business presence on WhatsApp. Use your business profile to tell prospective customers about your business and what you offer.

To benefit fully from the WhatsApp Business directory, complete your business profile thoroughly and update it regularly. The more information you add, the easier it will be for customers to find and contact you. A complete and accurate business profile helps establish trust with your customers.

To help you grow your business on Whatsapp, make sure you include the following information in your business profile:

  • Your business name

  • Your business profile photo with your business logo

  • A description of your business in the bio

  • Your business address

  • Your business location on a map or service radius

  • Note: A service radius shows customers the geographic area a business serves

  • Your business categories

  • Catalog items

  • Your business hours

  • Your business’ Facebook page or Instagram Business profile to your WhatsApp Business account.

  • Note: The last few posts from your linked Facebook page and Instagram Business profile will show in your business profile. This feature may not be available in your area yet.

Note: To help build trust with customers, the month and year you joined WhatsApp Business is displayed on your profile. This information is not affected if you change the phone number for your WhatsApp Business account.

For more information about how to apply to the WhatsApp Business directory, read this article.

See more businesses like this is a directory feature allowing customers to discover businesses similar to yours while on your business profile. Customers may also select this feature while viewing other profiles, thereby increasing the visibility of your business.

The WhatsApp Business directory is currently only available in Brazil and may not be available in your area yet. Businesses that apply must meet certain requirements to be included in the Business directory. Learn more about these requirements in this article.

Troubleshoot business username issues

Copy link

Usernames on WhatsApp Business is rolling out gradually over the next few months and might not be available to you yet. In the meantime, you can reserve your business username. We recommend keeping WhatsApp Business updated on your device so you can get the latest feature updates. To learn more about reserving your username, read this article.

If you’re having trouble creating or reserving a username on WhatsApp Business, here are some common issues and how to resolve them.

I don’t see the option to create or reserve a username

If you don’t see the username option in your settings:

  • Update WhatsApp Business to the latest version available.
  • Check availability in your region. Usernames are rolling out gradually and may not yet be available where you are.
  • Restart WhatsApp Business after updating to make sure the latest features are loaded.

The username option appears in your profile when available.

“This username is not available”

This message can appear for several reasons:

  • The username is held because it exists on Instagram or Facebook: If the username you want is already in use on Instagram or Facebook, it is held for the owner of that account. If you are the owner of that Instagram or Facebook account, you can claim it on WhatsApp by adding your WhatsApp account to the same Accounts Center to claim the name you use on Facebook or Instagram. There’s a limited time to do this before it becomes available to others. Learn how to reserve and manage a username.
  • The process was interrupted: If you started the reservation process but it was interrupted (for example, by a network issue), your username may appear temporarily unavailable. It should become available after a few minutes or by restarting the app.

“Username is taken”

Usernames are reserved on a first-come basis. If you see “Username is taken”, it means someone else has already claimed it and you’ll need to choose a different one. You can try a variation of your preferred username by adding numbers, underscores or other words (for example, @janedoe_london or @janedoe1). You can also generate suggestions by tapping Suggest a username.

“Try again later”

If you’ve made several attempts to create a username in a short time, you may be temporarily limited from trying again. Wait a few minutes before your next attempt.

Issues claiming the same username as Instagram or Facebook

If you’re trying to claim your Instagram or Facebook username and encounter issues, check Accounts Center. To claim the same username as your profile on one of these apps, it needs to be added to the same Accounts Center as your WhatsApp account.

If you haven’t linked your accounts yet, go to Tools > Facebook and Instagram in WhatsApp Business to connect your Facebook Page or Instagram Business profile. Learn how to link your accounts.

If you recently linked your accounts try restarting the app to refresh the connection.

Customers can’t find your business username

Customers need to enter your exact username (including the @) directly in WhatsApp to find you as there’s no searchable directory. If customers can’t find your business username:

  • Make sure your username is active, not just reserved. Reserved usernames aren’t visible or searchable until they become active. You’ll be notified in WhatsApp when your username is ready to use.
  • Check for typos. Usernames are case-sensitive to formatting and customers must enter the exact spelling, including any numbers, underscores, or periods.
  • Share your username proactively. Since there’s no directory, customers need to know your exact username.
  • Link your WhatsApp Business with Facebook and Instagram to give customers another way to reach you via the WhatsApp contact button on your profiles.

Issues with QR code

If you’re having issues with your business username QR code:

  • QR code not working after changing your username. If you recently changed your username, your old QR code will no longer work. You’ll need to share your updated QR code, which automatically reflects your new username.
  • Customers can’t scan your QR code. Make sure the QR code image is clear, not cropped, and large enough to scan. If sharing digitally, avoid heavy compression.
  • QR code only works when your username is active. If your username is still reserved (not yet active), the QR code won’t direct customers to a conversation with your business.

Learn more about QR codes for WhatsApp Business.

Accidentally deleted your username

Deleting your username is permanent. If you change your mind later, your previous username might not be available. Your username becomes available to others. Once deleted, another business or person may claim it.

Unpacking WhatsApp’s privacy label in the Apple App Store

Copy link

Apple recently required that all apps distributed via their App Store display details designed to show people how their data may be used. We support transparency, which is why we already provide a way for people to download information associated with their account. We go to great lengths to build WhatsApp in a way that protects the privacy of our users and make them aware of this at the start of every conversation.

We deployed end-to-end encryption throughout our app in 2016, meaning that calls, messages, photos, videos, and voice notes to friends and family are only shared with the intended recipient; no one else (not even us) can read them. With end-to-end encryption, messages are not stored on our servers after they’re delivered, and in the normal course of operating our services we do not retain a record of the people you may message.

We must collect some information to provide a reliable global communications service. As a matter of principle, we minimize the categories of data that we collect. For the limited kinds of data we do collect, we take measures to restrict access to that information. For example, while you may grant us access to your contacts to help deliver the messages you send, we do not share contact lists with anyone, including Facebook for its own use. We provide further explanations throughout our Help Center, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Service.

Below we unpack the WhatsApp label displayed in Apple’s App Store and provide additional information about data use that is not protected by end-to-end encryption. It’s important to understand that several of the items below only apply to optional features that people can elect to use; we do not automatically collect all of the items below. Many of these optional features, such as shopping and payments, are unique to WhatsApp and not offered by other end-to-end encryption messaging providers.

Contact information

When you sign up for WhatsApp, we receive your phone number and rely on it to deliver messages to your device. If you want to enable two-step verification, you can choose to share your email address with WhatsApp, though it is not required. You can also choose to email WhatsApp for support as well.

Identifiers

We associate your phone number as your WhatsApp user ID and are aware of the IP address from which your phone connects to WhatsApp.

Coarse location

While we do not ever see your precise location, we are aware of your IP address and country code from your phone number.

Contacts

To make it easier for you to message your friends and family, when you sign up for WhatsApp we ask for access to your phone numbers to see which of those numbers are verified in our system. If you choose to do so, the app displays the names you choose from your address book and we do not share any of this information with Facebook. Learn more here.

Usage data

To operate a reliable global service, we must understand whether features are performant, though we are testing a way to do this in a de-identified fashion. To prevent abuse we take action against accounts engaged in bulk or automated messaging, which has been particularly important during elections where certain groups may attempt to send messages at scale. We also sponsor marketing campaigns, including using Apple’s ad network, to reach people who do not currently use WhatsApp. We also communicate to users inside the app about new product features, and updates and to provide user education.

Diagnostics

Should you encounter an issue using WhatsApp we receive crash logs so we can fix bugs and improve our service.

Additional options we provide:

Financial information

In countries where you can send payments via WhatsApp, your card or bank information is needed to complete a transaction.

Purchases

If you choose to use Facebook Shops on WhatsApp, we are able to understand your shopping activity, such as the products you view and purchase, and we share this information with Facebook since Shops is a Facebook product. This means that product browsing and purchasing experience within Shops may influence what you see in Shops on other Facebook products. Before using Facebook Shops on WhatsApp, we inform you of this and ask for your agreement.

User content

We receive your “about” information as well as profile photo, group names, group profile photo and group descriptions. We rely on this information to prevent abuse, including banning accounts that are sharing child exploitative imagery. Additionally, if you choose to report an issue to WhatsApp, we receive what you have chosen to send us.

How to use broadcast lists on the WhatsApp Business app

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

More

Android

iOS

Broadcast lists are saved lists of contacts that allow you to message many of your customers at once. This message will be sent to all customers on the list, as long as they have your number saved in their phones’ address book. If any of your customers reply to your message, their reply will appear as a normal message in your Chats screen. It won’t be sent to other customers on your broadcast list.

Create a broadcast list

  1. Tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Broadcast Lists > New List.
  2. Search for or select the contacts you want to add.
  3. Tap the contact’s name > Create.

Note: Only contacts who’ve added your number to their phone’s address book will receive your broadcast message. If your contact isn’t receiving your broadcast messages, check to make sure they’ve added you to their address book. Broadcast lists are a one-to-many communication. If you want your recipients to participate in a group conversation, you’ll need to create a group chat instead.

Edit a broadcast list

  1. Tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Broadcast Lists.
  2. Tap the “i” icon next to the list you want to edit.
  3. In the List Info screen, you can:
  • Change the name of your broadcast list by tapping the existing broadcast list name or List name. Enter the new name of your broadcast list.
  • Add or remove recipients from the list by tapping Edit list… Tap the “x” in the contact’s profile picture to remove them > Done.

Delete a broadcast list

  1. Tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Broadcast Lists.
  2. Swipe left on the broadcast list you want to delete.
  3. Tap Delete.

  3. Select the quick reply. The message will appear in the text input field.

  4. Edit the message, or tap

    [Image: Send (paper airplane within circle)]

    .

Business Tip: Complete each section in your business profile to generate default replies that you can use to inform customers about your address, hours, and more.

Delete quick replies

You can delete quick replies and they will no longer automatically send to customers.

To delete a quick reply:

  2. Tap the quick reply you wish to delete.
  3. Tap Delete > Delete.

Note: You cannot recover a deleted quick reply. Keep a copy of your most important quick replies saved outside WhatsApp so you can quickly recreate them if needed.

Usernames on WhatsApp Business is rolling out gradually over the next few months and might not be available to you yet. In the meantime, you can reserve your business username. We recommend keeping WhatsApp Business updated on your device so you can get the latest feature updates.

In places where business usernames are not yet available, you can reserve a username now to use on WhatsApp Business at a later date. When you reserve a business username, it will be held for you and others will not be able to claim it. You’ll be notified in WhatsApp when your reserved username is ready to use. Reserving a username is completely optional.

Learn more about how to create and manage your username.

What is a username?

Usernames on WhatsApp Business are an optional feature that lets you create a unique identifier for your business (for example, @YourBusinessName) to help customers easily find and recognize your business. Customers can use your username to start a chat with your business more easily without needing your phone number. Your business phone number will still be visible on your business profile. Your business username is different from your Business name (the name that appears in your Business profile).

What does it mean to reserve a username?

  • Reserving a username lets you secure the username you want now, even if usernames aren’t active in your area yet. When you reserve a username, it’s held for your business account and other accounts won’t be able to claim it.
  • No one can see your reserved username, and customers can’t message you by it until your username becomes active.

Why reserve a business username?

  • Reserving your username may enable you to create a consistent identity across Meta. You may be able to claim the same username you use on Instagram or Facebook but there’s a limited time to do so. Learn how to link your accounts and claim your username.
  • You can get your preferred name by reserving it early. Usernames are first-come, first-served — reserving early secures your brand name. Note: Certain usernames are held for known brands, governments, public figures and can’t be claimed by others.

Link your accounts for a consistent username across Meta

If you’d like to use the same username you have on Instagram or Facebook, you’ll first need to link your WhatsApp Business account with your Facebook Page or Instagram Business profile. This lets you claim your existing username on WhatsApp and maintain a consistent brand identity across Meta apps.

To link your accounts, go to Tools > Facebook and Instagram in the WhatsApp Business app and follow the prompts. Learn how to link your WhatsApp Business with Facebook and Instagram.

Reserve your business username

  1. Go to your Business profile.
  2. Tap Reserve username > Reserve username.
  3. Enter the username you’d like to reserve and tap Done.

Usernames are unique and generally available on a first-come, first-served basis on WhatsApp. Some usernames may be held and won’t be available to claim.

For Meta Verified businesses with a custom web page address, your Business username will automatically match your web page address. Your username is already reserved and you don’t need to take any action.

Notes:

  • Must be between 3 and 35 characters long
  • Can contain lowercase letters (a to z), numbers (0 to 9), underscores (_), and periods (.)
  • Can’t only contain numbers
  • Must be unique
  • Can’t contain restricted words or phrases
  • If you see this error message: “This username is not available”, the username might be taken
  • No one can see your reserved username until it becomes active. Once active, customers who don’t have your business phone number saved will see your username instead. Customers who already have your number will continue to see it as before.

Who can see my reserved business username?

No one will be able to see your reserved business username until your username becomes active. Once your username becomes active you will be notified in WhatsApp, and customers who don’t have your number saved will see your username instead.

Can customers contact me by my reserved business username?

No one will be able to contact you by your reserved business username until your username becomes active. Once your username becomes active, you can share your username when you want to give someone a way to contact your business on WhatsApp without having to share your phone number.

How will I know when my reserved business username is active?

You will receive a notification in WhatsApp Business when your business username is active. You will be able to share your business username instead of your phone number to connect with new customers.

Can I change or delete my reserved username?

Reserving a business username is completely optional. You can change your reserved username or delete it at any time. If you change or delete your reserved username, it may become available for others to claim.

Can someone take my username?

Usernames are unique to each account. When you reserve a business username, it will be held for you and others won’t be able to claim it. If the username you want is already taken, you’ll need to choose a different one. If your preferred username matches your Instagram or Facebook handle, there’s a limited time to claim it on WhatsApp.
