WhatsApp voice messaging allows you to instantly communicate with contacts and groups. You can use it to deliver important and time-sensitive information. All voice messages are downloaded automatically.

You can also record, preview, and re-record voice status updates before sharing them with selected contacts. Your recipients can listen to your status and view an active visualization of it while the audio plays.

Send a voice message

  1. Open the chat you’d like to send a voice message to.

  2. Press and hold

    [Image: Microphone (microphone)]

    next to the text field, then start speaking. Note: If the beginning of your message isn’t recorded, you might need to wait a second before speaking.

  3. When you’ve finished, remove your finger from

    [Image: Microphone (microphone)]

    to automatically send your message. Or, if you’re recording hands-free, tap

    [Image: Pause (two parallel vertical lines within circle)]

    to pause recording and preview a draft of your message before sending. Tap

    [Image: Resume (microphone)]

    to continue recording.

  4. Tap

    [Image: Send (paper airplane within circle)]

    to send the message.

Note:

  • While recording you can slide

    [Image: Slide to cancel (left chevron)]

    to cancel and delete your voice message.

  • If the beginning of your message isn’t recorded, you might need to wait a second before speaking.

  • If you try to send a voice message and the recording disappears before you can send it, try restarting your phone.

Screen sharing allows people to share what’s on their screen in real time. You must be in a video call to share your screen.

Share your screen during a video call

  1. Tap

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots)]

    in the video controls and then tap Share screen. Your phone will show a prompt indicating that you’re about to begin recording with WhatsApp.

  2. Tap Start Broadcast to begin screen sharing.

  3. To stop sharing your screen, tap Stop Sharing.

Note:

  • During a screen sharing session, the video feeds of call members appear below shared content.
  • If a user isn’t saved in your contacts, we’ll remind you to only share your screen with people you trust. This reminder only shows in individual chats. The information displayed on your shared screen, including usernames and passwords, are visible to the person you’re sharing with.
  • Screen sharing isn’t available during audio calls.
  • Screen sharing is protected with end-to-end encryption and is never recorded by WhatsApp. No one outside of the call, not even WhatsApp, can see or hear what you share on your screen.
  • For the best experience, update to the latest operating system and the latest version of WhatsApp. If members aren’t using the latest version, a prompt will appear to update WhatsApp before screen sharing.

How to turn broadcast lists into marketing messages

Copy link

Marketing messages is now business broadcasts in some countries. Business broadcasts might not be available to you yet. If you’re seeing business broadcasts, please refer to this article.

[Embedded video omitted]

0:00 / 1:27

Broadcast list messages can only reach customers that have your business’s number in their contact list. To reach customers who don’t have your business’s number in their contact list, you can turn your broadcast message into a marketing message.

To turn a broadcast list message into a marketing message:

  1. Open your most recent broadcast group.
  2. Tap marketing message on the banner at the top of the group. A marketing message draft of the broadcast message will open.
  3. Tap Edit to make any edits to the marketing message. You can also add an actionable button to the draft that your customers can tap.
  4. Tap Next to review the marketing message.
  5. Tap Send now to send the marketing message or Schedule to send the message later.

Note: The marketing message audience is automatically set to the customers who haven’t received a broadcast message.

Voice message transcripts are text versions of voice messages. The voice message transcript feature must be enabled on your device to use it. Once enabled, the message recipient can see voice message transcripts. The sender can’t see the transcripts.

Voice message transcripts are generated on your device, and your personal voice messages remain protected by end-to-end encryption. No one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp, can listen to your voice messages, see the content of your voice message transcripts, or share them.

Supported languages

Languages currently supported depend on your OS.

iOS 16+ languages

Only English, Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish and are supported.

iOS 17+ languages

Only English, Arabic, Chinese, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Hebrew, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, and Turkish are supported.

Turn voice message transcripts on or off

  1. Tap WhatsApp Settings or your profile picture.
  2. Tap Chats.
  3. Turn Voice Message Transcripts on or off.
  4. Tap Choose language, then select the language most of the voice messages you receive are in.
  5. Tap Change to {language}.

You can change the transcript language at any time by going to WhatsApp Settings, then tapping Chats > Transcript language. Turning voice message transcripts off will reset your transcript language settings.

How to see voice message transcripts

To see voice message transcripts, your operating system must be iOS 16 or newer and Siri must be enabled. Learn how to turn on Siri here. If Siri wasn’t enabled prior to turning on voice message transcripts, then you’ll need to download the selected language when enabling voice message transcripts.

  1. Enable voice message transcripts on your device.

  2. Tap and hold a voice message, then tap Transcribe.

  3. Tap

    [Image: open close menu]

    in the voice message to expand the transcription.

The voice message transcript might take a moment to become available.

Unauthorized use of automated or bulk messaging on WhatsApp

On iPhone

Copy link

WhatsApp is a private messaging platform originally built to help people message their friends and loved ones. Over time we’ve seen how people value messaging with businesses and so we’ve built two tools–the WhatsApp Business app and the WhatsApp Business Platform–to help companies manage customer interactions. Our products are not intended for bulk or automated messaging, both of which have always been a violation of our Terms of Service.

We are committed to reinforcing the private nature of our platform and keeping users safe from abuse. We recently detailed our on-platform capabilities to identify and ban accounts in this white paper. We’re aware that some companies attempt to evade our machine learning systems, even as we work tirelessly to improve them. Using the on-platform information available within WhatsApp we’ve found and stopped millions of abusive accounts from operating on our service.

This is a challenge that requires a holistic approach and WhatsApp is committed to using the resources at its disposal–including legal action–to prevent abuse that violates our Terms of Service, such as automated or bulk messaging, or non-personal use. This is why in addition to technological enforcement, we also take legal action against individuals or companies that we link to on-platform evidence of such abuse. WhatsApp reserves its right to continue taking legal action in such circumstances.

In addition, beginning on December 7, 2019, WhatsApp will take legal action against those we determine are engaged in or assisting others in abuse that violates our Terms of Service, such as automated or bulk messaging, or non-personal use, even if that determination is based on information solely available to us off our platform. For example, off-platform information includes public claims from companies about their ability to use WhatsApp in ways that violate our Terms. This serves as notice that we will take legal action against companies for which we only have off-platform evidence of abuse if that abuse continues beyond December 7, 2019, or if those companies are linked to on-platform evidence of abuse before that date.

Note: Boosting content may drive more people to message you on WhatsApp, but receiving many messages at once will not result in an account ban.

Nothing in this announcement limits WhatsApp’s right to enforce its Terms using technology, such as banning accounts based on machine-learning classifiers, and WhatsApp will continue to do so.

We will continue to provide capabilities to help businesses communicate with their customers. To learn more about these capabilities, visit the WhatsApp Business app and WhatsApp Business Platform pages.

How to use away messages

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

More

Android

iOS

When away messages are enabled, customers who message you will automatically receive a customizable message, indicating that you’re busy or away from your phone. You can choose which customers to send away messages to and when away messages should be sent.

Using away messages not only helps you protect your personal time. It also assures your customers that you aren’t neglecting them.

Set an away message

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Away message.

  2. Turn on Send away message.

  3. Under Message, tap the message to edit it, then tap Save.

  4. Tap Schedule to schedule your away message. Choose from the following options:

    • Always send: send at all times.
    • Custom schedule: send only during the specified period.
    • Outside of business hours: send only outside of business hours.
      • Note: This option is only available if you have set your business hours in your business profile.

  5. Tap Recipients to determine who should receive your away message. Choose from the following options:

    • Everyone: send to anyone who messages you while you have the Away Message feature turned on.
    • Everyone not in address book: send only to customers who aren’t in your address book.
    • Everyone except…: send to all customers except those you select.
    • Only send to…: send only to selected contacts.

Note: Your device must have an active internet connection in order to send away messages.

How to use broadcast lists

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

More

Android

iOS

People in some countries might see a monthly broadcast limit. This feature is rolling out gradually and might not be available everywhere. Learn more about broadcast limits.

You can use broadcast lists to send a message to several contacts at once.

Broadcast lists are saved lists of contacts that you can repeatedly message without having to select the contacts each time.

Note: Broadcast lists aren’t supported on Windows, Mac, or Web.

Broadcast list requirements

  • Make sure all contacts in the broadcast list have saved your number in their address book.
  • You can create as many broadcast lists as you like.
  • You can include up to 256 contacts in each broadcast list.

Create a broadcast list

  1. Tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Broadcast messages > New List.
  2. Search for or select the contacts you want to add.
  3. Tap the contact’s name > Create.

Recipients receive a message from your broadcast list as an individual message from you in their Chats tab. Their reply will also appear as a normal message and won’t be sent to other contacts in the broadcast list.

Note:

  • Only people who’ve added you to their phone’s contacts will receive your broadcast message.
  • If someone isn’t receiving your broadcast messages, ask them to add you to their contacts.
  • Broadcast lists are a one-to-many communication. If you want your recipients to participate in a group conversation, create a group chat instead.

Edit a broadcast list

  1. Tap Settings > Broadcast messages.
  2. Tap the “i” icon next to the list you want to edit.
  3. In the List Info screen, you can:
    • Change the name of your broadcast list by tapping the existing broadcast list name or List name. Enter the new name of your broadcast list.
    • Add or remove recipients from the list by tapping Edit list… Tap the “x” in the contact’s profile picture > Done.

Delete a broadcast list

  1. Tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Broadcast messages.
  2. Swipe left on the broadcast list you want to delete.
  3. Tap Delete.

How to use click to chat

On iPhone

Copy link

WhatsApp’s click to chat feature allows you to begin a chat with someone without having their phone number saved in your phone’s address book. As long as you know this person’s phone number and they have an active WhatsApp account, you can create a link that will allow you to start a chat with them. By clicking the link, a chat with the person automatically opens. Click to chat works on both your phone and WhatsApp Web.

Create your own link

Use https://wa.me/<number> where the <number> is a full phone number in international format. Omit any zeroes, brackets, or dashes when adding the phone number in international format.

Examples:

Use: https://wa.me/1XXXXXXXXXX

Don’t use: https://wa.me/+001-(XXX)XXXXXXX

Create your own link with a pre-filled message

The pre-filled message will automatically appear in the text field of a chat. Use https://wa.me/whatsappphonenumber?text=urlencodedtext where whatsappphonenumber is a full phone number in international format and urlencodedtext is the URL-encoded pre-filled message.

Example: https://wa.me/1XXXXXXXXXX?text=I'm%20interested%20in%20your%20car%20for%20sale

To create a link with just a pre-filled message, use https://wa.me/?text=urlencodedtext

Example: https://wa.me/?text=I'm%20inquiring%20about%20the%20apartment%20listing

After clicking on the link, you’ll be shown a list of contacts you can send your message to.

How to use Chat on WhatsApp button

The branded Chat on WhatsApp button follows brand guidelines. By following brand guidelines, this button will be recognizable and trusted by potential customers who want to interact with you. Chat on WhatsApp button are available in green and white and three different sizes: small, medium, and large.

Below are two examples of how the official Chat on WhatsApp button looks like:

Note: The Chat on WhatsApp button is currently only available in English.

To increase engagement using the Chat on WhatsApp button, follow these best practices:

  • Use the button as is. Don’t change the button.
  • Use the latest version of the button. You can download the button designs here.
  • Make sure the button is visible and easy to read.

You can use that Chat on WhatsApp button in many places, such as:

  • landing pages on desktop browsers
  • contact pages
  • mobile apps
  • mobile versions of your website
  • templates from third-party developers

How to use greeting messages

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

More

Android

iOS

A greeting message is a customizable message that’s automatically sent to your customers when they first message you. Greeting messages are also sent when customers message you after 14 days of inactivity in their chat with you. Enable greeting messages to automatically engage your customers in conversation.

Set up greeting messages like “Hi there! How can I help you today?” to engage your customers in conversation and help them feel welcomed. This can lead to improved customer satisfaction.

Set a greeting message

  1. From the Tools tab, tap Greeting message.
  2. Turn on Send greeting message.
  3. Under Message, tap the message to edit it and then tap Save.
  4. Tap Recipients and choose from the following options:
    • Everyone: send to everyone who messages you.
    • Exclude my contacts: send to anyone who isn’t in your contacts.
    • Everyone except…: send to all customers except those you select.
    • Only send to…: send only to select customers.

Note: Your device must have an active internet connection in order to send greeting messages.

If your greeting message isn’t sending

If you’ve enabled your greeting message but it’s not being sent, try the following:

  • Check if Meta Business Agent is enabled. Greeting messages are automatically disabled when Meta Business Agent is connected. If you want to use greeting messages, you’ll need to delete Meta Business Agent. Learn how here.
  • Review your recipient settings. Make sure your recipient setting isn’t excluding the contacts you want to reach. For example, if you’ve selected Only send to… or Everyone except…, some customers may not receive your greeting.
  • Remember the 14-day rule. Greeting messages are only sent to customers who message you for the first time or after 14 days of inactivity. If a customer has messaged you within the last 14 days, they won’t receive a greeting message.
  • Toggle the feature off and on. Go to Tools > Greeting message, turn off Send greeting message, wait a moment, and turn it back on.
  • Update WhatsApp Business. Make sure you’re running the latest version of the app.
  • Restart your device. This can resolve temporary issues with message delivery.

Lists are customizable filters that can help you keep your chats organized. Open the Chats tab and swipe down to view your lists.

Create a new list

  1. Tap Chats and swipe down to view your lists.

  2. Tap

    [Image: Add (plus sign)]

    .

    • You might need to swipe on your lists to find

      [Image: Add (plus sign)]

      .

  3. Add a name for your list and tap Add people or groups.

  4. Select chats or tap Search to search for and select a person or group.

  5. Tap Add > Done.

Alternatively, tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Lists > New list.

Note:

  • You need to add at least one chat to create a list.
  • You can add and remove chats from the list after creation.

Add or remove chat from list

  1. Tap and hold the chat.
  2. Tap Add to list.
  3. Select the list and tap Done.
    • To create a new list, tap New list > Add a name for your list > Done > Done.
    • To change list, tap list to deselect and then tap a different list. Tap Done.
    • To remove from list, tap the list to deselect and then tap Done.

Edit list

  1. Tap Chats and swipe down to view your lists.
  2. Tap and hold your list.
  3. Tap Edit.

    • Tap the list name >

      [Image: Delete Name (the letter X)]

      to change the list name.

    • Tap Add people or groups to add chats to the list.

    • To remove a connected chat, tap

      [Image: Delete (white minus sign within red circle)]

      Delete.

  4. Tap Done.

Alternatively, tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Lists > tap the list > Edit.

Delete list

  1. Tap Chats and swipe down to view your lists.
  2. Tap and hold your list.
  3. Tap Delete > Delete.

Alternatively, tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Lists > tap the list > Delete list > Delete.

Note: If you delete one of the preset lists, you can recover them. Tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Lists. Under Available presets, tap

[Image: Add Chat Green (plus sign within circle)]

next to the preset list you would like to add.

View all lists

  1. Tap Chats and swipe down to view your lists.
  2. Tap and hold All.
  3. Tap Manage Lists.

Alternatively, tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Lists.

Reorder lists

  1. Tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Lists > Reorder.

  2. Tap and hold

    [Image: Drag Item (three parallel horizontal lines)]

    to drag lists up and down the order.

  3. Tap Done.

Note: Learn about managing notifications for lists in this article.

Lists can help you segment, organize and quickly find your contacts. You can create customized lists or use one of the default or recommended ones, and add or delete recipients or groups to update your lists.

How to use live location

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

More

Android

iOS

Live Location allows you to share your real-time location with the members of an individual or group chat. You control whether and how long to share your live location. You can also stop sharing your live location at any time. Once stopped or expired, your live location will no longer be shared.

Individuals who you shared your live location with will continue to see the location you shared as a static thumbnail image and can tap the image to see your last updated location.

This feature is end-to-end encrypted, which means no one can see your live location except the people you shared with. To learn more about your security on WhatsApp, please visit WhatsApp Security. You can also read our Privacy Policy for more information on WhatsApp’s privacy practices.

Enable location permissions on your phone

  1. Go to your device’s Settings and tap Privacy & Security.
  2. Tap Location Services > WhatsApp > Always.

Share your live location

  1. Open an individual or group chat.

  2. Tap

    [Image: Attach (plus sign)]

    Location > Share live location.

    • Tap OK, if prompted.

  3. Select the length of time you’d like to share your live location. Your live location will stop being shared after the selected amount of time.

    • You can also enter a comment and emoji.

  4. Tap

    [Image: Send (paper airplane within green circle)]

    .

Stop sharing your live location

Stop sharing your live location in a specific individual or group chat

  1. Open the individual or group chat.
  2. Tap Stop sharing > Stop sharing.

Stop sharing your live location in all individual or group chats

  1. Tap WhatsApp Settings or your profile picture, then tap Privacy > Live location.
  2. Tap Stop sharing > Stop sharing.

Note: You can disable location permissions for WhatsApp at any time by going to your device’s Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services > WhatsApp > Never.

Can’t find live location

Facebook Places and Google Maps supply us with map and places information.

If you can’t find your location when using the share live location feature in WhatsApp, please contact these location providers.

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

Web

Mac

More

Android

iOS

Web

Mac

Windows

Polls are a simple way to ask questions and get real-time answers in a group chat.

Create a poll

  1. Open a chat.

  2. Tap

    [Image: Attach (plus sign)]

    Poll.

  3. Under Question, enter the question you want to ask your group. Poll questions are limited to 255 characters.

  4. Under Options, enter up to 12 poll options. Poll options are limited to 100 characters.

    • Tap and hold

      [Image: Drag Item (three parallel horizontal lines)]

      next to an option to change the order of your poll options by sliding up or down.

    • Users can vote for multiple options on polls by default. To prevent users from voting for more than one option, turn off Allow multiple answers.

  5. Tap Send to create your poll.

Receive updates about your poll

To receive updates on incoming votes, make sure push notifications for WhatsApp are enabled on your device. Learn more about how to manage your notifications.

Respond to a poll

To respond to a poll, tap the option, or options, you want to vote for.

To remove your vote for an option, tap the option you selected again.

Note: If the creator of the poll has turned off multiple answers, tapping an option will deselect any options that you previously tapped.

View poll details

To view the results of an active poll:

  1. Open the chat with the poll you want to view.
  2. Locate the poll, then tap View votes.

Find a poll

To search for a poll:

  1. Tap the search bar on the Chats tab.
    • You may need to swipe down on the Chats tab to show the search bar.
  2. Tap Polls.

Delete a poll

To delete a poll:

  1. Go to the chat with the poll you want to delete.

  2. Tap and hold the poll you want to delete.

  3. Tap Delete >

    [Image: Delete Message (trash can)]

    .

  4. Tap Delete for everyone or Delete for me.

Troubleshooting issues with polls

If you’re having issues with creating or responding to a poll, we recommend you:

  • Restart your phone, or turn it off and on.
  • Update WhatsApp to the latest version.
  • Update your phone to the latest OS.
  • Try connecting to mobile data if you’re on Wi-Fi, or to Wi-Fi if you’re on mobile data. If that doesn’t work, try these connection troubleshooting steps.

How to use Siri with WhatsApp

On iPhone

Copy link

iOS

More

iOS

Siri is a personal assistant built into iOS. You can ask Siri to send WhatsApp messages, place WhatsApp calls, or read aloud your unread WhatsApp messages.

Turn on Siri

  1. Go to iPhone Settings > tap Siri > Talk to Siri.
  2. Turn on Press Side Button for Siri.
  3. Tap Enable Siri.
  4. Return to Siri, then tap Apps > WhatsApp.
  5. Turn on Use with Siri Request.

On iPhone X, XS, XS Max, and XR you can press and hold the side button > tap Turn On Siri.

Note: Opening WhatsApp with unread messages will reset the notification badge. Siri will then interpret this as if there were no unread messages and therefore won’t read them aloud.

Visit the Apple Support website for specific information on how to use Siri and how Apple handles data sent through Siri.

Send stickers

You can access stickers, including avatar stickers, in individual and group chats. To view and use stickers, open a chat, then:

  1. Tap

    [Image: Stickers (square with folded corner)]

    [Image: Stickers (square with folded corner)]

    .

  2. Tap a sticker to send it.

Note: You can’t create new avatars, but you can continue using existing avatar stickers.

Sticker suggestions

Sticker suggestions are stickers recommended to you based on specific emojis you type at the start of a message. Only a single emoji will show suggested stickers.

You can:

  • Tap a sticker to send it.
  • Continue typing to dismiss the suggestion.
  • Scroll down the list of suggestions and tap Show more results to view additional stickers from WhatsApp and third-party providers, such as GIPHY.

Note: WhatsApp uses a set of common emojis to suggest relevant stickers available on your device. If you choose to search for more stickers, only your emoji will be shared with WhatsApp and third-party providers. As always, your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption, meaning no one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them.

Discover and manage sticker packs

Suggested sticker packs from the WhatsApp Sticker Store are shown underneath any downloaded packs. You can tap any of these stickers to send them, or tap

[Image: Add Sticker Pack (two overlapping squares with plus sign)]

to view the whole pack.

To find more sticker packs:

  1. Tap

    [Image: Stickers (square with folded corner)]

    [Image: Stickers (square with folded corner)]

    [Image: Add Sticker Pack (two overlapping squares with plus sign)]

    .

  2. Tap

    [Image: Download Stickers (down arrow within circle)]

    next to the sticker pack you want to download.

  3. [Image: Checkmark (checkmark)]

    will appear once the download is complete.

  4. Swipe down on the Stickers popup.

To find stickers in the App Store:

  1. Tap

    [Image: Add Sticker Pack (two overlapping squares with plus sign)]

    .

  2. Scroll to the bottom of the All stickers tab.

  3. Tap Discover sticker apps.

Note: Stickers downloaded outside of WhatsApp might not be searchable if the creator didn’t follow WhatsApp guidelines when tagging them.

To find out who the sticker pack belongs to:

  1. Tap

    [Image: Stickers (square with folded corner)]

    [Image: Stickers (square with folded corner)]

    .

  2. Tap and hold the sticker.

  3. The owner and creator of the sticker pack will be shown below the sticker.

Search for stickers

Open an individual or group chat. To find specific stickers you’ve downloaded or discover new ones,:

  1. Tap

    [Image: Stickers (square with folded corner)]

    .

  2. Tap

    [Image: Search (magnifying glass)]

    and search for stickers using text or emoji.

  • Under My stickers you’ll see stickers you’ve downloaded.
  • Under Text stickers, you’ll see sticker suggestions based on your search. Tap a sticker to send it. You can see stickers you recently sent in Recents or add them to Favorites or a sticker pack.
  • Under More stickers you’ll see stickers available to download from WhatsApp and third-party providers. Note: Online sources will use search terms to find relevant results.

If your stickers appear blank, you may have a corrupted backup. Learn more here.

Share avatar stickers

You can share stickers of your avatar, including social stickers with yours and another person’s avatar, to your chats and channels.

  1. Tap

    [Image: Stickers (square with folded corner)]

    .

Why am I seeing a new system message in my WhatsApp chats?

Copy link

We want to make it clear what it means to message with a business on WhatsApp.

Some businesses you chat with on WhatsApp may choose to use Meta or another company to help them manage their messages. When a business chooses to manage their messages with another company we will let you know by showing this system message:

If a business is managing their chats by themselves, you will see this system message:

Even if a business chooses to use Meta to manage their messages, Meta won’t automatically use your messages to inform the ads that you see. Just like with any other communication channel – like call centers or email – businesses can use interactions with customers for their own marketing purposes, which may include advertising on Facebook or elsewhere. You can always contact a business to learn more about its privacy practices.

If you don’t want to receive messages from a business, you can easily update chat preferences. Learn more about how you can control what messages you receive in this article.

Always private and secure

Every WhatsApp message is protected by the same Signal encryption protocol that secures messages before they leave your device. When you message a WhatsApp business account, your message is delivered securely to the destination chosen by the business.

Why is Meta reviewing my marketing messages?

Copy link

Marketing messages is now business broadcasts in some countries. Business broadcasts might not be available to you yet. If you’re seeing business broadcasts, please refer to this article.

We strive to keep Whatsapp users safe and prevent abuse on our platform. To help achieve this, your marketing messages are subject to review by Meta before you send them in chats on WhatsApp. Meta can’t access your messages once they’re sent in a WhatsApp chat. Meta can only review messages before they’re sent in chats, and does so only to make sure they don’t contain anything that might be harmful to Meta, WhatsApp or our users. Meta cannot access any information or details of the audience you choose for your marketing messages. You’ll be notified if a draft message is not approved to send, with guidance for how to update it and try again.

You can add or suggest groups to a community you’re already part of. By default, all members and admins can add a new group to a community. Admins can choose to adjust community settings so only admins can add new groups.

Only admins can add existing groups to a community, but members can suggest existing groups for admin approval.

Add or suggest a new group

  1. Tap

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots within circle)]

    , then tap Communitites.

  2. Tap See all next to the community you wish to add the group to.

  3. Tap Add group > Create new group.

  4. Fill in the group name and description.

    • The group name is required and can be up to 100 characters.
    • A description is optional and can be up to 2,048 characters.

  5. Tap Add.

Add or suggest an existing group

  1. Tap

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots within circle)]

    , then tap Communitites.

  2. Tap See all next to the community you wish to add the group to.

  3. Tap Add group > Add existing group.

  4. Select groups you’re an admin of, then tap Add when you’re finished.

  5. Review group permissions and group visibility.

  6. Tap Add to community.

Alternatively, you can:

  1. Tap a group you’re an admin of from the Chats tab.
  2. Tap Group info.
  3. Tap Add group to a community.
  4. Tap New community or Existing community.

Depending on what option you choose, you can either start a new community, or add the group to an existing one.

Note:

  • You can’t add groups with pending member requests to a community. To review pending requests, you’ll need to open your group and tap the group name.
  • You might be temporarily unable to add a group to a community as a security measure. This can be triggered by spam reports filed by members or by trying to link a group with recently added members. You may be unable to link your group to a community for a few hours and up to 24 hours in some cases. Please try again later.
  • When adding or suggesting a new group, you can set group visibility to Visible or Hidden.
  • Users can review, set and change group permissions when adding or suggesting a new or existing group.
  • Groups that admins create will automatically be added to the community.
  • Groups that members create or suggest will either be added to the community straight away, or sent to admins for approval, based on settings.
  • Group suggestions pending approval admins will be shown at the top of the community under Pending groups.

About building private, safe, and secure communities on WhatsApp

Copy link

We’ve built communities on WhatsApp for close-knit groups that need more tools to organize and manage their conversations. These kinds of groups typically have a connection where people know one another and are organized around a common place or interest.

Parents, schools, local clubs, and small workplaces now rely on WhatsApp as their primary way of keeping people up-to-date. These groups need private ways of communicating that are distinct from social media, but provide more tools to facilitate real-time conversations than e-mail or broadcast only channels.

At the center of every community on WhatsApp is a description and menu of groups that people can choose to join. Giving structure and organization to conversations among larger and more complex groups allows people to focus on what matters to them. We’re building updates to provide private, safe, and secure ways for these groups to communicate on WhatsApp using the following principles as our guide.

Empowering admins

Admins are responsible for creating and managing communities on WhatsApp. They can choose which groups become part of their community by forming new groups or by linking pre-existing groups.

Community admins can also unlink groups from the community and remove individual members from the community entirely. Group admins will be able to delete inappropriate or abusive chats or media for all members of a group. We’ll provide admins with resources on how best to use these new features.

Giving users more control over their chats

In addition to providing tools for admins, users can control their interactions within communities. Our existing settings allow users to decide who can add them to a group – and these settings will also apply to communities. You’ll always be added to an Announcement group as part of a community.

Users can also easily report abuse, block accounts, and leave communities they no longer want to be a part of. We’ve also added the ability to silently leave a group without notifying group members of the exit.

Limits on size, discoverability, and forwarding

While other apps provide group chats without limits, WhatsApp is focusing our product development on meeting the needs of organizations and other groups where many people know one another already. Unlike social media and other messaging services, WhatsApp will not support the ability to search for or discover new communities on our service.

To limit noise and overload, only community admins can send announcements to all community members. However, community members can reply to these announcements.

We continue to limit forwarding on WhatsApp to keep conversations private. With the introduction of communities, messages that have already been forwarded will only be able to be forwarded to one group at a time. We believe this will reduce the spread of potentially harmful misinformation in community groups.

End-to-end encryption and phone number privacy

Given the private nature for chats within communities, WhatsApp will continue to protect messages with end-to-end encryption so that only the members of the respective groups can see them, and no one else. This security technology protects sensitive conversations among organizations, workplaces, and personal groups.

To protect user privacy, your phone number is only visible to community admins, people who have saved your number in their contacts, or those who have your number from your other chats. This prevents unwanted contact and reduces the risk of scraping people’s phone numbers.

Taking action against abusive communities

These measures and controls are designed to empower community admins to address problems within their groups. We continue to encourage users to report problematic communities and messages to us directly.

Whenever we become aware of communities engaging in abuse such as distributing child sexual abuse material or coordinating violence or human trafficking. WhatsApp will ban individual community members or admins, disband a community, or ban all members of a community. We rely on all available unencrypted information including the community name, description, and user reports to take appropriate action.

WhatsApp will continue to build support for communities in the months and years to come. As always, we continue to listen closely to feedback from users about how we can help people connect privately, safely, and securely.

By default, all members and admins can create new groups in a community. New groups can have up to 1,024 members (1,025 including the group creator).

All members and admins can also suggest existing groups.

But, community admins can adjust settings to allow only admins to add new or existing groups, and members to suggest groups.

Choose who can add groups

  1. Tap the Communities tab.

  2. Tap a community.

  3. Tap

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots)]

    Community settings.

  4. Tap Who can add new groups.

  5. Choose:

  • Everyone: All community members can add new groups.
  • Only admins: Members can only suggest groups for admin approval. Only admins can add new groups.

Approve or reject groups suggestions

Community admins can choose to approve or reject groups suggested by members. Groups approved by a community admin will be added to the community.

  1. Tap the Communities tab.
  2. Tap a community.
  3. Tap Pending groups.
  4. Review and approve or reject the group suggestions.

Note:

  • If a group is hidden, you’ll see Group visibility is set to hidden below the group description.
  • The group and its members will be added to the community and its Announcements group.
  • The group’s members can join or request to join other groups in the community.
  • Community admins won’t be automatically added to groups created by community members.
  • Admins can add, join, manage, or remove a group from a community at any time.

Join a member added group

By default, anyone can join a member added group, unless it’s hidden.

But, group admins can change this in community settings so that they need to approve new members.

Note: When groups are added to a community, the group’s existing settings still apply unless an admin changes them. The only exception is group visibility which is set by the admin when the group is added to the community.

To join a member added group:

  1. Tap the Communities tab.
  2. Tap a community.
  3. Tap the new group under Groups you can join.
  • If you need to request to join, you’ll see a Request to join note under the group name.
  1. Tap Request to join, or Join group.

You’ll either be added to the group straight away, or when your request is approved. You’ll see any groups that are pending a request for you to join at the bottom of the list of community groups.

To cancel your request, tap Cancel request.

About communities

Copy link

Communities on WhatsApp bring members together in topic-based groups. Anyone can create a WhatsApp community. You can create new topic-based groups or add existing WhatsApp groups.

Community admins can reach members with important updates by sending announcements. Community members can stay connected by exploring and chatting in groups that matter to them.

Members can receive updates and announcements sent to the entire community. They can also easily organize smaller discussion groups on what matters to them.

Your personal messages and calls in communities are always end-to-end encrypted. No one else, not even WhatsApp, can read or listen to them.

Here are some helpful things you can do in groups that are part of communities:

  • Create events.
  • Share polls.
  • React to messages.
  • Share files.
  • Controls for admins.
  • Reply to community announcements.

About community announcements

Copy link

When you’re in a community, you’ll be added to an announcement group.

Admins can use this group to send announcements to all community members.

Only community admins can send announcements.

[Embedded video omitted]

0:00 / 1:53

As a member, you can:

  • Reply and react to an announcement.
  • Vote in and react to polls.
  • View the number of community members.
  • Report an admin announcement.
  • Mute notifications.

Note:

  • You can’t leave an announcement group unless you leave the community.
  • If you leave the announcement group, you’ll also exit the community.
  • Everyone can see the total number of members in the announcement group in the member list. Admins can see who the members are.
  • You can add up to 2,000 members to a community and its announcement group.

About community announcements for admins

Copy link

When you create a community, all admins and members are added to an Announcements group.

This is a group you’ll use to share announcements to all community members. Using community announcements instead of sending repeated messages to groups or members may help reduce the risk of being flagged as spam.

Only admins can send announcements and start polls, but members can reply and react to them.

When a community member replies to an announcement, you’ll receive a notification.

As admin, you can delete or report members’ replies by tapping and holding the reply, then tapping Delete or Report. It’s not possible to turn off or disable replies in a community.

Note:

  • You can’t exit the Announcements group without exiting the community.
  • Only the admin can see the total number of members in the Announcement group. Everyone can see who the admins are.
  • You can add up to 2000 members to communities. All community members are automatically added to the community Announcements group.
  • Community members can report replies by tapping and holding a reply, then tapping Report.

About community ownership

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

Web

More

Android

iOS

Web

Community owners play an important role in maintaining the health and activity of the community. As a community owner, you can:

  • Manage community settings (for example, review who can add groups and members to the community)
  • Add or remove members
  • Moderate discussions
  • Send announcements
  • Make sure the community remains active and engaging
  • Review pending group requests from members
  • Assign other admins to help you manage the community

To manage your community effectively, follow these tips:

  • Clean old groups and members regularly to make space for new ones.
  • Use announcement groups for important updates.
  • Engage with your community members regularly to understand their needs and feedback.
  • Establish and communicate clear rules and expectations to ensure a positive and respectful environment.
  • Regularly review and update community settings, including group descriptions, admin settings, and privacy options.

Note:

  • If the community is no longer relevant or legitimate, you can deactivate it for all members as the community owner. Learn how.
  • If you delete your account as a community owner and there are no other admins, the community will be deactivated.
  • If you think there’s a better owner for the community or if you’d like to leave the community, you can assign ownership to another admin. Learn how to transfer ownership.

How to create and customize events in community groups

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

More

Android

iOS

You can find and join events in community groups to help organize gatherings and stay connected.

Create an event

  1. Tap Communities.

  2. Tap the community, then tap the group chat.

  3. Tap

    [Image: Add Item (plus sign)]

    Event.

  4. Enter an event name, time, and date.

  5. Add additional details to make your event more informative.

    • Description: Describe your event in up to 2,048 characters.
    • End time: Choose an end time for your event.
    • Location: Add a location to help guests find your event.
    • WhatsApp call link: Add a call link to host your event on a video or voice call. Call links can’t be added to events more than 12 months in advance.
    • Allow guests: Turn on to allow guests to bring an additional guest.

  6. Tap Send.

Once created, the event will be shared in the community group. Members can tap the message to respond and view event information. They can respond Going, Going with guest, Maybe, or Not going.

Those who respond Going, Going with guest, or Maybe will receive a notification when the event begins.

You can also create events in announcements, but only if you’re an admin for the community. Learn how to manage community admins here.

Note:

  • Events are hosted by the event creator. It’s not currently possible to have a co-host.
  • If Disappearing messages is turned on, you might not be able to create events in advance. To use the full calendar, turn Disappearing messages off.
  • You can’t invite people who aren’t in the group to the event. You also can’t forward an event to another chat.
  • New users can’t see events created before they joined the group. To include new members, delete the event and create a new one.
  • When you view the Events section in Communities, you will only see upcoming events.

Edit an event

Only event creators can edit events.

  1. Tap Communities.
  2. Tap the community, then tap the group chat.
  3. Tap the group name > Events.
  4. Tap the event > Edit event.
  5. Edit your event name, date and time, location, or description.
  6. Tap Save.

Members who respond Going, Going with guest, or Maybe will receive a notification when you make changes to your event. A notification about your event changes will also be sent to the community group.

Cancel an event

Only event creators can cancel events.

You can deactivate a community for all members if you’re the community owner.

When you deactivate a community, all the groups you and other members belong to will be unlinked from the community.

You can find former community groups in the Chats tab. No one will be able to send messages in General or Announcements.

Note: There’s no way to reactivate a deactivated community.

Deactivate a community

  1. Tap

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots within circle)]

    , then tap Communitites.

  2. Tap the community you want to deactivate.

  3. Tap More > Community Info.

  4. Under Community and Announcement, tap Community.

  5. Scroll down and tap Deactivate community > Deactivate > Deactivate.

Once you’ve deactivated the community, you’ll see the groups that belonged to that community in your Chats tab, and can continue to interact with them. You won’t be able to interact with Announcements or General, but you can still view messages sent in those groups.

You can exit and delete any groups in your Chats tab.

Note:

  • Only the community owner who created the community can deactivate the community.
  • When a community is successfully deactivated, all groups will be unlinked from the community.
  • Excluding General and Announcement, groups that are unlinked from the community will continue to work as regular groups in the Chats tab.
  • If you deactivate your WhatsApp account, your communities and Announcement groups will also be deactivated. Community admins and members will be removed from the community and from Announcement groups.
  • There’s no way to reactivate a deactivated community.

About general chat for communities

Copy link

General chat is a group that new community members can choose to join.

It’s separate to announcement groups, which are used to communicate announcements from admins to members.

General chat works like other WhatsApp groups. Admins and members can use general chat to take part in group discussions focused around the community topic.

Community members will see notifications when a new member joins, and discussions from everyone in the group.

Like other groups, the community general chat limit is 1,024 members. You can exit the general chat at any time without leaving the community.

As a member

When you join a community, you can choose to join general chat, unless the chat is full. In this case, you’ll need to wait until there’s space for you to join.

The community general chat appears in the community Groups you can join.

You can add members to the general chat. You can also mute, exit, and report the general chat.

As a group admin

Community admins are automatically added as general chat admins by default. Admins can manage how group members interact with each other through group admin settings. Community admins can also promote and dismiss community general chat admins.

When general chat is created, admins will see a message about how to get started with the community general chat. You can edit the general chat name, description, and photo and will see the members list as people join.

Approve New Members is turned off by default so that members can easily participate in the community general chat.

Turning on the setting in Group Settings requires the admin to review every request to join the group before a member can join.

Admins can remove people from the group, and can unlink the group from the community.

When the community general chat reaches 1,024 members, new community members can’t join or be added to the group. New community members can join the community general chat when a member is removed or exits the group.

Admins can leave the group without leaving the community. Community owners can’t leave the general chat. If an admin unlinks general chat, it gets deactivated and all members will be removed from the group.

You can invite people to join a community by sharing a link with them. Only community admins can invite people to join a community.

Share a community invite link

  1. Open the community.

  2. Tap

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots)]

    Invite members.

  3. Tap Send link via WhatsApp or Add members, or tap the link itself to copy it for pasting in other messaging apps.

  • If you tap Send link via WhatsApp, you can select the individuals and groups you’d like to invite to join the community, then tap Send.
  • If you tap Add members, you can select the people you’d like to invite to join the community, then tap Add > OK.
  • Users you add in this way will have the opportunity to accept the invitation or exit the community.

Alternatively, you can:

  1. Open the community.

  2. Tap

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots)]

    Community info > Add members.

  3. Tap Invite to community via link or Add members.

  • If you tap Invite to community via link, you can opt to share the link via WhatsApp (as above), copy the link, share the link using other messaging apps, or share a QR code.
  • If you tap Add members, you can select the people you’d like to invite to join the community, then tap Add > OK.
  • Users you add in this way will have the opportunity to accept the invitation or exit the community.

Note: Anyone with WhatsApp can use this link to join the community, so only share with those you trust. It’s possible for someone to forward the link to others who could join the community without approval from the admin.

Revoke a community invite link

If you think the link has been shared with people other than those you intended to invite, you can revoke the link at any time:

  1. Open the community.

  2. Tap

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots)]

    Community info > Add members.

  3. Tap Invite to community via link > Reset link > Reset link.

Note: If you choose to do this, you’ll need to re-invite individuals and groups you want to join the community, as the link you sent them won’t work anymore.

How to keep your groups and community safe

Copy link

Safety is at the heart of the WhatsApp experience. Your community should be a space where people can connect meaningfully. We’ve designed tools and safety features to help you achieve that. Share this page with your members as a quick reference guide.

Your privacy is our priority

We’ve built several features to ensure the privacy of your account.

  • End-to-end encryption: WhatsApp protects your personal messages with end-to-end encryption. No one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp, can read, listen to, or share them. Learn more about end-to-end encryption in this article.
  • Turn on two-step verification: Set up a secret pin so no one can steal your account. If anyone tries to access your account, they’ll have to enter the pin as well as a 6-digit code sent to your phone number. Learn more about two-step verification this article.
  • Enable Touch ID or Face ID: Turn this feature on so only you can unlock your WhatsApp account. Learn how to use Touch ID or Face ID for WhatsApp in this article.

Control what you send and see

  • Send disappearing messages: You can decide how long messages remain visible once you’ve sent them - 24 hours, 7 days, or 90 days. Learn more about disappearing messages this article.
  • Use view once for shared content: For added privacy, you can send photos and videos that disappear from your chat after they’ve been opened once. Learn more about view once this article.
  • Pay attention to messages labeled “Forwarded many times.” Avoid rumors, viral messages, and fake news by checking for accuracy before forwarding content - especially if it’s a chain message and the “Forwarded many times” label is displayed. Learn more about forwarding limits this article.

Avoid unwanted contact

  • Block and report: You can stop receiving messages, calls, and status updates from a contact by blocking them.
  • Report inappropriate behavior: You can report inappropriate content, messages, or members. Learn how to block and report contacts in this article.

Tools for community admins and members

You can keep your community safe with the tools and tips below.

Admin controls

Admins have access to the following tools:

  • Invite members to join your community by sharing a link. Don’t post the link on a public forum or website. Only share it with people you know. Learn how to invite members into a community in this article.
  • Restrict who can make changes to your community. You control who can make changes to the group or community’s subject, icon, or description. Learn how to make changes to a community in this article.
  • Delete unwanted messages or remove members. As a community admin, you can easily delete unwanted messages or remove members from the community. Learn how to remove a member from a community in this article.

Member tools

Here are some useful tips to share with your community members:

  • Check your group permissions. You can decide who can add you to a group and if you want to stay in a group you’ve been added to. Learn how to change group privacy settings in this article.
  • Exiting a community: Members can leave a community they no longer want to be a part of by using the exit community feature. If you choose to leave you can do so quietly. Only the admin will know. Learn how to exit a community in this article and how to change group admin settings in this article.
  • Report inappropriate content: Members should report inappropriate or harmful content to WhatsApp to help us keep it safe. Learn how to report a community in this article.
  • Mute group notifications: If a community becomes too noisy, members can mute group notifications. Learn how to mute or unmute group notifications in this article.

Access groups in a community

There are a few ways to access groups in a community.

You can tap or click the community the group is part of from the Chats tab. Then, tap or click the group.

Or, you can search for your group by typing the group name into the search bar.

How to rejoin a community

Copy link

To rejoin a community that you left, use the invite link or rejoin any of the groups that are in that community.

If you were removed from a community by an admin, a community or group admin will need to re-invite you.

Once you rejoin a community, you’ll be automatically added to the community Announcements group. You can choose to join the general chat.

You can add yourself to more groups within the community.

If you were a community admin and left the community, a community admin will need to re-invite you. You can ask an admin to make you a community admin again.

Rejoin a community you’ve left multiple times

If you want to rejoin a community you’ve left twice, you’ll need to wait 24 hours to rejoin.

Every time you leave a community, this wait time increases. The most you’d need to wait is 81 days.

When you rejoin a community, you can rejoin all the groups you were removed from when you left.

Rejoin a deactivated community

A community is deactivated if the creator of the community is banned. If the ban is removed, you still won’t be able to re-access that community and will need to create the community again.

Only community or group admins can remove a group from a community. Community admins can also remove members of a removed group from a community. To remove a community member who is the owner of a community group, you must unlink the group from the community first.

  1. Tap the community.
  2. Tap More Info.
  3. Tap Manage Groups.
  4. Under Groups in this community, swipe left on the groups you want to remove and tap Remove > Remove group.

If you’re a community admin, you can tap Remove group members to remove members of the group from the community. You can do this if the members aren’t part of other groups.

Note: When a group is removed from a community, a message will appear in the group and Announcements group.

Remove a group

If you’re a group admin, you can remove any group from a community.

  1. Tap the group you want to remove from the community.
  2. Tap Group info.
  3. Tap Remove from community > Remove.

Note: When an admin removes a group from a community, group members can still use the group. However, other community members won’t see the group in the community and if they’d like to join this group they will need to reach out to admin to get added.

How to request a review for a suspended community

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

Web

Windows

Mac

More

Android

iOS

Web

Windows

Mac

If a community is suspended, no one in the community can send messages, add members, download or forward media.

A community might be suspended if it doesn’t follow our Terms of Service. WhatsApp uses various signals, such as community metadata or user reports, to identify communities that may be harmful or show signs of spam or scams.

If you’re a community admin and you think the suspension was a mistake, you can request a review.

Request a review

  1. Tap the suspended community
  2. In the popup This community is suspended, tap Request review.
  3. Tap Ok.

We’ll notify you when the review is complete, typically within 24 hours.

If the review was successful, the community can resume activity. If the review was unsuccessful, the community will remain suspended and the community admin(s) and members can tap Delete community.

Note: You can only request a suspension review once.

WhatsApp provides simple options for users to make reports to us from any community. You can add new contacts and share, edit, or delete your existing contacts on your mobile devices and in the web and Windows desktop versions of WhatsApp.

Add a contact

You can add a contact with a new chat, save someone’s number from a chat, or add contacts from a group.

If you have contact permissions and WhatsApp contacts turned on, you can choose which contacts on WhatsApp sync to your phone.

To check your contact permissions, go to your phone’s Settings > Apps > WhatsApp > Contacts and select Full Access.

Add a contact with a new chat

  1. Tap Chats >

    [Image: Add Chat Green (plus sign with circle)]

    New contact and enter contact details.

  2. Tap Done.

    • To sync a contact with your phone’s address book, turn on Sync contact to phone.

Add a contact from an existing chat

  1. Tap Chats.
  2. Tap the chat with your contact.
    • You will see their phone number instead of their name.
  3. Tap their phone number.
  4. Tap Create new contact.
  5. Tap Done.
    • To sync a contact with your phone’s address book, turn on Sync contact to phone.

Add a contact from groups

  1. Open the group.
  2. Next to one of their messages, tap their profile photo.
  3. Tap Create new contact and enter contact details.
  4. Tap Done.
    • To sync a contact with your phone’s address book, turn on Sync contact to phone.

Save group members to your contacts

  1. Open the group and tap the group name.
  2. Tap Add members to contacts.
  3. Below Add to contacts, select the contacts you want to save and tap Add.

Edit a contact

  1. Tap the search bar and enter their name.
  2. Tap the contact, then tap their name.
  3. Tap Edit.
  4. Tap Done.
    • To sync a contact with your phone’s address book, turn on Sync contact to phone.

Note: WhatsApp users choose their own profile photo. If a contact didn’t set a profile photo, you can’t add one for that contact.

Share a contact in chats

  1. Open the individual or group chat.

  2. Tap

    [Image: Add Item (plus sign)]

    Contact.

  3. Select the contact.

  4. Tap Next > Send.

The recipient can add the contact to their address book or message them directly from the message.

Delete a contact

  1. Tap the search bar and enter their name.
  2. Tap the contact, then tap their name.
  3. Tap Edit > Delete Contact > Delete.

Note:

  • If you’ve synced this contact to your phone by turning WhatsApp contacts on, they will be deleted from your phone’s address book.
  • Deleting a contact won’t delete the chat history you have with them. Learn how to delete a chat.

Note: WhatsApp may show suggestions for new chats on your Chats tab to help you start conversations with contacts from your address book. These suggestions appear when you have few active chats. To dismiss a suggestion, tap the X next to it.

You can hide your last seen and online, profile photo, about information, stories, and read receipts from other users.

Someone’s last seen and online, profile photo, about information, stories, or read receipts might not be visible to you because:

  • You or the user changed your privacy settings to hide this information.
  • You and the user both need to resync your contacts.
  • You’re blocked by the user.
  • You need to save them as a contact.
  • They haven’t messaged you before or saved you as a contact.
  • There’s a temporary network issue.

If your contacts’ names appear as numbers, some contacts are missing, or you can’t see a contact’s profile picture and information, first check your privacy settings. Ensure you and your contacts have the correct visibility settings enabled.

Note: If your contacts can’t see your profile picture and information, they should also check their privacy settings and resync their contacts.

Certain contact names won’t appear when you try to call, message, or view a status if you haven’t allowed full access to the contacts in your phone’s address book. You can grant access by going to your phone’s Settings > Apps > WhatsApp > Contacts.

Profile photo in notifications

When your contacts receive a message from you and they have notifications enabled, your profile photo is displayed in their notification, unless you decide to adjust your privacy settings.

To edit who can see your profile photo:

  1. Tap Settings or your profile picture, then tap Privacy > Profile Photo.
  2. Choose Everyone, My Contacts, My Contacts Except…, or Nobody.

On iPhone

If you see numbers or a username in WhatsApp instead of your contact’s names, or if some or all of your contacts are missing, there are a few things you can try:

Search your contacts

  1. Go to the Chats tab and tap the search bar. You might need to drag down on the chats tab to show the search bar.

    • Alternatively, go to the Calls tab and tap

      [Image: Add Chat Green (plus sign within circle)]

  2. Type a contact’s name or phone number.

Check your phone’s permissions

To find phone contacts that are using WhatsApp, ensure permissions are turned on in your phone’s settings.

  1. Open your device’s Settings > Apps, then tap WhatsApp.
  2. Tap Contacts and choose between:

  • Limited Access > select the contacts that you’d like to grant access >

    [Image: Blue checkmark (white checkmark within blue circle)]

  • Full Access > Allow Full Access.

If you deny WhatsApp access to your phone’s contacts, you can still:

  • Create contacts on WhatsApp that don’t sync to your phone.
  • Receive messages from other WhatsApp users and groups.
  • Change WhatsApp settings.

Reset your contacts

Users having trouble viewing their contact lists or those encountering issues with their contact lists not updating can try resetting their contacts. To reset the sync between WhatsApp and your phone’s contacts:

  1. Go to iPhone Settings > Privacy & Security.
  2. Tap Contacts > WhatsApp and choose between:

  • Limited Access > select the contacts you’d like to grant access >

    [Image: Blue checkmark (white checkmark within blue circle)]

  • Full Access > Allow Full Access.

If WhatsApp is grayed out, make sure you don’t have any restrictions in your phone’s settings. Go to your iPhone Settings > Screen Time > Content & Privacy Restrictions. If Content & Privacy Restrictions is turned on, tap Contacts > Allow Changes.

If WhatsApp is still grayed out or missing, you might need to restore your phone. Visit the Apple Support website for more information.

Missing international or Exchange contacts

If you still can’t see some of your contacts on WhatsApp, try the following:

  • For international contacts, make sure you’ve added the correct phone number in full international format.
  • If the missing contacts are stored in an Exchange account, your account administrator might not be allowing WhatsApp or other apps to access your contacts.

Note: Exchange accounts are likely to be work accounts.

Usernames on WhatsApp are rolling out gradually over the next few months and might not be available to you yet. In the meantime, you can reserve your username. We recommend keeping WhatsApp updated on your device so you can get the latest feature updates. To learn more about reserving your username, read this article.

On WhatsApp, you can message, call, or save someone as a contact with their username. You will need to know their exact username and their key if they have one set up.

Start a chat with a username

  1. In your Chats tab, tap

    [Image: New Chat (plus sign within circle)]

    to start a new chat.

  2. Tap the search bar.

  3. Type the person’s username. If the username exists, you’ll be able to start a chat with them.

  • You need to type the full, exact username to find someone.
  1. Tap Chat.
  • If they have created a username key, enter this now and tap Next. If you do not know their username key, you will not be able to reach them via username.

You’ll see their username and display name in the chat. If you don’t have their phone number saved, you won’t see it.

Start a call with a username

  1. In your Calls tab, tap

    [Image: New (plus sign within circle)]

    to start a new call.

  2. Tap the search bar.

  3. Type the person’s username. If the username exists, you’ll be able to start a call with them.

  • You need to type the full, exact username to find someone.
  1. Tap their username.
  • If they have created a username key, enter this now and tap Next. If you do not know their username key, you will not be able to reach them via username.

  1. Tap

    [Image: Call (phone)]

    or

    [Image: Video Call (video camera)]

    next to their name to begin a call.

You’ll see their username and display name in the call log. If you don’t have their phone number saved, you won’t see it.

Add someone to a group by username

  1. Open a group chat and tap the group name at the top.

  2. Tap

    [Image: More (three vertical dots)]

    Add members.

  3. Type the person’s username. If the username exists, you’ll see their profile with their display name.

  • You need to type the full, exact username to find someone.
  1. Tap their name and then Add.
  • If they have created a username key, enter this now and tap Next. If you do not know their username key, you will not be able to reach them via username.

You’ll see their username and display name in the group info. If you don’t have their phone number saved, you won’t see it.

If someone has a username key

Some people set up a username key for extra privacy. If this is the case:

  • When you try to message them for the first time, you’ll be prompted to enter their key.
  • You’ll need to get the key from them (it’s meant to be shared alongside the username).
  • Once you’ve entered the correct key, you can message them directly going forward.

You don’t need a key if:

  • You already have their phone number saved
  • You’ve previously chatted with them
  • You’re in a shared group with them
  • You scanned their QR code
  • They messaged you first

Learn more about how to add and manage your username key.

Share your username

You can share your username with others so they can message you without needing your phone number.

  • Share your link: Your username creates a direct link (wa.me/YourUsername) that you can share with others, whether in person, on social media, or on a business card.
  • QR code: You can also share your QR code, which now includes your username. Learn how to share your WhatsApp QR code.

About contact upload

Copy link

Contact upload is an optional feature that helps you create and manage your contacts on WhatsApp.

Using contact upload:

  • You can choose to sync your device’s address book to discover which of your contacts also use WhatsApp.
  • You can also save contacts to your WhatsApp account so they can be restored and managed across your devices.

We don’t share your contacts with Meta: When you give us permission, we access your device’s contacts to make messaging fast and reliable, and we don’t share your contacts lists with the other apps Meta offers.

Syncing your device address book to discover which of your contacts are also WhatsApp users

When you sync your device address book, this allows us to check which of your contacts are also WhatsApp users and update your WhatsApp contact list when your contacts who aren’t using WhatsApp yet sign up later. WhatsApp will access and upload the phone numbers in your address book typically daily, but this depends on various factors, including how often a user uses WhatsApp.

If any of your contacts in your device address book aren’t yet using WhatsApp, we protect their privacy by managing the phone number in a way that is designed to prevent those contacts from being identified by WhatsApp. We do this by creating a cryptographic hash value of their phone number, and then delete the number. Each cryptographic hash value is stored on WhatsApp’s servers, linked to the WhatsApp users who synced the corresponding phone numbers before they were hashed so that we can more efficiently connect you with these contacts when they join WhatsApp.

Separately, we also create a cryptographic hash representation of the phone numbers in your device address book which we use to detect and combat misuse of syncing device contacts. For example, we assess the hashes to determine whether there have been unusual changes in the address book. This does not involve tracking or comparing individual phone numbers.

You can control the contact upload feature from your device-based settings.

Saving contacts to your WhatsApp account so that they can be restored and managed across your devices

You can choose to save contacts to your WhatsApp account, which will securely store the names and phone numbers of your contacts who already use WhatsApp. This means your contact names and phone numbers can then be automatically restored to your WhatsApp account, including your linked devices, if you switch devices or reinstall WhatsApp. We do not include the names and phone numbers of any of your contacts who do not use WhatsApp.

You can choose which contacts to save only to WhatsApp or sync to your device. When adding a new contact for the first time, the sync option will be off by default and won’t be automatically synced to your device. You can sync the contact to your device by turning on the control and your selection will remain in place when adding future contacts until you change it. Contacts synced from your device address book will remain saved to your account, even if you turn off address book syncing later.

You can always choose to delete individual contacts or turn off saving contacts to your WhatsApp account in WhatsApp Settings > Privacy > Contacts, which will delete contacts saved to your WhatsApp account, including contacts synced from your device address book. If you delete your WhatsApp account, your saved contacts will also be deleted. To avoid losing contacts saved only to your WhatsApp account, you can choose to save them to your device address book.

If you need help with WhatsApp, we first recommend browsing through our Help Center. If you can’t find the answer you’re looking for and want to contact us, the only ways to contact WhatsApp Support are via the app or via our website contact form.

Contact us via in-app chat

    • Provide clear details about your issue and attach screenshots to help us resolve your request faster.

Contact us via our website contact form

If you can’t access the app, you can use our website contact form to submit a request.

  1. Go to the Contact WhatsApp page on the WhatsApp website.
  2. Tap contact us under WhatsApp Support.
  3. Provide clear details about your issue.
  4. Tap Next Step > Send Question to submit your request.

Note: Response times vary depending on your issue. You’ll receive an email response from an address ending in @support.whatsapp.com.

Can I email WhatsApp support directly?

No. WhatsApp no longer accepts support requests via email. Emails sent to support@support.whatsapp.com, support@whatsapp.com or any other @whatsapp.com address won’t receive a response from our support team because WhatsApp email addresses aren’t monitored for support requests. If you’ve seen any WhatsApp support email addresses recommended on a website, blog, or by an AI assistant, that information is outdated.

Learn more about safely communicating with WhatsApp Support here.

You can identify which of your contacts use WhatsApp when you sync them with your phone’s address book. You can only find new contacts from your phone’s address book on your primary device.

Find contacts

  1. Go to the Chats tab >

    [Image: New Chat (plus sign within circle)]

Note:- To avoid duplication, use the search feature in your Contacts app to check if the number is already saved before adding it. If you notice duplicate contacts, you can merge or delete them using your phone’s contact management options. - WhatsApp may show suggestions for new chats on your Chats tab to help you start conversations with contacts from your address book. These suggestions appear when you have few active chats. To dismiss a suggestion, tap the X next to it.

Can’t find contacts

If you can’t find your contacts, check the following:

  • Your contacts are using WhatsApp. Contacts that don’t use WhatsApp yet will be listed under Invite to WhatsApp.
  • You’ve saved your contacts’ phone numbers in your phone’s address book. If they’re using an international phone number, enter the full international format.

Invite a phone contact to WhatsApp

Invite a phone contact to a WhatsApp group

You can invite someone who doesn’t use WhatsApp to join a group directly. WhatsApp will send them an SMS invite on your behalf so you don’t need to switch apps.

Note:

How to recover lost contacts

Copy link

If you’ve turned on WhatsApp contacts, your contacts will be saved to your WhatsApp account and will be restored automatically if you change phones or reinstall WhatsApp.

  • If your contacts fail to restore, try deleting WhatsApp and reinstalling it again.
  • In some instances, your contacts may be restored after a delay for additional security. You can still add or edit your contacts on your device, but the changes won’t be stored and saved to your WhatsApp account until your previous contacts are restored.
  • Your privacy settings will use the contact list saved to your WhatsApp account. For example, if you chose only for your contacts to see your Profile picture, all contacts saved to your WhatsApp account can still see your profile picture, even if they haven’t been restored in your contact list yet.

If you’ve turned off WhatsApp contacts, you can only restore contacts if you’ve previously made a copy of them using your phone’s features. If you give WhatsApp permission to access your device’s address book, WhatsApp will add any phone contacts with an account to your WhatsApp contact list.

Note: If you unblock a contact or phone number which wasn’t previously saved in your device’s address book, you won’t be able to restore it to your device.
