If your photos appear blurry, try:

Automatically saving photos to your device

A photo might appear blurry if WhatsApp can no longer find it on your device or SD card. This usually happens if the photo is deleted. To automatically save photos to your device:

  1. Tap Settings or your profile picture > Chats.
  2. Toggle on Save to Photos.

Checking your Internet connection

Photos may appear blurry if you have a weak internet connection when uploading the photos. We recommend you:

  • Restart your phone, or turn it off and on.
  • Update WhatsApp to the latest version.
  • Try connecting to mobile data if you’re on Wi-Fi or Wi-Fi if you’re on mobile data.
  • Contact your mobile provider.

WhatsApp automatically saves audio, video, and photos sent to your phone. Save to Photos is turned on by default.

Stop saving media from all chats

To stop WhatsApp from automatically saving media to your Photos:

  1. Tap Settings or your profile picture > Chats.
  2. Turn off Save to Photos.

If you’ve turned Save to Photos off, you can turn it back on at any time if you want to revert to WhatsApp automatically downloading audio, images and videos.

Note: Changing this setting won’t affect any previous auto-download choices you’ve made for specific chats or groups.

Stop saving media from specific individual or group chats

You can also adjust your settings for saving incoming media from specific chats or groups.

  1. From the Chats tab, tap an individual or group chat.
  2. Tap the contact or group name to see Contact Info or Group Info.
  3. Tap Save to Photos and select Never from the selection below:
  • Default (On): Incoming media will be saved to Photos.
  • Always: All incoming media is saved to Photos.
  • Never: Incoming media won’t be saved to Photos.

Meta AI

About AI experiences available through WhatsApp

Copy link

WhatsApp’s parent company, Meta, has developed a number of optional AI (artificial intelligence) experiences that are available through WhatsApp. Meta provides you with the AI experiences and the AI technology that powers them, while WhatsApp focuses on improving integration and performance of our service when you message Meta AI through the WhatsApp app.

Some of the AI experiences available through WhatsApp include:

  • Chat with Meta AI
  • Create and edit AI-generated images
  • Edit your photos with Meta AI
  • Create an AI-generated image for your profile or group photo
  • Create and share AI-generated stickers
  • Access to Meta AI through WhatsApp search

Note:

  • Meta AI and some experiences are currently only available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet, even if others in your country have access.
  • You can chat with Meta AI in any language. However, in some markets, access to Meta AI is only available for devices in certain languages. We’re continuing to expand access. Learn more in this article.

Messages from Meta AI are generated by Meta’s AI (artificial intelligence) technology, in response to the prompts and messages you send to the AI. We explain more about how Meta uses AI messages and prompts below. Only messages that mention @Meta AI, or that people choose to share with Meta AI, can be read by Meta. Meta can’t read any other messages in your personal chats. When you share your personal messages for AI features that use Private Processing technology, Meta cannot read or access the messages you have shared.‬ Learn more here.

As always, your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption, meaning no one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them. Learn more about end-to-end encryption in this article.

What’s Meta’s role?

Meta provides the generative AI technology that powers AI experiences available through WhatsApp. Generative AI is a computer model that’s trained on different types of data, such as text and images, including the messages and prompts you send to Meta AI. In addition to building and training the language model, Meta is also responsible for the privacy and safety guardrails to protect people’s information and ensure they have a positive experience. Learn more about how Meta is building generative AI features responsibly here.

What’s WhatsApp’s role in offering AI experiences?

Integration

WhatsApp integrates and makes AI features available by:

  • Adding ways for you to discover and use AI experiences through WhatsApp.
  • Building tools so you can submit feedback to Meta if you experience a problem with AI experiences on WhatsApp, and reviewing that feedback to address any product issues.
  • Helping you understand, inside the app, how your information may be used when you choose to use an AI experience.

Performance

WhatsApp reviews how AI experiences are functioning on WhatsApp to make sure they perform optimally for our users.

What information does Meta receive about me if I use an AI experience available through WhatsApp?

Meta needs to receive and use information in order to provide the generative AI technology that powers AI experiences. What Meta receives and how Meta uses it depend on how you interact with the experiences.

Experiences such as AI chats, including Meta AI and AI image generation are provided directly by Meta. Meta uses AI chats consistent with Meta’s Privacy Policy. By using Meta AI features, you agree to Meta AIs Terms of Service. When you choose to use these features, Meta receives your prompts, AI messages, and feedback to deliver relevant responses directly to you and to improve its AI quality. Meta receives information from WhatsApp, which Meta needs for the optimal performance of the AI. Meta AIs Terms of Service and the Meta Privacy Policy describe how Meta uses this information. Meta also receives performance and AI usage information from WhatsApp in accordance with the WhatsApp Privacy Policy.

Learn more about AI chats and privacy on WhatsApp here.

About AI stickers

Copy link

You can create your own stickers using AI on WhatsApp. Once you send an AI sticker, it’ll appear automatically in your sticker tray.

AI stickers on WhatsApp are generated by artificial intelligence (AI), based on the description you enter, using a secure technology from Meta. To generate AI stickers, Meta processes the prompt without seeing your account information. As always, your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption, meaning no one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them.

Note:

  • This experience is currently only available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet, even if other users in your country have access.
  • At this time, only sticker descriptions in English, Indonesian, Portuguese, and Spanish are supported.

AI stickers generated automatically in response to your text might not always be accurate or appropriate. If you believe a sticker generated by AI is incorrect or if you have a problem, you can report it. Learn how in this article.

We may ban a user if we believe that user is violating our Terms of Service, including by sharing inappropriate AI-generated content.

You can use the WhatsApp search bar to search personal chats or send questions to Meta AI. Messages from Meta AI are generated by AI (artificial intelligence), using a technology from Meta, in response to the prompts and messages you send to the AI.

Note:

  • Meta AI and some experiences are currently only available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet, even if others in your country have access.
  • You can chat with Meta AI in any language. However, in some markets, access to Meta AI is only available for devices in certain languages. We’re continuing to expand access. Learn more in this article.

When you type into the search bar, we’ll show you results from your chats and present questions you can ask Meta AI. Content from your personal chats remains on your device. Meta doesn’t connect what you type back to you personally unless you send a prompt to Meta AI. By default, topics suggested by Meta AI are generated automatically and not based on your personal information.

You can continue to use the search functionality on WhatsApp as you normally would, to search chats for messages, photos, videos, links, GIFs, audio, polls, and documents from the search bar. Choosing to interact with Meta AI doesn’t affect your personal messaging experience on WhatsApp.

Search with Meta AI

  1. Tap the search field at the top of your Chats list.
  2. Tap a suggested prompt or type your own and tap Ask.
  3. As you type a prompt, you’ll see search recommendations under Ask Meta AI.
  • If prompted, read and accept the terms.
  1. Tap a search recommendation.

When you tap Ask, you’ll be shown Meta AIs Terms of Service only if you’ve never interacted with Meta AI. You’ll then be taken to a chat with Meta AI to continue the interaction. Learn how to chat with Meta AI in this article.

Note:

  • As always, your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption, meaning no one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them. To learn more about AI chats and privacy on WhatsApp, read more here.
  • Only messages that mention @Meta AI, or that people choose to share with Meta AI, can be read by Meta. Meta can’t read any other messages in your personal chats.
  • Once you start a chat with Meta AI, Meta may use your AI messages to improve AI quality. You can learn more about interactions with Meta AI outside of WhatsApp search in this article.
  • Some messages generated by Meta AI might not be accurate or appropriate. You can provide feedback to help improve these systems and responses for yourself and others. Learn how in this article.
  • Meta uses AI chats consistent with Meta’s Privacy Policy. By using this feature, you agree to Meta’s AI Terms of Service.

Create an AI image in the chat with Meta AI

  1. Open the chat with Meta AI.

  2. Describe the image you’d like to create in the message field.

  3. Tap

    [Image: send (paper airplane within circle)]

    .

  4. The generated image will be displayed in the chat.

Create an AI image in an individual or group chat

  1. Open the individual or group chat.

  2. Tap

    [Image: attach (plus sign)]

    AI images.

  3. You can:

  • Tap New image and describe the image you’d like to create in the text field. Then, tap

    [Image: create image (circle with sparkle dust)]

    .

  • Tap Use photo. Then, select a photo you’d like to edit.

  • Select a suggested image to explore ideas.

Alternatively, you can create an image using voice prompts. To do so:

  1. Open the individual or group chat.

  2. Tap

    [Image: attach (plus sign)]

    AI images.

  3. Tap and hold

    [Image: microphone (microphone within circle)]

    next to the text field, then start speaking.

  4. Describe the image you’d like to create.

  5. When finished, remove your finger from

    [Image: microphone (microphone within circle)]

    .

When you create and select an image, you can:

  • Tap

    [Image: refresh (arrow in the shape of a circle)]

    to see a new set of images.

  • Tap

    [Image: send (paper airplane within circle)]

    to share the image in the chat without modifying.

  • Edit: Tap Edit to change the style or edit the image.

  • Restyle: Tap Restyle to apply a style to the image.

  • Animate: Tap Animate to animate the image.

Edit a new AI image

  • Add: Tap Add and describe what you’d like to add to the image in the text field. Then, tap

    [Image: create image (circle with sparkle dust)]

    .

  • Remove: Tap Remove and describe what you’d like to remove from the image in the text field. Then, tap

    [Image: create image (circle with sparkle dust)]

    .

  • Change: Tap Change and describe what you’d like to change in the image in the text field. Then, tap

    [Image: create image (circle with sparkle dust)]

    .

  • Describe the edits you’d like to make to the image in the text field. Then, tap

    [Image: create image (circle with sparkle dust)]

    .

Apply a style to an AI image

When you tap Restyle you can choose to:

  • Apply a suggested style: Tap a suggested style to apply.

    [Image: create image (circle with sparkle dust)]

    .

  • Tap

    [Image: send (paper airplane within circle)]

    to share the image in the chat.

  4. Tap

    [Image: send (paper airplane within circle)]

    to share the image in the chat.

With Meta AI, you can create images of yourself using a text prompt. AI images are generated by artificial intelligence (AI), based on the prompt you type and your setup photo, using a service from Meta.

Note:

  • Meta AI and some experiences are currently only available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet, even if others in your country have access.
  • At this time, only English is supported.

Chatting with Meta AI and sharing your setup photo with Meta AI are optional. Meta AI won’t access your setup photo without being prompted by a user to do so. You can delete your setup photo at any time. As always, your personal messages and calls remain end-to-end encrypted, meaning not even WhatsApp or Meta can see or listen to them.

Only messages that mention @Meta AI, or that people choose to share with Meta AI, can be read by Meta. Meta can’t read any other messages in your personal chats. As always, your personal messages and calls remain end-to-end encrypted, meaning not even WhatsApp or Meta can see or listen to them.

Get started

  1. Open the chat with Meta AI.
  2. Type imagine me in the message field followed by your text prompt.
  • Alternatively, type a text prompt that includes the word me.
  1. If prompted, read and agree to the terms.
  2. Tap Allow to allow Meta to use your setup photo to create your AI-generated image.
  3. Follow the prompts to take a photo of yourself.
  4. Tap Ok.

Create an AI image of yourself

Once you’ve set up the feature, you can start creating AI images of yourself in a chat.

In a chat with Meta AI

  1. Open the chat with Meta AI.
  2. Type imagine me in the message field followed by your text prompt.
  • Alternatively, type a text prompt that includes the word me.

  1. Tap

    [Image: send (paper airplane within green circle)]

    .

  2. The generated image will be displayed in the chat.

In an individual or group chat

  1. Open the chat you’d like to create an image of yourself in.
  2. You can:

  • Tap

    [Image: Attach (plus sign)]

    AI images >

    [Image: Imagine me (face with sparkle within circle)]

    .

  • Tap

    [Image: Attach (plus sign)]

    AI images. Then, type imagine me.

  • Type @** in the message field and tap Meta AI. Then, type imagine me** or a text prompt that includes the word me.

  1. Tap

    [Image: Send (paper airplane within green circle)]

    .

  2. The generated image will be displayed in the chat.

Retake or delete your setup photo

You can always retake or delete your setup photo. If you choose to delete, Meta will your setup photo. You have the option to retake it if you want to use the feature again.

  1. Open the chat with Meta AI.
  2. Tap Meta AI at the top of the chat.
  3. Tap Imagine yourself.
  4. Tap:
  • Retake your setup photo to retake your setup photo.
  • Delete your setup photo to delete your setup photo.

You can also tap Retake below an AI-generated image of yourself to retake your setup photo.

Provide feedback

Some responses generated by Meta AI might not be accurate or appropriate. You can provide feedback to Meta about responses from Meta AI.

  1. Tap and hold the AI image you’d like to provide feedback on.
  2. Tap Good response or Bad response.

  • Alternatively, tap

    [Image: thumbs up (thumbs up)]

    or

    [Image: thumbs down (thumbs down)]

    .

  1. If prompted, add a reason, then tap Submit.

Note:

  • This is an optional feature provided by Meta. Your personal messages and calls remain end-to-end encrypted, meaning not even WhatsApp or Meta can see or listen to them. To learn more about AI chats and privacy on WhatsApp, read more here.
  • You always have the option to delete AI chats. You can also request the deletion of information including photos you previously shared with Meta AI or AI-generated images of you. Learn more in this article.
  • Meta uses AI chats consistent with Meta’s Privacy Policy. By using this feature, you agree to Meta’s AI Disclosures and AI Terms of Service.

You can create your own stickers using AI through WhatsApp. AI stickers are generated by artificial intelligence (AI), based on the text you enter, using a service from Meta. Once sent, your AI stickers will appear automatically in your sticker tray and can be shared at any time with your contacts.

Note:

  • This experience is currently only available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet, even if other users in your country have access.
  • At this time, only sticker descriptions in English, Indonesian, Portuguese, and Spanish are supported.

Create an AI sticker

  1. Open a chat.

  2. Tap

    [Image: Stickers (sticker with upturned corner)]

    [Image: Stickers (sticker with upturned corner)]

    .

  3. Tap Create > Use AI.

  • If prompted, tap Continue.
  1. Enter a description of the sticker you want to create.
  2. Up to four stickers will be generated.
  • You can also edit your description and try again.

Options after you create an AI sticker

Send, edit, or view an AI sticker

Once you create an AI sticker, you have the option to send, edit, or view it.

  • Send one of the stickers: Tap on the sticker you’d like to send.

  • View your stickers: View stickers you’ve recently created by tapping

    [Image: Recent stickers (clock showing 9:00)]

    in your sticker tray.

  • Edit one of the stickers: Tap and hold the sticker you’d like to edit, then tap Edit sticker.

  • Tap

    [Image: Add Sticker Emoji (square with upturned corner within circle)]

    to add a sticker or emoji to your sticker.

  • Tap

    [Image: Add Text (upper and lowercase letter a within circle)]

    to add text to your sticker.

  • Tap

    [Image: Draw On Sticker (pencil within circle)]

    to draw on your sticker.

When you’re done editing your sticker, tap

[Image: Send (paper airplane within green circle)]

to send it.

Favorite an AI sticker

You can favorite a sticker and share it later.

  1. Open the chat with the AI sticker you want to favorite.
  2. Tap the sticker in your chat or tap and hold the sticker in the sticker tray.
  3. Tap Add to Favorites.

To make AI stickers more accessible to those using screen readers, we automatically label stickers with emojis, based on the prompt you entered to generate the sticker.

Report an AI sticker

AI stickers generated automatically in response to the prompt you enter might not be accurate or appropriate. If you believe a sticker is incorrect, you can report it. We may ban a user if we believe that user is violating Meta’s AI Terms of Service, including by sharing inappropriate AI-generated content.

Report a sticker you’ve received

  1. Tap and hold the stick you’d like to report > Report.
  2. Tap Report and block or Report.

Report a sticker you’ve created

You can report a sticker you created on the creation screen.

  1. Tap

    [Image: More (three horizontal dots)]

    Report.

Alternatively:

  1. Tap and hold the sticker you created.
  2. Tap Report > Submit.

About Incognito chats with Meta AI

Copy link

You can have one-off conversations with Meta AI in an Incognito chat. When you chat with Meta AI in an Incognito chat:

  • Only you can see the chat. Meta and WhatsApp can’t access it.
  • By default, your conversation will disappear when you exit the chat. However, you can choose to keep your chat history when you exit the chat. Messages are only saved on your device. Learn how in this article.

Note:

  • Meta AI and some experiences are currently only available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet, even if others in your country have access.
  • You can chat with Meta AI in any language. However, in some markets, access to Meta AI is only available for devices in certain languages. We’re continuing to expand access. Learn more in this article.

For example, you can:

  • Brainstorm ideas for a new project.
  • Get travel ideas for a work trip that you don’t want to influence your future chats with Meta AI.
  • Ask for tips on how to reply to feedback before responding to a message on WhatsApp.
  • Get help planning a surprise, like a marriage proposal or birthday party.

Messages from Meta AI are generated by Meta’s artificial intelligence (AI), using a technology from Meta, in response to the prompts and messages you send to the AI.

Incognito chats with Meta AI use Private Processing, a secure technology from Meta. Meta’s Private Processing is built on top of a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE), a confidential computing environment. This allows Meta AI to generate responses to your prompts while ensuring no one, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can see your prompts or Meta AI’s response. In a chat with Meta AI in an Incognito chat, your prompts are sent encrypted between your device and the TEE, where they’re used to complete your request without any messages being stored after you exit the chat. You can learn more about Private Processing in this article and our white paper.

Chatting with Meta AI in an Incognito chat is always optional. As always, your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption, meaning no one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them.

Web search

To give you the most accurate and current answers, Meta AI may need to search the web for the most up-to-date information. To do this, Meta AI generates a search query based on your prompt and sends it to select web search engines, without connecting the search to your account. This allows Meta AI to provide you better responses. Search queries may be used to improve search results.

Web search is turned on by default, but you can turn it off any time. Learn more in this article.

About searching WhatsApp and asking Meta AI

Copy link

The search feature allows you to search for chats or send Meta AI a question. Messages from Meta AI are generated by AI (artificial intelligence), using a technology from Meta, in response to the prompts and messages you send to the AI.

With Meta AI, you can:

  • Learn more about topics that interest you
  • Discover new things
  • Get helpful suggestions

Note:

  • Meta AI and some experiences are currently only available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet, even if others in your country have access.
  • You can chat with Meta AI in any language. However, in some markets, access to Meta AI is only available for devices in certain languages. We’re continuing to expand access. Learn more in this article.

When you type into the search bar, you’ll see results from your chats and have the option to ask Meta AI. Content from your personal chats remains on your device. Meta doesn’t connect what you type back to you personally unless you send a prompt to Meta AI.

You can continue to use the search functionality on WhatsApp as you normally would, to search chats for messages, photos, videos, links, GIFs, audio, polls, and documents from the search bar. Choosing to interact with Meta AI doesn’t affect your personal messaging experience on WhatsApp.

Note:

  • As always, your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption, meaning no one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them. To learn more about AI chats and privacy on WhatsApp, read more here.
  • Only messages that mention @Meta AI, or that people choose to share with Meta AI, can be read by Meta. Meta can’t read any other messages in your personal chats.
  • Meta uses AI chats consistent with Meta’s Privacy Policy. By using this feature, you agree to Meta’s AI Terms of Service.
  • Once you start a chat with Meta AI, Meta may use your AI messages to improve AI quality. You can learn more about interactions with Meta AI outside of WhatsApp search in this article.
  • Some messages generated by Meta AI might not be accurate or appropriate. You can provide feedback to help improve these systems and responses for yourself and others. Learn how in this article.

You can create and share AI images to status. AI images are generated by artificial intelligence (AI), based on the prompts and messages you type, using a service from Meta.

When you create an AI-generated image to share to your status, you can add an Add yours sticker to enable others to see and try the prompt you used to create their own AI-generated image.

Images created with your prompt: If you created the image using your own prompt, you can add your own short description.

Images created with suggested prompts: If you created an image using a suggested prompt, that prompt will be used for the description.

Create and add an AI image

  1. Go to Updates.

  2. Tap Add status > AI images.

  3. You can:

    • Select a suggested image.
    • Type a text description of the image you’d like to create, then tap.

      [Image: regenerate (arrow in the shape of a circle within a circle)]

  5. After selecting an image, you can:

    • Add a caption.

    • Tap

      [Image: text (the letter T)]

      to add text. You can change the color, font, size, layout, and add a background.

    • Tap

      [Image: stickers (square with folded corner)]

      to add stickers or emojis.

    • Add, resize, move, or remove the Add yours sticker. Tap Done when you’re ready to share.

      [Image: music (music note)]

    • Tap

      [Image: crop-rotate (overlapping corners with arrow)]

      to crop and rotate.

    • Tap **@** to add up to 5 private mentions to your status. This notifies people or groups about your status, and they can reshare the content of your status to their audience.

    • Tap Status (Contacts) in the bottom left to customize your audience.

  6. Tap

    [Image: send (paper airplane within circle)]

    to share your status.

About side chat with Meta AI

Copy link

You can privately ask Meta AI for help with your individual or group chats. In a side chat with Meta AI, Meta AI uses messages from the relevant individual or group chat for context, without Meta or WhatsApp being able to access them.

When you interact with Meta AI in a side chat, only you can see the conversation. Other group members, Meta, and WhatsApp can’t see or access it.

Note:

  • Meta AI and some experiences are currently only available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet, even if others in your country have access.
  • You can chat with Meta AI in any language. However, in some markets, access to Meta AI is only available for devices in certain languages. We’re continuing to expand access. Learn more in this article.

How Meta AI can help you in a side chat

Get quick answers to questions

  • Responds to your questions
  • Explains something in the chat that you don’t understand
  • Provides advice related to the conversation

Get things done more easily

  • Helps you draft responses to messages
  • Surfaces parts of a conversation or summarizes information from the chat to help you quickly get up-to-speed
  • Organizes information shared in the chat for you, such as plans for a trip
  • Creates to-do lists for you based on action items from the chat

Help plan

  • Helps plan events
  • Shares travel or restaurant recommendations
  • Brainstorm ideas to share in the chat

Side chat with Meta AI uses Private Processing, a secure technology from Meta. Meta’s Private Processing is built on top of a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE), a confidential computing environment. This allows Meta AI to generate responses to your prompts while ensuring no one, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can see your prompts or Meta AI’s response. In a side chat with Meta AI, your prompts are sent encrypted between your device and the TEE, where they’re used to complete your request without any messages being stored after your session is completed. You can learn more about Private Processing in this article and our white paper.

Using Meta AI is always optional. As always, your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption, meaning no one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them.

Web search

To give you the most accurate and current answers, Meta AI may need to search the web for the most up-to-date information. To do this, Meta AI generates a search query based on your prompt and sends it to select web search engines, without connecting the search to your account. This allows Meta AI to provide you better responses while protecting your privacy. Web search is turned on by default. You can turn Web search off or on at any time. Learn how in this article.

Note:

  • Meta uses AI chats consistent with Meta’s Privacy Policy. By using this feature, you agree to Meta’s AI Terms of Service.
  • Some messages generated by AIs might not be accurate or appropriate.

How to use WhatsApp on Meta AI glasses

Copy link

Ray-Ban Meta and Meta Ray-Ban Display are smart glasses launched in partnership between Meta and EssilorLuxottica. Learn more about AI glasses on the Meta Help Center.

You can link WhatsApp to AI glasses to send and reply to messages, and to make, answer and decline calls.

How to link and unlink WhatsApp

Link WhatsApp to Ray-Ban Meta

  1. Open the Meta AI app on your phone.
  2. Select the device you want to connect WhatsApp to, and press the settings gear icon.
  3. Tap Communication.
  4. Tap Connect next to WhatsApp.

Link WhatsApp to Meta Ray-Ban Display

  1. Open the Meta AI app on your phone.
  2. Tap Settings.
  3. Tap Calling and messaging.
  • Or tap your glasses, then tap Calling and messaging.
  1. Tap Connect next to WhatsApp.
  2. Tap Continue to allow WhatsApp to use Bluetooth to connect your glasses.
  3. Put on your glasses and follow the prompts in the Meta AI app. A code will appear on both your phone and glasses. Confirm the codes match on both devices to complete pairing.

Unlink WhatsApp from AI glasses

  1. Open the Meta AI app on your phone.
  2. Select the device you want to disconnect, then press the settings gear icon.
  3. Tap Communication.
  4. Tap WhatsApp, then tap Disconnect.

How to use WhatsApp features

Send a text-based message

  1. Say “Hey Meta, send a message to [name] on WhatsApp”.
  2. Listen and confirm with Meta AI that you’ve selected the correct person.
  3. Say the message that you want to send.
  • Note: Your device will read your message back to you.
  1. Say “Yes”, “No”, or “Cancel”.

Send and receive a voice messages

You can send and listen to voice messages to keep connected with your loved ones and easily communicate on the go.

Make a call

To make a voice call, follow the steps in this article. You can also share your point of view while on a video call.

Set up message announcement and read out

You can use Meta Assistant to announce who’s messaging you and to read out your messages.

  1. Open the Meta AI app on your phone.
  2. Select the device you want to update WhatsApp settings for, and press the settings gear icon.
  3. Tap Communication.
  4. Tap WhatsApp, then turn Announce messages or Automatic message readout on or off.

Note:

  • If you don’t hear message announcements when the toggle is on, make sure you’ve provided Bluetooth permission in your phone’s settings.
  • If you turn Read out messages on, you’ll still need to say “Hey Meta, play message” to play voice messages.

About your privacy

When you use WhatsApp on AI glasses, your calls and personal messages are secured with end-to-end encryption. To protect your privacy, as soon as it’s identified that you’re sending a message or making a call, audio content is not sent to Meta servers. Various factors can affect accuracy, such as the clarity of your voice command that indicates the start of a message. No one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them.

Read our Privacy Policy for more information.

About using AI experiences available through WhatsApp

On iPhone

Copy link

We’re inspired by the possibilities that may come from Generative AI and believe they can help people, groups, and communities express ideas and make communicating with businesses more useful.

To start, we’re introducing ways for people to create stickers, as well as chat with and create images using an AI assistant built by our parent company Meta.

AI is fast improving its ways of responding to questions about people, places, and events in numerous languages. However, no matter how realistic these conversations become, talking to AI has different rules and expectations than personal conversations with friends and family. We want people interested in trying out this experimental technology to know some basics and what to expect.

Chatting with Meta AI through WhatsApp

The most important thing to know is that your personal messages with friends and family are off limits. Meta AI can read what is shared with it, but your personal messages remain end-to-end encrypted. Only people inside of the chat can read or share them.

We’ll make chats with AI visually distinct so it’s clear these are different from personal messages and conversations. You have to take action to start the conversation by opening a chat or sending a message to the AI. Only you or a group participant can initiate this, not Meta or WhatsApp. You can read more about this in our white paper.

Talking to an AI provided by Meta doesn’t link your personal WhatsApp account information on Facebook, Instagram, or any other apps provided by Meta.

What you send to Meta may be used to provide you with accurate responses or to improve Meta’s AI models, so don’t send messages to Meta with information you don’t want it to know. Even still, Meta’s AI is trained to limit the possibility of information about people, like names for example, from showing up in other chats. You have the option to delete your interactions with Meta AI.

Generative AI is new technology and it’s important to keep in mind that responses may not be accurate or appropriate. Please provide feedback to help improve these systems and responses for yourself and others.

On WhatsApp Web

Copy link

We’re inspired by the possibilities that may come from Generative AI and believe they can help people, groups, and communities express ideas and make communicating with businesses more useful.

To start, we’re introducing ways for people to create stickers, as well as chat with and create images using an AI assistant built by our parent company Meta.

AI is fast improving its ways of responding to questions about people, places, and events in numerous languages. However, no matter how realistic these conversations become, talking to AI has different rules and expectations than personal conversations with friends and family. We want people interested in trying out this experimental technology to know some basics and what to expect.

Chatting with Meta AI through WhatsApp

The most important thing to know is that your personal messages with friends and family are off limits. Meta AI can read what is shared with it, but your personal messages remain end-to-end encrypted. Only people inside of the chat can read or share them.

We’ll make chats with AI visually distinct so it’s clear these are different from personal messages and conversations. You have to take action to start the conversation by opening a chat or sending a message to the AI. Only you or a group participant can initiate this, not Meta or WhatsApp. You can read more about this in our white paper.

Talking to an AI provided by Meta doesn’t link your personal WhatsApp account information on Facebook, Instagram, or any other apps provided by Meta.

What you send to Meta may be used to provide you with accurate responses or to improve Meta’s AI models, so don’t send messages to Meta with information you don’t want it to know. Even still, Meta’s AI is trained to limit the possibility of information about people, like names for example, from showing up in other chats. You have the option to delete your interactions with Meta AI.

Generative AI is new technology and it’s important to keep in mind that responses may not be accurate or appropriate. Please provide feedback to help improve these systems and responses for yourself and others.

About using the AI handoff list

Copy link

Note:

  • This feature is currently only available in limited countries to select businesses. It might not be available to you yet. If you are unable to turn on Meta Business Agent using the steps in this article, you can add yourself to the waitlist here.
  • At this time, not all languages are supported. The language that Meta Business Agent uses is determined by your business’s phone number.

The AI handoff list enables businesses using Meta Business Agent to quickly identify and respond to customers who require special assistance, as determined by Meta Business Agent.

Use the AI handoff list

  1. From the Chats tab, tap AI handoff.
  • Note: If you do not see any chats when you tap AI handoff, this means that there are no conversations that currently require your assistance.
  1. Tap a chat to respond manually to that customer.

Manage AI handoff list settings

  1. From the Chats tab, tap AI handoff.
  2. At the bottom of the list, tap Manage AI handoff list.
  3. Under Remove chats from AI handoff list, select one of the following options:
  • Immediately after I reply: Responding manually to a customer will immediately remove the chat from the AI handoff list. This is the default setting.
  • 24 hours after I reply: Responding manually to a customer will remove the chat from the AI handoff list after 24 hours.

Chats that are inactive for seven days will be removed from the AI handoff list. They will still be available in the Chats tab.

About WhatsApp on Meta AI glasses

Copy link

Ray-Ban Stories, Ray-Ban Meta, Oakley Meta, and Meta Ray-Ban Display smart glasses launched in partnership between Meta and EssilorLuxottica.

You can use these AI glasses with some Meta platforms, including WhatsApp.

Ray-Ban Stories

You can use the hands-free voice commands on Ray-Ban Stories to send and reply to messages and to decline and answer calls.

The voice commands can also announce when you receive messages and read them out loud in English, French and Italian.

You can activate voice commands by saying “Hey Meta” and speaking your command.

For example, “Hey Meta, send a message to Anna on WhatsApp.”

Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta

You can complete even more actions with Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta AI glasses. You can use hands-free voice commands to send and reply to messages and to decline and answer calls. You can also use it to share photos.

Voice commands can also announce when you receive messages and read them out loud in English, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, and German.

You can activate voice commands by saying “Hey Meta” and speaking your command.

For example, “Hey Meta, send a photo to John on WhatsApp.”

You can also share your view from your glasses camera during a WhatsApp video call. You can do this by double tapping the physical capture button on glasses during a call.

You can use this feature even if you haven’t linked WhatsApp in the Meta AI app. To enable sharing your view, tap the glasses icon during your next video call for instructions.

Meta Ray-Ban Display

Ray-Ban Meta Display glasses feature a discreet in-lens display that allows you to view and respond to WhatsApp messages and make video and audio calls while remaining aware of your surroundings.

You can use WhatsApp by saying “Hey Meta” to send messages, reply to chats, or make calls. If you prefer not to use voice commands, the Meta Neural Band on your wrist enables control of the display through subtle hand gestures.

During WhatsApp calls, you can share your perspective using the built-in camera, and see incoming messages and notifications directly on the display. Replies can be made by voice or selecting suggested replies and audio is played through open-ear speakers for a hands-free experience.

Message search and summaries

The Message search and summaries feature for WhatsApp on Meta AI glasses allows you to quickly retrieve key details from your recent message history using Meta AI, all hands-free. Searches are performed and summaries are generated on your device, meaning they’re not shared with Meta servers and remain private to you. Your personal messages remain secured with end-to-end encryption.

Note: This feature is only available to program members in the US and Canada. To learn more, refer to Early Access program for AI glasses.

About your privacy

When you use AI glasses, your calls and personal messages are secured with end-to-end encryption. To protect your privacy, as soon as it’s identified that you’re sending a message or making a call, audio content is not sent to Meta servers. Various factors can affect accuracy, such as the clarity of your voice command that indicates the start of a message. No one outside of your chats, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read or listen to them.

Read our Privacy Policy for more information.

Meta Subscriptions and Products

About admin permissions for subscribing to Meta Verified or Meta One for businesses on WhatsApp

Copy link

If you are prompted to log in to a Facebook or Instagram account when trying to subscribe to Meta Verified or Meta One for businesses on WhatsApp, it’s likely that your WhatsApp Business account is linked to a Meta business portfolio controlled by a different account on Facebook or Instagram that has Full control admin permissions. The account subscribing to Meta Verified or Meta One must have admin permissions within the business portfolio.

Accounts that do not have Full control admin permissions will see the following error upon trying to log in to Facebook or Instagram to complete the subscription:

“Your Facebook/Instagram account {name} doesn’t have admin permission for this business. Try using a different account.”

This means that another admin associated with your business account has admin permissions. You’ll need to log in to that account to purchase the subscription. If your account is logged into the Facebook or Instagram app on your device, you will be able to sign in with one click. If you don’t have the app or aren’t logged in to Facebook or Instagram on your device, you’ll be prompted to login on the Facebook or Instagram website.

If your account doesn’t have permissions to purchase the subscription, tap Use a different Facebook account or Use a different Instagram account when prompted to log in to Facebook or Instagram to switch to an account with the correct permissions.

How to answer a WhatsApp call on Meta Quest

Copy link

Note: WhatsApp isn’t available on Meta Horizon operating system (OS) versions older than v62. If your software version is older than v62, please update it.

Answer or decline a WhatsApp call during an active VR session

When you receive a WhatsApp call during a VR session, you’ll see an incoming call notification with the WhatsApp caller’s name or phone number.

  1. On the WhatsApp incoming call notification, press Accept call or Decline call.
  2. Press Quit to exit your VR session, or Resume to continue your VR session.

Answer or ignore a WhatsApp group call on Meta Quest

When you receive a WhatsApp group call on Meta Quest, an incoming call notification appears with the WhatsApp group name. You can see the list of group call participants by pressing the participant icons.

  • On the WhatsApp incoming call notification, press Ignore to decline the call.
  • Press Join to connect to the call.

How to cancel your Meta One subscription

On iPhone

Copy link

Android

iOS

More

Android

iOS

Meta One is currently in limited testing and isn’t available everywhere yet. The options you see may vary based on your location, account type, and what’s currently available in testing.

This article explains how to cancel your Meta One subscription, what to know before you cancel, and what happens to your benefits after you cancel.

Meta One is a paid subscription that adds a set of benefits across Meta technologies. You can cancel your subscription at any time.

What to know before you cancel Meta One

Review the following before you cancel your Meta One subscription:

  • Subscription stays active until your billing cycle ends: When you cancel Meta One, you keep access to your subscription benefits until the end of your current billing cycle. After your billing cycle ends, you lose access to all benefits.
  • No refunds for canceled subscriptions: If you cancel your subscription, you won’t receive a credit or refund unless required by law.
  • Cancel from the same platform and account you used to subscribe: Your Meta One subscription is linked to the platform, device type, and Apple ID or Google account you used to purchase it. To cancel, use the same platform, device type, and account. If you use a different account, you may not see your subscription. If you purchased your subscription through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store, follow that store’s cancellation process.
  • Recommended cancellation timing: To avoid being charged for another billing cycle, it is recommended that you cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before your current billing period ends.

What happens if you cancel Meta One during a free trial

A free trial may be available when you first subscribe to Meta One. If you cancel during the free trial, you won’t be charged.

If you don’t cancel before the trial ends, your subscription automatically renews at the monthly fee, unless prohibited by law.

If you cancel and re-subscribe to Meta One before the trial ends, your original trial end date will still apply. You won’t be charged until that date.

Cancel your Meta One subscription

You can cancel your Meta One subscription from WhatsApp Messenger, the WhatsApp Business app, or the Facebook and Instagram mobile apps.

To cancel your Meta One subscription on WhatsApp Messenger:

  1. Open WhatsApp Settings.
  2. Tap Subscriptions, then tap Meta One.
  3. Scroll to the bottom, then tap Cancel subscription.
  4. Follow the prompts, then tap Complete cancellation.

Signing out of your account or deleting an app doesn’t cancel your Meta One subscription. You must complete the cancellation steps to end your subscription.

You can also cancel directly through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store by managing your subscriptions in your store account settings.

What happens after you cancel Meta One

After you cancel your Meta One subscription:

  • You’ll receive a confirmation that your subscription is canceled.
  • Your subscription stays active until the end of your current billing cycle.
  • After your billing cycle ends, you lose access to your Meta One subscription benefits.
  • If you change your mind after you cancel, you can subscribe to Meta One again at any time.

Troubleshoot problems with canceling Meta One

If you have trouble canceling your Meta One subscription:

  • Make sure you’re logged into the same account you used to subscribe.
  • Make sure you’re signed into the same Apple ID or Google account used for the purchase.
  • Make sure you’re using the latest version of WhatsApp Messenger or the WhatsApp Business app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store.
  • If you subscribed through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and don’t see cancellation options in Accounts Center, cancel directly through your device’s app store.

Visit the Meta One Help Center for more help.

We’re currently experiencing a problem with a WhatsApp Business feature. We’re working on fixing it at the moment. In the meantime, we recommend keeping WhatsApp updated on your device. Updates are released regularly and may contain fixes for bugs and other issues.

If you’re experiencing verification issues when signing up for Meta Verified, here are some potential solutions.

Can’t sign up

Meta Verified for businesses is slowly rolling out and isn’t available for everyone yet. If you’re not able to sign up, it may not be available for you yet.

Unable to verify business details

If you don’t see your business listed on the Select your business screen when signing up, we won’t be able to verify your business details.

If this happens, we recommend that you:

  • Make sure you entered your business information correctly.
  • Choose the business record that most closely matches your business, even if there isn’t an exact match.
  • Try signing up again after 4 weeks if the business you’re verifying is newly registered.

If your business name doesn’t match the profile name associated with your WhatsApp Business account, we won’t be able to verify your business for Meta Verified. If we’re unable to complete your verification because those names don’t match, you’ll have the option to tap Update profile name. Once you’ve updated your profile name, tap Update name > Submit. It typically takes about 48 hours for us to review your information. We’ll send you a notification once our review is complete.

If you don’t want to change your profile name, you can verify another profile that’s similar to or clearly associated with your business name.

Confirmation code issues

If you have trouble with your confirmation code, we recommend that you:

  • Make sure you enter your 5-digit confirmation code correctly.
  • Enter your code before it expires.
  • Depending on the verification method you choose, make sure you are using the correct email address or phone number for your code.

Note: Confirmation codes expire after 24 hours. If your code expires, you can select Resend code to receive a new one.

Issues uploading ID

When you take photos of your valid, unexpired government-issued photo ID to upload for identity verification, make sure you:

  • Use a well-lit area.
  • Place your ID on a flat surface with a contrasting background.
  • Can clearly read the text in the photos.

If you experience issues with your camera during this step of the verification process, you can also add a picture of your ID from your device’s photo gallery.

We may not accept your ID photos if they are:

  • Too blurry
  • Too dark or not taken in a well-lit room
  • Missing the required information
  • A picture of a screenshot or a photo-copied ID
  • Not properly visible with all four corners in the frame

Verification failed

There are a few reasons verification may have failed:

  • You didn’t complete the verification process. If this happens, your subscription will be canceled and you will be eligible for a refund. Learn more in this article.
  • We weren’t able to confirm your connection to the business. If this happens, we recommend choosing a different business record or selecting a different verification method.
  • You made any changes to your WhatsApp Business profile after subscribing. If your business has a Meta Verified badge on WhatsApp, you can’t edit your business profile information without losing your verified status. If you lose your verified status, only your 4 most recently-used linked devices will remain linked and your web page will be removed from the web and its link address will be available for others to claim. You will need to resubscribe to Meta Verified to get your verified badge, re-link your devices, and create a new web page link address. Before resubscribing, make sure the information on your profile is accurate and up to date. Learn about the steps you need to complete before purchasing a subscription here.

Can’t make payment for Meta Verified for Business on WhatsApp

Copy link

If you experience payment issues while subscribing to Meta Verified for Business on WhatsApp, try the following solutions.

Payment declined or failed

If your payment was declined, verify your payment details in the Google Play Store or Apple App Store to ensure they meet the following requirements:

  • Make sure you use a supported payment method.
  • Make sure you enter your payment information correctly.
  • Make sure your payment method hasn’t expired.
  • Make sure your payment method has enough funds in your account.

Note: Your payment method’s financial institution may have declined your payment. If this happens, please contact your financial institution for more information.

We recommend adding a second payment method to your account as a backup. If your default payment method fails for any reason, your backup payment will be charged to keep your subscription active.

Unauthorized payment

If you see a charge that you don’t recognize, we recommend that you:

  • Compare your Meta Verified payment history in Meta Business Suite with your payment method’s bank statement.
  • Check to see if an admin on your Business Account that has access to your card made the charge.
  • Make sure the charge isn’t for a different Meta product, such as Meta Ads.

Charged twice

Meta Verified business subscriptions are charged on a monthly basis and automatically renew every month. If you notice multiple charges in the same month, we recommend that you check the payment status. If your payment shows as “Pending”, this is likely an authorization hold from your financial institution.

WhatsApp Plus benefits and availability may vary by region and account. Available benefits will be shown to you during registration before you subscribe.

This article helps you fix common problems with subscribing to WhatsApp Plus, using benefits, and managing your subscription. If you have trouble with WhatsApp Plus payments, visit this article.

WhatsApp Plus is a paid monthly subscription that gives you even more ways to make WhatsApp yours - with exclusive stickers, app themes, extra pinned chats and more.

Learn about WhatsApp Plus.

Fix problems with subscribing to WhatsApp Plus

If you can’t subscribe to WhatsApp Plus, try the troubleshooting steps below.

Can’t find WhatsApp Plus

If you don’t see WhatsApp Plus as an option on WhatsApp, it may not be available to you yet. In the meantime, keep WhatsApp updated to access new features as soon as they’re available.

Note: WhatsApp Plus isn’t currently available on the WhatsApp Business app.

Can’t subscribe to WhatsApp Plus

If you see WhatsApp Plus but can’t subscribe, try these steps:

  • Check your eligibility. To subscribe to WhatsApp Plus, you must:
    • Be at least 13 years old.
    • Have a phone number from a country where WhatsApp Plus is available.
    • Have an active WhatsApp account.
    • Agree to the Meta Subscription Terms of Service and follow the WhatsApp Terms of Service and Meta Community Standards.
  • Check your account type. Currently, WhatsApp Plus is only available on WhatsApp Messenger. Business accounts aren’t eligible.
  • Check your device. You can only subscribe to WhatsApp Plus on iPhone or Android. You can’t subscribe from a computer or mobile browser.
  • Update your app. Make sure you have the latest version of the WhatsApp Messenger installed from the Apple App Store.
  • Try again later. If none of the steps above apply, wait a few minutes and try again. Temporary server issues can sometimes block the subscription process.

Fix problems with WhatsApp Plus benefits

If your WhatsApp Plus subscription is active but benefits aren’t working as expected, try the troubleshooting steps below.

Can’t find or access WhatsApp Plus benefits

If your WhatsApp Plus benefits don’t appear after you subscribe, try these steps. If you still don’t see certain benefits, it may be because benefits vary by region and account.

  • Close and reopen WhatsApp to refresh your account.
  • Make sure you’re logged in to the WhatsApp account that has the WhatsApp Plus subscription.
  • Check that you’re on a mobile device. Some WhatsApp Plus benefits aren’t available on computers.
  • Check that your WhatsApp Plus subscription is active.
  • Check your device’s internet connection.

Fix problems managing your WhatsApp Plus subscription

If you can’t manage, cancel, or find your WhatsApp Plus subscription settings, try the troubleshooting steps below.

Can’t cancel WhatsApp Plus

If you can’t cancel your WhatsApp Plus subscription through WhatsApp Messenger, you may need to cancel directly through the Apple App Store or Apple subscription settings.

Learn how to cancel your WhatsApp Plus subscription.

Can’t find your WhatsApp Plus subscription settings

To find your WhatsApp Plus subscription settings, follow the instructions in the Manage your WhatsApp Plus subscription article.

If you don’t see your subscription, make sure you’re using the same WhatsApp account you used when you subscribed. Also confirm you’re signed in to the same Apple account you used to purchase WhatsApp Plus.

Businesses with an active Meta Verified subscription can change their subscription plan and add additional business assets, like accounts from Facebook and Instagram, to their subscription.

When you change your plan, your subscription payment amount will change to the new plan price. Your existing subscribed assets and basic benefits like the verified badge will stay the same.

Note: This feature is slowly rolling out and may not be available to all regions or businesses. Plans and benefits may be limited to select businesses and/or locations.

What to know before you change your plan

  • Active subscription: To change your plan, you need to have an active Meta Verified subscription.
  • Eligible assets: Your subscription needs to contain eligible WhatsApp business assets. Any Facebook or Instagram profile that you’re adding to your subscription will need to meet their own eligibility requirements. Learn more in this article from the Meta Business Help Center.
  • Account owner: If you purchased your subscription through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store, only the owner of the Apple or Google account used to purchase the subscription can change the subscription plan.

Changing to a higher-priced plan typically takes effect within 24 hours and doesn’t require an additional review process. You should receive access to the benefits for that plan after the 24-hour period. Your payment amount will update to the new plan price.

Changing to a lower-priced plan takes effect at the beginning of your next billing cycle and doesn’t require an additional review process. You’ll continue having access to the benefits in your higher-priced plan until then.

Note: Changing plans is currently only available on mobile devices. This feature is not supported on desktop computers.

Change your Meta Verified subscription plan

Note: Only the owner of the Google account used to purchase the subscription can change the subscription plan.

To change your Meta Verified subscription plan on WhatsApp:

  1. Go to Manage Subscriptions and tap Explore other plans.
  2. Swipe to view the different plans and their benefits.
  3. Tap Upgrade to select a plan.
  4. Tap Continue.

After you change your plan

Once your subscription plan change takes effect, you’ll receive access to the benefits associated with your new plan. Your payment amount will be updated to reflect the new plan price.

Learn how to manage your Meta Verified subscription plan.

Having trouble?

If you have trouble changing your subscription plan, we recommend that you make sure:

  • You have an active monthly Meta Verified subscription.
  • There is no pending change in review. This process typically takes effect within 24 hours.
  • You haven’t already changed to a lower-priced plan during this billing cycle. You’ll need to wait until the next billing cycle to make further changes.
  • You’re the owner of the Apple or Google account used to purchase the subscription. Only the account owner can change the subscription plan.
  • You’re using a mobile device. This feature isn’t available on desktop computers.
  • Your payment method hasn’t failed or been declined.

Note: This feature is slowly rolling out and may not be available in your location yet.

Update business assets for Meta Verified

Businesses that are subscribed to Meta Verified or want to subscribe can update the eligible Facebook and Instagram business asset(s) linked in their subscription. You can update these business assets during the subscription process as well as after your subscription is active.

Note: This feature may not be available to all regions or businesses at this time.

Update business assets before subscribing to Meta Verified

Once you’ve selected your subscription plan, you can bundle your other business assets with your WhatsApp account:

  1. From the Payments screen, tap Edit Profile Selection.
  2. Select the Instagram or Facebook business assets you want to update.
  3. Tap Save.

Update business assets after subscribing to Meta Verified

You can also update your business assets after your subscription is active.

  1. Go to Manage Subscriptions.
  2. Tap Show you’re verified everywhere.
  3. Select the Instagram or Facebook business assets you want to update.
  4. Tap Add profile.
  5. Review your subscription price changes. Tap Continue > OK.

When you add or remove an asset, your subscription payment amount and billing date may change.

For Meta Verified business subscriptions purchased on:

  • Apple App Store: You’ll be charged the full amount for all your assets. Apple will refund what you already paid on your last billing date. Your billing date will change to the date you purchased an additional asset.
  • Google Play Store: You’ll only be charged for the added asset for the remainder of your current billing cycle. On your next billing date, you’ll be charged the normal amount for all your assets.

For information about Meta Verified businesses on Facebook or Instagram, read this article from the Meta Business Help Center.

About eligibility requirements for Meta Verified for Business on WhatsApp

Meta Verified for Business is a paid subscription for eligible businesses on Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp. To qualify for this subscription on WhatsApp, you need to meet the following eligibility requirements.

Applicant eligibility

To sign your business up for Meta Verified for businesses on WhatsApp, you need to:

  • Be at least 18 years old.
  • Have a phone number in a country where Meta Verified for businesses is available.
  • Follow our Meta Verified for Business Terms of Service, WhatsApp Business Terms of Service.

Business Account eligibility

Your WhatsApp Business account must:

  • Have a presence on the WhatsApp Business app a certain number of days.
  • Have recently sent a message.
  • Be located in a country where Meta Verified for WhatsApp Business is available.
  • Have a profile name and a profile picture.
  • Not have an active Meta Verified subscription through Meta Business Suite.

Note: Eligibility requirements are subject to change as we improve the product experience for our users. The subscription currently is not available to certain categories of businesses, such as government and political organizations, and would be subject to revocation.

How to get help with Meta Verified for businesses on WhatsApp

Copy link

Businesses with active Meta Verified subscriptions have access to our premium support experience to help resolve account issues.

All available subscriptions include Meta Verified support. Additionally, requests from businesses that subscribe to Plus, Premium, or Max plans will be prioritized to resolve issues more quickly.

To contact support on the WhatsApp Business app:

  1. Open the WhatsApp Business app on your primary device.
  2. Tap Tools > Meta Verified > Enhanced Support.
  3. Select the option you’d like help with:
  • Tap WhatsApp for support with WhatsApp features. Describe the issue. Tap Next and review the list of suggested help center articles related to your issue. If you still need support, tap Send my Question to WhatsApp Support.
  • Tap Meta Verified account to request support for issues related to your Meta Verified account or subscription. Then, select an option from the list of topics provided. If needed, tap Manage subscription to update payment methods and manage your Meta Verified account. For additional support, tap Email support to submit your support request.

About information WhatsApp shares with other Meta companies

Copy link

Our privacy policy covers the ways in which data is received from and shared with other Meta companies, and this article explains what additional user controls you have over that experience.

If you use WhatsApp Messenger

WhatsApp relies on Meta’s infrastructure, such as servers, to support people around the world with fast and reliable services. However, access to WhatsApp personal data is restricted so it cannot be used by other Meta apps – including for ads - unless it’s for determining how many people we serve, keeping people safe, or optional features that work across Meta Company Products. Optional features are always explained clearly in the app so you can make the choice that’s right for you. See the WhatsApp Privacy Policy for more information.

WhatsApp in Accounts Center is one of the optional features that work across Meta Company Products. If you have added your WhatsApp account to Accounts Center, read this article to learn more about how your information will be shared. Your Accounts Center will become your Meta Account. We are gradually rolling out this update over the next year.

If you use the WhatsApp Business app

The information we share with the other Meta Companies includes your account registration information (such as your phone number and information from your business profile and product catalog), transaction data (for example, if you use Meta Pay), service-related information, information on how you interact with customers when using our Services, mobile device information, your IP address, and may include other information identified in the WhatsApp Business App Privacy Policy or obtained upon notice to you or based on your consent.

We will always protect your personal conversations with end-to-end encryption, which keeps your personal messages and calls between you and the person you’re communicating with. No one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp, can read, listen to, or share them. We don’t keep logs of who everyone is messaging or calling and can’t see your shared location, so we can’t and do not share this with Meta. We need your contacts to provide the service, but don’t share your contacts with Meta. You can learn more about some of these limitations here.

This article explains how to view your Meta One subscription details, manage your payment method, and cancel your subscription.

Meta One is a paid subscription that bundles exclusive features across Meta Company Products, including WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook, into a single package. Learn more about Meta One.

View your Meta One subscription details

You can check your Meta One subscription status, renewal date, and payment method from WhatsApp Messenger.

  1. Open WhatsApp Settings.
  2. Tap Subscriptions, then tap Meta One.
  3. From this screen, you can review your subscription status, next renewal date, and current payment method for Meta One.

Learn how to subscribe to Meta One on Facebook or Instagram.

Use the same platform and account to manage Meta One

To manage your Meta One subscription, use the:

  • Same platform (the app you originally subscribed through — WhatsApp, Instagram, or Facebook)
  • Same device type (iPhone)
  • Same app store account (Apple)

Example: If you subscribed through the Apple App Store on iOS using WhatsApp Messenger, use the same setup to manage your subscription. This means using an Apple device, the same Apple account, and WhatsApp Messenger.

Note: Make sure you’re signed into the same Apple account you used for your original Meta One purchase. If you use a different account, you won’t see your Meta One subscription.

Update your Meta One payment method

Keep your payment method current to avoid interruptions. If your payment method expires or fails, your subscription might not renew. You’ll lose access to Meta One benefits across WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook.

You can add a backup payment method to your account. If your default payment fails, your backup payment method is charged automatically to keep your Meta One subscription active.

Learn how to update your payment method for Meta One.

Cancel your Meta One subscription

Meta One renews automatically each month unless you cancel. If you cancel, your subscription stays active until the end of your billing cycle. After that, you lose access to all Meta One benefits across WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook.

If you purchased Meta One through the Apple App Store, follow that store’s cancellation process. To avoid being charged for another billing cycle, cancel your Meta One subscription at least 24 hours before your current billing period ends.

Learn how to cancel your Meta One subscription.

Troubleshoot Meta One subscription issues

If you can’t view or manage your Meta One subscription, try the following:

  • Make sure you’re using the same platform, device type, and account you originally used to subscribe.
  • Make sure you’re using the latest version of WhatsApp Messenger from the Apple App Store.
  • Check that you’re signed into the correct Apple account.
  • If you subscribed through one app try managing your subscription from that same app.

If you’re still having issues, visit Troubleshoot Meta One subscription issues.

Visit the Meta One Help Center for more help.

Meta Verified is a subscription that helps your business establish its presence across WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook. Meta Verified provides tools to help you build more confidence with new audiences, protect your brand and more efficiently engage with your audience.

Manage your Meta Verified subscription

Once you’ve successfully completed the verification process for your business, you can manage details of your Meta Verified subscription, payment methods and payment history, within WhatsApp Business.

To manage your subscription, tap Tools > Meta Verified > Manage Subscription. From there:

  • Tap your business profile, to view your business details.
  • Tap Explore other plans to view upgrade and downgrade options for your Meta Verified subscription.
  • Tap Show you’re verified everywhere to update business assets in your Meta Verified subscription.
  • Tap Payment method to view and update your payment method.
  • Tap Payment history to view your payment history.
  • Tap X to close the subscription details window.

Upgrade or downgrade subscription

We offer several subscription plans with benefits that help you build more confidence and drive more engagement with new audiences and protect your brand.

Update business assets in your Meta Verified business subscription

Businesses that are subscribed to Meta Verified can update the business asset(s) like Facebook and Instagram accounts in their subscription.

Learn more about changing your subscription and updating business assets here.

For information about Meta Verified businesses on Facebook or Instagram, read this article from the Meta Business Help Center.

Transfer your Meta Verified subscription to a different WhatsApp Business account

At the moment, it is not possible to transfer your Meta Verified subscription to a different WhatsApp Business account. If you want to verify another WhatsApp Business account, you can purchase a separate Meta Verified subscription plan for the other account if it’s part of a different Business Portfolio.

If you only want to manage one verified account, you can cancel your active Meta Verified subscription when subscribing to a different account.

Transfer your Meta Verified subscription to a different device or phone number

Your subscription will not be impacted by moving your account to a new device. However, if you change your phone number, any active subscriptions will be canceled and you’ll have to resubscribe using the new phone number.

Note: If you switch your account from the WhatsApp Business app to WhatsApp Messenger, your verified status will be removed. If you have already switched to WhatsApp Messenger, you may be able to request a refund from the app store. For more information on how to request a refund, please see this article.

If you choose to cancel your Meta Verified subscription, go to Manage Subscription and tap Unsubscribe. Select a reason for canceling from the Choose a reason dropdown. Depending on your selection, you may also have the opportunity to provide additional details about your decision. After entering your feedback, tap Submit feedback. To complete the process, tap Continue cancellation > Cancel Meta Verified. Once these steps are finished, your subscription will be canceled, and you’ll have access to benefits until the end of your current billing period

Note: Canceling your Meta Verified subscription removes all but your 4 most recently used linked devices and removes your web page from the web 15 days after your subscription expires. The link address becomes available for others to claim 30 days after your subscription expires. If your subscription is canceled, you’ll need to resubscribe to get your verified badge, re-link your devices, and create a new web page link address. Before resubscribing, make sure the information on your profile is accurate and up to date. You’ll continue to have access to your Meta Verified benefits, like web page and multi-agent, until the end of your current billing cycle. Any open conversations or cases you have with the support team will be closed after that billing cycle ends.

Renew your Meta Verified subscription

If you have an existing WhatsApp Business Premium subscription, you’ll be given the choice to transition to a Meta Verified subscription. We’ll ask you to make the decision by a certain time. If you choose to become verified, we’ll carry your WhatsApp web page and custom address link over to your Meta Verified subscription.

Meta One eligibility

Subscriber requirements

To subscribe to Meta One Plus or Premium and access expanded AI experiences, you must:

  • Have a phone number from a country where Meta One and AI experiences are available. Learn more about AI availability here.
  • Have an active WhatsApp account on WhatsApp Messenger.
  • Agree to the Meta Subscription Terms of Service and follow the WhatsApp Terms of Service and Meta Community Standards.

How Meta and WhatsApp work together

When you subscribe to Meta One, both WhatsApp and WhatsApp’s parent company, Meta, plays a role in delivering your subscription.

What’s Meta’s role in this subscription?

Meta, WhatsApp’s parent company, offers multiple subscriptions across Meta Company Products as part of Meta One. When you subscribe to any Meta One subscription, use of your subscription information, such as your renewal date and payment information, is subject to Meta’s Privacy Policy.

What’s WhatsApp’s role

Messages from Meta AI are generated by artificial intelligence (AI), using a technology from Meta, in response to the prompts and messages you send to the AI.

Meta provides and operates the AI features included in your subscription and available through WhatsApp.

Note:

  • As always, your personal messages and calls are protected with end-to-end encryption, meaning no one outside of the chat, not even WhatsApp or Meta, can read, listen to, or share them. To learn more about AI chats and privacy on WhatsApp, read more here.
  • Meta uses AI chats consistent with Meta’s Privacy Policy. By using this feature, you agree to Meta’s AI Terms of Service.
  • Some messages generated by Meta AI might not be accurate or appropriate.
